izzyondroid:android.com.ericswpark.camsu.name: camsung
izzyondroid:android.com.ericswpark.camsu.description:
Silence camera on Samsung phones
 Installation
 If your phone is running Android 13 or below, just sideload the APK.
 If your phone is running Android 14 or above, you need to install the app via ADB as Google blocks installing apps that target SDK 22 and below. Enable Developer Mode and USB Debugging, then run:
adb install --bypass-low-target-sdk-block app-release.apk
 Make sure to replace app-release.apk if you've renamed the file.
 Usage
 Install, open, and click on the switch to enable the mute function. Click on the lock icon to enable on boot.
 Note that your phone needs to be on vibrate or mute for the camera shutter to be muted!
 Uninstall
 Turn off the switch, then uninstall. If you uninstalled before turning off the switch, re-install
the app, toggle the switch at least once until it is in the off position (so if it shows as off,
then turn on and then turn off. If it shows as on, just turn it off), then uninstall.
 If you still get unexpected behavior after following the removal steps, try the following command on your computer while your phone is connected via USB and in ADB developer mode:
adb shell settings delete system csc_pref_camera_forced_shuttersound_key
 This deletes the prop set by camsung.
 Warning
 Please do not use this app for malicious purposes. It's only made for situations where you don't
want to disturb other people (such as in restaurants or in a library).
 This app directly modifies system settings. While it should be relatively safe things can still go
wrong. I am not responsible for any problems that may arise from using this app.
 This app only works with recent Android versions paired with One UI releases. Future software
updates may block the mechanism that this app uses.

izzyondroid:dev.ldev.gpsicon.name: Gps Icon
izzyondroid:dev.ldev.gpsicon.description:
Before Kitkat, The GPS icon in the status bar reflected whether your device was still searching for satellites or already had acquired a fix. With Kitkat, this no longer was the case – but an XPosed module named GPSNotification fixed that. This module is no longer working with Lollipop – which is where Gps Icon comes into play. Thanks to this little app, you again can see the GPS status in your status bar.
 The developer of GPS Icon doesn’t want an app which needs less than 50kB to do its job inflated to 500kB or more just because of drawing in the „usual frameworks“ – so it sometimes takes a bit of playing around to have it working on as many Android versions as possible. Version 1.3.0 worked well for a long time – but no longer for Android 8 (Oreo). Attempts to get that working broke it for either Android 6, 7 or both – so after the experiments, we decided to keep 3 versions:
 v1.3.1: a special old version, actually created after v1.4.3, based on v1.3.0 and made working for Oreo
 v1.4.2: version with new features but before „Oreo hacks“ (i.e. probably not working on Oreo)
 v1.4.6: version with new features which now hopefully works for all aforementioned platforms (but no longer with Android 10)
 Should there still be any issues, please report!

fdroid:co.xplat.husk.name: Husk
fdroid:co.xplat.husk.summary: Turn a spare Android phone into a remote camera and control rig
fdroid:co.xplat.husk.description:
Husk turns a spare Android phone into a remote camera and control rig on your own LAN or
Tailscale network, without root.
Features: camera streaming (MJPEG) in a browser, or as a webcam via a PC tool; front or back
camera, switchable over HTTP while the stream runs; an accessibility engine for scripted
on-screen actions; in-app recovery of Wireless Debugging after a reboot; an adb bridge for
scrcpy from a PC; camera or screen motion alerts with a push and a live snapshot; a Samsung
DeX toggle on DeX phones. It starts automatically after a reboot.
Husk has no built-in updater and never checks for, downloads or installs anything on its own.
Update from F-Droid, or install an APK with adb.
Every host Husk can talk to, and what triggers it:
* 0.0.0.0 - it LISTENS, it never connects out: the HTTP control server on 8090 and the adb
 bridge on 15557, while the service runs, both behind a source-IP allowlist.
* 127.0.0.1 - loopback only, inside the phone: the accessibility engine on 8127, and the adb
 bridge forwarding to the local Wireless Debugging port.
* ntfy.sh - only when motion alerts are enabled and you have set a topic; one push per alert.
 The server is configurable - use your own instance.
* xplat.co - project website and PC companion download. The app itself never contacts it;
 1.1 removed the updater that read it.
The allowlist admits loopback, private LAN ranges, fc00::/7 and Tailscale's 100.64.0.0/10;
some carriers use that range too, so on mobile data it is wider than your tailnet alone. An
optional token adds a second layer, off by default. Restrict access with a Tailscale ACL.
Husk uses the AccessibilityService API and exposes an adb bridge by design. 100% open source
(GPLv3), AOSP framework APIs only: no trackers, no ads, no proprietary code.

fdroid:dev.cosmoslab.boxbreathing.name: Box Breathing
fdroid:dev.cosmoslab.boxbreathing.summary: Lightweight 50 KB box breathing timer that ticks the seconds out loud
fdroid:dev.cosmoslab.boxbreathing.description:
A lightweight, calm timer for box breathing and related patterns. The whole app is about 50 KB, smaller than a single photo, and the only permission it asks for is vibration. It runs well on any Android 10+ phone, old or new.
 The box. A dot travels the square, one side per phase: up while you breathe in, across the top while you hold, down while you breathe out, and along the bottom for the final hold. An inner square swells and shrinks with your breath, and a big counter shows the seconds.
 The audio timer. Breathe with your eyes closed:
 a sound every second: tick, beep, spoken count, or off, with an accented first second of each phase
 a cue at each phase change: a pitched chime, a voice saying "Breathe in", "Hold", "Breathe out", or off
 optional vibration on each phase change, and a gong when the session ends
 Configurable. 
 set each phase from 1 to 30 seconds, or 0 to skip a hold
 presets: Box 4-4-4-4, Long box 6-6-6-6, 4-7-8, Coherent 5-5
 session length in minutes, or open-ended
 a get-ready countdown, counting up or down, and volume
 No ads, no accounts, no network access, nothing collected. Free for everyone; an optional donation link is in Settings. The screen stays on during a session.
 Safety. This is a relaxation aid, not medical advice. Holding your breath can make you dizzy or faint: stop if you feel unwell, never use it while driving or in water, and ask a doctor first if you have a medical condition or are pregnant. Use at your own risk.

 App Groups & Widgets:

 FOSS & Privacy First:

fdroid:io.github.revocx35.walmobile.name: wa_logger mobile
fdroid:io.github.revocx35.walmobile.summary: Keeps an encrypted log of your WhatsApp messages, including deleted ones
fdroid:io.github.revocx35.walmobile.description:
wa_logger mobile runs the real WhatsApp Web in the background on your phone and records every message, photo, video, voice note, document, edit and reaction that your account sends or receives. Everything is encrypted on the phone, and messages stay readable even after the sender deletes them . There is no server: WhatsApp Web, the logger, the encrypted database and the WhatsApp-style reader all live in the app.
 Features 
 Anti-delete: messages deleted for everyone (or by a group admin) stay readable and are flagged in red. The Deleted page lists every deletion, and an optional notification tells you when one happens.
 Edit history: earlier versions of edited messages are kept.
 Send messages: text, replies, photos, videos, files, voice notes, reactions, edits and delete for everyone. What you send is logged too.
 All message types except view-once media: text with WhatsApp formatting, photos, videos, GIFs, voice notes, audio, documents, stickers, locations, contact cards, polls, calls, group events, reactions, replies, forwards and status updates (optional).
 Media is downloaded immediately , before it can be deleted, and stored encrypted.
 History import of the last messages of every chat when you link.
 Search across all messages, globally or per chat.
 Runs in the background as a foreground service, restarts after a reboot, and warns you if WhatsApp gets unlinked.
 Light and dark theme, phone and tablet layouts.
 Security 
 Message text, names, thumbnails and media files are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) under keys that only your password (scrypt) or your recovery key unlock. The logger holds only a public key, so it keeps logging while the app is locked but cannot read anything.
 Optional fingerprint unlock through the Android Keystore, auto-lock, throttled password attempts.
 No servers, no analytics, no backups. Screenshots are blocked by default. Crash reports stay on the phone and never contain message content.
 How it works 
The app is linked to your account as a WhatsApp linked device , like WhatsApp Web on a computer. You link it with a code on the same phone, or by scanning a QR code with another phone. Requires an up-to-date Android System WebView (or Chrome).
 Please note 
This app uses WhatsApp Web in an unofficial way. Automating WhatsApp may break its Terms of Service and could get the account restricted. Use it only for your own account and at your own risk. Laws about recording communications differ by country. Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. View-once photos and videos are not logged, by design.

fdroid:me.river.nightbell.name: Nightbell
fdroid:me.river.nightbell.summary: Uptime monitoring that runs on your phone. No server, no account.
fdroid:me.river.nightbell.description:
Point Nightbell at a URL, one element on a rendered web page, a Prometheus
server, your service's own health report, a GitHub repository, a host by
ping, TCP or UDP port, or an IMAP mailbox, and it watches it, charts it,
and gets loud when it breaks.
There is no server and no account. The phone in your pocket does the
checking, and your API tokens and target URLs never leave the device.
Ten kinds of monitor:
- Status check: hit a URL, assert on the status code.
- Request and response: pick the method, set headers and a body, assert
 on what comes back (contains, equals, regex, or a JSON field by path).
- Page element: load the real page in an embedded browser and watch DOM
 nodes you picked by tapping them.
- Prometheus: read a metrics endpoint, run a PromQL query, or watch
 Alertmanager.
- Health endpoint: read the report a service writes about itself, part by
 part.
- GitHub repository: stars, issues, pull requests, comments, releases and
 downloads.
- Ping: ICMP echo over IPv4 or IPv6, no root.
- TCP port: connect to one port and hang up.
- UDP port: send a real DNS, NTP, SNMP or game server query, or your own
 bytes, and check the reply.
- Mailbox: new mail in an IMAP folder, louder for the senders that matter.
Urgent alerts arrive as a full-screen red page with a looping alarm that
keeps going until you acknowledge it, and it wakes the screen even if the
phone is locked. A first-launch screen walks through the four Android
grants a paging app actually needs (notifications, unrestricted battery,
full-screen intent, Do Not Disturb access), because two of them have no
system dialog and have to be opened by hand.
A home-screen widget shows the worst monitor first. Settings let you shape
the alert policy: what counts as down, sound, haptics, escalation, and
quiet hours.
Signed with the developer's own key. No Play Store listing.

apple-macos:1639565811.description:
Project Office X introduces faster app performance, new implemented features and more responsive interface. The is a full-featured project management app. Based on Gantt method, this app is built to make it easy juggling multiple projects, assign resources, track any remaining work to be done, and head off potential bottlenecks at a glance. 
FREE TRIAL 
With the 14-day trial, you can try all of the features of Project Office X for free. After the trial, you can continue using Project Office X in a Preview Mode. 
BASIC PROJECT MANAGEMENT OPTIONS 
• Gantt chart view: Each task is shown graphically on visual timeline by day, week, month or year. Gantt chart view helps you keep an eye on tasks durations, start and due dates, completion percentage, dependencies and resources assigned. 
• Outline view: Use the Table view to see your tasks, groups and milestones in a spreadsheet format. Friendly and intuitive interface helps you get things done fast and stays out of your way while doing so. 
• Resource and Base calendars: Each project automatically includes a base calendar with some general working hours and a resource calendar that specifies a unique schedule for a specific resource. Project calendars are used to schedule tasks, and if resources are assigned to tasks, resource calendars are used as well. For each resource you can create an individual resource calendars based on the settings in base calendar. 
• Resources management: add resources to your project: people or materials, necessary to make this project done. Identify bottlenecks in your project and distribute workloads fairly. 
• Multiple baselines: set baseline to track development by comparing the set baseline with actual plan and progress. 
• Critical path: Project Office X displays your project’s critical path, which is the series of tasks that are necessary in order to finish your project on schedule. 
• Customized calendar: modifying work hours for entire project you can create a more realistic plan considering off-time and weekends. 
• Filtering: you can easily hide those tasks you don't need to think about at the moment. Simply use filter to focus on tasks you need to be done. 
• Projects and reports sharing: send an entire project to your colleagues or Email the Gantt chart to others as PDF. For more convenience you can make task and resources report and send them as HTML. 
• iCloud backup: backup your projects to keep all information you have added 
Project Office X Pro version:
• IMPORT/EXPORT Microsoft Project® (XML) 
Project Office X can export and import files with Microsoft Project® (XML) format. Project Office X does not support export/import MPP files. To use Microsoft Project® (XML) export/import, you need to buy one-time purchase license. 
• NETWORK DIAGRAM
This is a graphical flow of tasks, dependencies and the critical path for a project. It represent a chart with a series of boxes and dependencies lines that connect those boxes. Network diagram view will help you easily map out the project schedule and work sequence, track its progress and completion.
For how-to tutorials and other information, please visit our website: https://www.dk-consulting.app/project-office

Built around a real-time C++ DSP engine modeled after the classic Moog architecture, EduSynth gives you three oscillators, a 24dB/octave ladder filter, dual ADSR envelopes, an LFO, and a mixer — all with a clean, intuitive interface designed for learning.
PLAY & EXPLORE
• Three oscillators with saw, square, triangle, and sine waveforms
• Classic Moog ladder low-pass filter with resonance and self-oscillation
• Separate filter and amplitude ADSR envelopes
• LFO with multiple shapes and modulation targets (pitch, filter, amplitude, PWM)
• Portamento with off, on, and legato modes
• 10+ factory presets to get you started instantly
LEARN AS YOU GO
• Built-in Learn window with chapters covering signal flow, oscillators, filters, envelopes, LFO, and more
• Interactive info popovers on every section explaining what each knob does
• Visual signal flow strip showing how sound moves through the synth
• Chapters on digital audio fundamentals and real-time audio programming
CONNECT & PERFORM
• Full MIDI support — connect any MIDI controller
• MIDI settings window with per-device enable/disable and live activity monitor
• Computer keyboard input — play notes without any hardware
• Autoplay mode with selectable demo melodies
DESIGNED FOR LEARNING
EduSynth is perfect for music production students, audio programming enthusiasts, sound design beginners, and anyone curious about how synthesizers actually work. Every parameter is explained in plain language, and the Learn window goes deeper into the theory and code behind the sound.
Available in English and Italian.

Send Files Using OS X Sharing
Share encrypted files via Mail, AirDrop, or Messages, or even share them with third-party apps like Dropbox. However you usually share, Encrypto has you covered.
Or Save Them to Disk
With Encrypto, you can encrypt your files even if you don’t need to send them. You know, for file security on your hard drive. Just put your file through Encrypto and boom — it’s protected.
Encrypt and Decrypt on Both Mac and Windows
Share files with friends no matter their OS. You use a Mac, your friend uses Windows — you both can encrypt and send files to each other with Encrypto.

flathub:net.waterfox.waterfox.name: Waterfox
flathub:net.waterfox.waterfox.description:
Waterfox is a privacy-focused browser built for power users who value customization and control
 over their online experience. It pairs a privacy-first foundation with the kind of deep customization
 normally reserved for extensions and hidden flags.
 Waterfox routes DNS-over-HTTPS through a Fastly-hosted Oblivious HTTP relay, disables DNS prefetching,
 blocks 0.0.0.0 lookups, and leaves Safe Browsing calls off so lookups stay private. Cookie-banner
 automation rejects consent prompts when possible, HTTPS-First is enforced, Global Privacy Control
 is declared, and telemetry, experiments, analytics, and ad feeds are stripped out.
 Private Tabs let you flip any tab into an isolated session with its own history, cookies, and
 default search. Tab context shortcuts can copy URLs, unload sleeping tabs, or restart the browser
 with cache-purge options, while privacy-first ergonomics keep scripted pop-ups in tabs, prompt
 for new download handlers, and restore the classic status bar with live link previews.
 Layout controls move tab bars, bookmark bars, restart switches, and status bars without touching
 userChrome.css. Switch between Waterfox, Lepton, and Proton presets, adjust icon weight, padding,
 autohide behaviour, and rounding, or load legacy userChrome and userContent tweaks. Modern web
 APIs such as WebGPU, WebCodecs H.265, Web Share, JPEG XL, CSS Masonry, and scroll-driven animations
 are enabled by default, and Startpage plus Waterfox Private Search ship as defaults with a separate
 private-window engine.

flathub:org.sinzala.silori.summary: Calm, fast screen capture for Linux
flathub:org.sinzala.silori.description:
Silori is a lightweight screenshot tool focused on a calm capture flow, quick previewing, cropping, and simple on-image annotation.
 Version 0.1.1 improves the preview editing workflow with better crop handling, undo and redo behavior, and stronger blur annotations.
 Capture the desktop into a preview window
 Crop screenshots before saving
 Add simple annotations such as shapes, text, highlights, and blur
 Copy captures to the clipboard or save them as PNG or JPG

flathub:page.wisha.platen.name: Platen
flathub:page.wisha.platen.summary: Edit equations for slides and more
flathub:page.wisha.platen.description:
Platen is a Typst/LaTeX equation editor intended for use when making presentations. You can...
 Typeset equations using Typst or LaTeX (translated to Typst via MiTeX).
 See the equations rendered instantly as you type.
 Customize style and layout (anything Typst is capable of).
 Change your Typst/LaTeX preamble, and use any package from the Typst Universe.
 Export as SVG, PDF, PNG, JPEG, and WebP.
 Directly paste vector output into LibreOffice, OnlyOffice, or any program that support pasting SVGs.
 Directly paste vector output into Google Slides (experimental).
 Recover formulae from Platen-made image files by pasting them back into Platen.
 Recover formulae from Platen-made SVG objects in LibreOffice, OnlyOffice, and Google Slides by pasting them back in (experimental).

fedora-packages:armadillo/armadillo.description: Armadillo is a C++ linear algebra library (matrix maths) aiming towards a good balance between speed and ease of use. Integer, floating point and complex numbers are supported, as well as a subset of trigonometric and statistics functions. Various matrix decompositions are provided through optional integration with LAPACK and ATLAS libraries. A delayed evaluation approach is employed (during compile time) to combine several operations into one and reduce (or eliminate) the need for temporaries. This is accomplished through recursive templates and template meta-programming. This library is useful if C++ has been decided as the language of choice (due to speed and/or integration capabilities), rather than another language like Matlab or Octave.

fedora-packages:dmlite/dmlite-dpm-dsi.description: The dpm-dsi package provides a Disk Pool Manager (DPM) plugin for the Globus GridFTP server, following the Globus Data Storage Interface (DSI). fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package provides all of the extension and converter modules.

fedora-packages:ghc8.10/ghc8.10.description: GHC is a state-of-the-art, open source, compiler and interactive environment for the functional language Haskell. Highlights: - GHC supports the entire Haskell 2010 language plus a wide variety of extensions. - GHC has particularly good support for concurrency and parallelism, including support for Software Transactional Memory (STM). - GHC generates fast code, particularly for concurrent programs. Take a look at GHC's performance on The Computer Language Benchmarks Game. - GHC works on several platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux, most varieties of Unix, and several different processor architectures. - GHC has extensive optimisation capabilities, including inter-module optimisation. - GHC compiles Haskell code either directly to native code or using LLVM as a back-end. GHC can also generate C code as an intermediate target for porting to new platforms. The interactive environment compiles Haskell to bytecode, and supports execution of mixed bytecode/compiled programs. - Profiling is supported, both by time/allocation and various kinds of heap profiling. - GHC comes with several libraries, and thousands more are available on Hackage.

firefox-addons:46308.name: Google Translator for Firefox
firefox-addons:46308.summary: With this addon you can translate any text to your own language with one click or hot-key. You can either translate the selected text, this way the translated text will overwrite the original selected text, or you can translate the full page too.
firefox-addons:46308.description:
By default, the add-on will try to set your detected language for the default target language. If it is not possible then English will be the target language of the translation.
It's highly recommended to select less text than more, otherwise the translation will take longer to appear. You can select a maximum of 1100-character long text. If you select a longer text, you'll get an alert box in some cases. You shouldn't either select pictures or tables because these will disappear and mystic text will appear there.
Now, let's see, how it works. Firstly, you search something that you don't understand because it's in an other language. Secondly, you select this section or sentence. Now you can go three ways:
- Right-click with the mouse and click on "Translate this text with Google Translate" text. 
- Click on the Toolbar icon.
- Press the hot-key.
As soon as the translation-progress starts, the Red T will become green, and as soon as the translation ends, it'd be red again. Within a second or two, you'll see that the selection disappears and a text in your language appears there. That's all.
Or, if you want to translate the full page, you can go with the three ways mentioned above, too.
 Options: 
you can find this menu if you:
 - right-click on the Red T (or before Firefox 57 click on the little arrow next to it) and click "Options"
 - go to Add-ons menu and click on configuration of this addon
 you can set here: 
 - what language you want to translate to
 - what (and how) to translate when you click on the Red T or press the hot-key
 - the Hot-key (only before FF57)
Available target languages: you can translate to every language that you can find on Google Translate page ( http://translate.google.com/ ). If you found a language that isn't in the list of this addon then comment here below.
The language of the original text is automatically detected.
Available user interface languages: Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, Serbian, Slovenian, Spanish (Spain), Turkish.
The translations are powered by Google Translate, the addon uses their translator-program.

firefox-addons:2642515.name: HLS Video Download
firefox-addons:2642515.summary: Download videos from the Web. The extension handles some HLS based and single file video stream formats and it can be used for websites that use respective technology (e.g. arte.tv, Putlocker, HlsPlay, 123Movies, Tinklepad, SolarMovie, etc).
firefox-addons:2642515.description:
HLS Video Download is a tool for downloading video files from websites and saving them on your local device. Notice: The unregistered version limits the size of the files that it downloads to 20MB (full version can be activated for $1.99 on the extension's options page). This is not a general purpose download tool but it specializes on certain scenarios that do not seem to be supported by other existing 'video download' extensions. It does not aim to replicate features that are already nicely covered by other more complete video download extensions. It handles some HLS based and single file stream formats and it can be used for websites that use respective technology (e.g. ARD mediathek, arte.tv , Youtube, Putlocker, HlsPlay, 123Movies, Tinklepad, SolarMovie, etc). Known limitation: This plugin is not 100% HLS feature complete, i.e. there are features like "HLS media encryption" that are not currently fully implemented. Before buying the full version, make sure to use the demo version to specifically verify that the plugin actually downloads playable versions of the streams that you are specifically interested in! Feel free to drop me a feature request in case you are interested in some page that isn't currently supported. LEGAL DISCLAIMER: The extension is provided 'as is', without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to the warranty of fitness for a particular purpose. There may be country specific laws regarding what videos can be legally downloaded from the Internet. The fact that it is technically possible to download a video does not automatically make it legal and it is your responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations that apply to whatever country you might be living in. Usage: Click on the extension's toolbar icon and use the 'Turn on' / 'Turn off' button in the respective dropdown menu to make sure the extension is active (The "turned off" plugin will still complete downloads already in progress but it will stop to look to new media streams.). Use the video website's regular functionality to the point where the streamed video is playing (you can pause it now) or where it has already accessed the respective video stream data. Then click HLS Video Download's toolbar icon. Wait until the resulting dropdown menu is properly filled (depending on the website this may take some seconds). Any videos that can be downloaded will show as buttons in the dropdown. (If a video isn't detected it may help to reload the page.) The menu will also show the status of the previous downloads. Files are downloaded to the browser's regular download-folder. Note: Completely closing the browser will discard any downloads that have not been completed. The plugin sets some default name for each download which will be used to name the file once the download is complete. This name can be easily changed in the tool-menu by clicking the respective name while a download is still in progress. The 'X' icon shown for respective downloads can be used to cancel the download and remove it from the tool-menu's list. Some pages use separate streams for audio/video data, and these streams can be downloaded separately. However this plugin does not include the potentially bulky and computationally expensive logic to merge (mux) the audio/video files into one. Rather than including a slow (since web-browser based) muxing-implementation or a separate native "companion" application (which might be perceived as an untrustworthy security risk) this plugin relies on the user's ability to manually mux respective audio/video files using some standard native tool of his choice. Example: the "ffmpeg" command line tool performs such merging via the below command (there are other tools like mkvtoolnix that also get the job done): ffmpeg -i "in.mp4" -i "in.m4a" -c copy "out.mp4" While activated, HLS Video Download tries to detect video streams by monitoring all the files loaded by the browser: To avoid this overhead it may be a good idea to use the extension's 'Turn off' button while not downloading video streams (this will not stop downloads that are already in progress). Postprocessing: The downloaded videos might still use original MPEG-transport-stream packets - which may lead to audio-stuttering in a regular video player and cause glitches while seeking. To easily fix these type of issues the affected files should be post-processed using a separate tool like ffmpeg -i "concat:in.mp4" -c copy "out.mp4". YouTube: While the plugin had originally allowed to also download Youtube videos, changes that Youtube has meanwhile made on its platform have broken that functionality (as of 2026) and the plugin no longer seems to detect respective videos. Since there are already plenty alternatives available to download Youtube videos it just isn't worth the maintenance effort to fix the plugin every time Youtube updates its anti-download measures. As for the media streams on other pages, the plugin just replays the requests performed by the original player. This means that the exact same stream/quality setting is selected. Sometimes respective higher quality streams use separate files for video and audio and these are downloaded unchanged (see above comments on "muxing"). For separate audio/video streams HLS Video Download here will generate/download a separate ".bat" script (same name as the stream) for each affected stream: That script then contains the "ffmpeg" based one-line command which can be easily verified by opening it in an arbitrary text editor. As long as "ffmpeg" is installed on your machine (and the excutable is on your search path) you can just double click on the respective .bat files in your download-folder to "merge" the separated audio/video files into one file that contains both. (Caution: Duplicate file names may be causing the browser to add "(1)", "(2)", etc add-ons to the file name originally selected by the extension. The generated ".bat" script will no longer work in this case since it isn't aware of the changed name and is still using the original names.) Regional locks: Some sites limit access to users within a specific country (e.g. ARD mediathek, etc) and you may need to use a VPN plugin to fake your respective location. (After a respective unsuccessful attempt the site may remember that it had denied access before - so make sure to get rid of respective cookies before retrying with VPN.) Known limitation: The plugin does not work in Firefox's "private windows". This is due to Firefox's silly design decision to not allow background page access from a "private window" (unlike Chrome and other browsers that take a much more sensible approach in this scenario). Hints: Some video pages make extensive use of "ads" and the respective file loading may render these pages very slow. Some pages then deliberately use "anti debugging" techniques that might interfere with the "HLS video download" extension. This may result in the extension's toolbar menu not opening or opening with a considerable delay (e.g. 10secs). To deal with these kind of unusually "difficult" pages the below approach may be helpful:
  1. First make sure that the original video actually plays (with the "HLS video download" still turned off). This makes sure that the page's files are already loaded and may later be fetched much more quickly directly from the browser's cache. It also avoids any risk of "HLS video download" interfering with the respective page loading logic and whatever expectations the respective page logic might have. (Some of these pages may play a video but become otherwise so unresponsive that it becomes difficult to use the player controls or even reload the browser tab.)
  2. Copy the video tab's URL and close the browser tab.
  3. Open a new browser tab and turn the "HLS video download" extension on.
  4. Paste the URL copied in step 2 into the new tab to again load the previous video page. As soon as the video is playing (again), pause it and click on the "HLS video download" toolbar icon to check if the video has been detected. If so, click on the respective button to start the download. Close the original video page to stop it from slowing down your browser.
Some simple video streams use a redirection scheme that no longer works as soon as "HLS video download" is turned on. However "HLS video download" may actually still detect these streams and download them. You will have to "Turn off" the extension if you want to watch those videos directly within the browser. But even if those videos are not playing when the extension is on you may still want to open the toolbar menu to check if the stream is available for download. If a video stream is incomplete (e.g. individual segments referenced in the playlist are not available) "HLS video download" will usually skip those problem segments and download those segments that are available. This may lead to segments "missing" in the downloaded stream. Transient server issues may sometimes cause a download to fail and the same download may succeed when tried again later.

bluejetty:00127235:ios.name: Blackbird Classic Card Game
bluejetty:00127235:ios.summary:
Outsmart the table in Blackbird — the fast, four-player trick-taking card game where every bid is a gamble and teamwork wins the round. Play online with friends, challenge players worldwide, or take on smart AI offline.
Partner up, call yo
bluejetty:00127235:ios.description:
Outsmart the table in Blackbird — the fast, four-player trick-taking card game where every bid is a gamble and teamwork wins the round. Play online with friends, challenge players worldwide, or take on smart AI offline.
Partner up, call your trump suit, claim the Nest, and race your team to 300 points. Easy to learn, tough to master — and there's always one more hand.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE BLACKBIRD
Online multiplayer — match with players around the world in real time
Private tables — invite friends and family and play your own game
Smart AI — sharpen your skills offline, anytime, no connection needed
Pick up where you left off — resume any game, even days later
In-game chat — talk a little trash while you play
Daily rewards & a fortune wheel — spin to earn more coins
New mini-game: Black or White — pick a side and win when the special card lands
HOW TO PLAY
Blackbird is played by four players in two teams, with partners sitting opposite each other. The deck has 41 cards: four suits (Black, Green, Red, Yellow) numbered 5 to 14, plus the special Blackbird card. The Blackbird is worth 20 points, every 14 and 10 is worth 10, and every 5 is worth 5.
Each player is dealt 9 cards, with 5 set aside as the Nest. Teams bid for the points they think they can win, starting at 70 and topping out at 120. The winning bidder picks the trump suit and may swap cards with the Nest.
Play moves clockwise, starting left of the bid winner. Follow the suit that's led when you can; the highest card takes the trick, and the trick winner leads next. Take the last trick and you claim the Nest — along with any points hiding in it. Win the points you bid, and you score them; fall short, and you lose them. First team to 300 points wins.
Simple rules, real strategy, and endless rematches. Download Blackbird and deal yourself in!
Love the game? Leave a review and tell us what you'd like to see next — we read every one.

Welcome to the Wonderful World of Color Dot Connect

 Merge and Upgrade: Identical bubbles will merge into a larger bubble.
 Character Skills: Tiny crooks will use their skills over time to affect the board or eliminate bubbles.

 Robot Battles

 Friendly mini cops need you to quickly eliminate bubbles to charge up and fight the enemies.

 Addictive Game Mechanics: Connect bubbles with the same numbers, create the longest chains, and merge them for more points.

bluejetty:00088196:ios.description:
**Pass the U.S. Citizenship Test Without Falling Asleep Mid-Constitution**
So you’ve decided to become a U.S. citizen. Congratulations. Now all that stands between you and the stars and stripes is a test packed with civics questions, U.S. history, geography, and facts about holidays you’re still not sure how to pronounce. Don’t worry, we’ve got you.
EZ Prep’s U.S. Citizenship Study App is the smartest, fastest, and least boring way to prepare for the naturalization test. Whether you're at home, on a break, or studying offline in the bath (we don't judge), our app makes sure you're ready with the right answers and the history behind them.
Made in the USA by people who’ve actually taken and taught the test, this app doesn’t just drill you with flashcards. It adapts to your progress, explains what you're learning, and gives you a personalized study plan so you’re always improving, not just memorizing.
**What sets EZ Prep apart from other apps like Citizen Now?**
We didn’t outsource this. We built it right here. Our questions are up to date, fact-checked, and come with context, so when you get asked why the colonists fought the British, you’ll know it wasn’t just about tea.
**Worried about test day?**
Our Exam Simulator recreates the timing and format of the real thing so you’re not surprised by how fast it goes when you’re sitting in front of an immigration officer with sweaty palms.
Try it free with our limited version. Then go premium to unlock Bookmarks, Missed Questions, and the full Exam Simulator.
**What you'll study inside the app:**
• Your State – Customized with your current senators, congressional rep, and capital
• American Democracy
• System of Government
• Rights and Responsibilities
• Colonial Period and Independence
• The 1800s
• Recent American History
• U.S. Geography
• Symbols
• U.S. Holidays
**App features include:**
• Personalized onboarding to set study goals and quiz difficulty
• Adaptive questions that get harder as you improve
• Instant feedback with clear explanations and helpful context
• Streaks and achievements to keep you motivated
• Progress tracking and score stats so you know when you're ready
Whether you're applying for naturalization or just trying to understand what exactly happened in 1776, EZ Prep gives you the tools to learn, prepare, and pass with confidence.
Any questions, please contact us at support@eztestprep.com
Terms of Use: https://www.eztestprep.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
EZ Prep is not affiliated with USCIS or any government agency. We just help you pass their test without losing your mind over the three branches of government.

bluejetty:00149766:ios.description:
Goodself: Trusted Health Communities, Vetted Experts, Information You Can Trust 
Welcome to Goodself, your trusted space to learn, ask questions, and feel confident navigating your health. 
Whether you're curious about nutrition, managing a chronic condition, starting a new medication, or just looking for trusted health answers, Goodself connects you with vetted experts, supportive communities, and credible resources to help you learn, connect, and take action. 
Traditional patient education is outdated. Static handouts and one-off doctor visits don't provide ongoing support. And mainstream social media, where most people now turn for health information, often fuels misinformation and stigma. Goodself brings together real experts, real people, and real conversations in one safe, stigma-free space. From hormones and cardiovascular health to diabetes, menopause, gut health, nutrition, sleep, mental health, and more, Goodself covers the full spectrum of health and wellness. Whatever your goals, you'll find trusted resources to help you feel informed and empowered. 
What you’ll get with Goodself: 
Community Groups: Connect with people on similar health journeys in moderated, inclusive spaces, including communities for conditions that often go underdiscussed, from perimenopause and PMDD to ADHD in women, endometriosis, POTS, and more. Never feel alone navigating your health. 
Personalized Pathways: Follow guided programs tailored to your conditions and goals, so you always know where to start. 
Live Expert-led Talks: Join live, interactive sessions with healthcare professionals. Ask questions in real time or watch anytime on demand. 
Curated Feed: Learn from videos, photos, and posts from experts and peers sharing insights and experiences. 
Expert-led Video Q&A Library: Search a growing collection of short video answers from experts on everyday health questions. 
Self-Paced Courses: Build your health knowledge and confidence at your own pace. 
Topics you’ll find inside: 
Diabetes | Hormones | Menopause | Perimenopause | PMDD | PCOS | Thyroid | ADHD in women | Gut health & digestion | IBS | Interstitial cystitis | Endometriosis | Adenomyosis | Women's health | Reproductive health & fertility | POTS | Chronic pain | Weight loss & weight management | Healthy aging | Medications & treatment options | Nutrition & healthy eating | Fitness & workouts | Sleep & insomnia | Stress & anxiety | Depression | Mental health | Heart health & blood pressure | Cholesterol 
Goodself makes it easy to find trusted health answers from vetted experts, connect with others, and feel supported on your health journey, whatever that looks like for you.

bluejetty:00120513:ios.description:
Practice and improve your math skills with Mental Math Trainer Games - Pure Math.
Play and practice just a few minutes a day and keep your mind sharp. Great brain training for you to increase your confidence and speed at mental math.
No matter if it's addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, we guarantee you hours of practice with Mental Math Trainer Games - Pure Math. And every time you play it's a different experience. Questions are always random. Great way to train and learn math.
With its increasing difficulty, Mental Math Addition Games - Pure Math is suitable for all ages - kids, students, adults. Pure practice and learning. We store your progress, so you can continue where you left. The faster you answer the questions, the more points you get. 
In Math Arcade mode you get to complete math levels with increasing difficulty starting from the most basic tasks. The levels are divided into 5 main categories - Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, and Mixed Mode.
Math Practice mode in Mental Math Addition Games - Pure Math allows you to create custom practice sessions depending on the operations you wish to train. You can also select custom practice duration, difficulty level, and custom numbers. Math games where you solve math problems and a great way to give your brain a workout and improve your cognitive function.
Learning math tables has never been easier. Play Math Tables, repeat a few times a day, and train your memory. Multiplication tables, times tables, brain games, addition games, and more.
Find the Pairs (Math Cards) is a math game where you match math cards by number or color until you find all pairs and clear the board. Cool math game to train your memory. 
Mental Math Addition Games - Pure Math supports Game Center, so you can compare your score to your friends' and even challenge them to see who's doing better in Math.
Some levels in the app are free to play and you can unlock all features and levels (1200+) by upgrading to PRO.

bluejetty:00187300:ios.description:
Branded to YOUR COMPANY and Powered by RapidFunnel, this App is changing everything. 
The RapidFunnel App engages your audience and your team of people; building business and MRR easier than any method you’ve used before. 
Our Authentic Sharing Technology (AST) is the perfect choice for network marketing teams. We keep the fundamentals of network marketing and support them with world-class technology.
The App is a self-contained, powerhouse that allows people to carry out professional business activities anywhere, right from their mobile device. Fill the library with company resources (audio, video, PDFs and more) then share them seamlessly across social media, email or text.
All communications stay within a private loop that sends valuable content out to contacts, then notifies the user in real-time when their contact engages with what was sent, for the simplest follow-up ever. Technology can’t automate a relationship but AST does help grow them, with less work from you!
The App is easy and comfortable to use, with built in gamification features that add excitement. No need to be a salesperson or digital marketing expert, your people just need to download the App, connect and share information. 
Our intelligent, real time analytics deliver the visible answers you need to hone in on what’s working (or not) and nail your messaging. Keeping more of your own data will also give your business more power within your industry.
The RapidFunnel App guides everyone through your exact winning process for sharing the company story, delivering massive growth. Find out what Authentic Sharing Technology, Powered by RapidFunnel can do for your business!

bluejetty:00160732:ios.description:
We know that renting an apartment can be stressful. We make it a breeze with the HotPads home and apartment finder app! Peruse the largest collection of available homes for rent and real estate in the U.S. Whether you’re looking for place in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Denver, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Boston, Washington D.C., Atlanta, or Miami, we’ve got the places you want and you can search for them on-the-go. Our rental search team of wizards work their magic 24/7 to provide the most accurate and up-to-date rental listings just for you. Quickly contact landlords, gawk property photos, explore area stats, and save as many favs to your Favorites as you like.
Some of Our Splendid Apartment Search Features
- Search Alerts: No need to constantly check up on new apartment or house rentals. Name your price on quintessential neighborhoods and our search alerts will notify you when new rentals are listed!
- Share Listings: Sharing is caring! Show off cool homes you’ve found with all of your friends (don’t be shy!).
- Advance Filters: Fiddle with the filters to find senior housing communities in Miami for grandma, student housing for your high school graduate in Austin, or cheap low-income restricted houses in Atlanta. Our filters allow you to find homes tailor-made to your exact needs.
- Listing Views: Enjoy the view? Choose between our List View, Map View, or Hybrid View to make your way home easier and faster.
Let’s get you home, today!
What our users are saying:
"I've moved a lot in the last 5 years in Chicago and I always come back to HotPads. Great app!"
“My lease will be up in a few months and this app has been very helpful in assisting me find a new place in whatever area of metro-Atlanta I want!”
“ HotPads app has been very helpful in my search for a new home rental. I actually appreciated the email updates when something was listed that matched my search criteria.”
“HotPads pulls up many more apartments that fit my preferences and budget than any other apartment search engine I have tried. I love this app.”
“Makes finding a apartment rental simple and easy in Los Angeles area. Great apps like this are hard to find!”
“Such better listings than Craigslist. Clean and easy to use! Direct contact to agents is also a plus!”

bluejetty:00077225:ios.name: Club Active
bluejetty:00077225:ios.summary:
THE CLUB ACTIVE APP helps you change the way you age and get the most out of your wellbeing as you move into your later years.
Completely redesigned look and feel with three areas:
FACILITY: Discover all the services that your facility prov
bluejetty:00077225:ios.description:
THE CLUB ACTIVE APP helps you change the way you age and get the most out of your wellbeing as you move into your later years.
Completely redesigned look and feel with three areas:
FACILITY: Discover all the services that your facility provides and choose what interests you most. 
MY MOVEMENT: What you’ve chosen to do: here you will find your programme, classes you’ve booked and and all the other activities you’ve chosen to do at your facility
RESULTS: Check your results and monitor your progress.
Get moving with the Club Active App collect MOVEs, and get more and more active every day. 
Always enjoy our programs from our fully qualified staff to enhance your experience in our tailored facilities using The Club Active App to connect to the equipment with Bluetooth or QR Code. The equipment will automatically set up with your program and your results will be automatically tracked on your mywellness account.
Log MOVEs manually or sync with other apps such as Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin, MapMyFitness, MyFitnessPal, Polar, RunKeeper, Strava, Swimtag and Withings.
---------------------------------
WHY USE THE CLUB ACTIVE APP?
YOUR FACILITY CONTENTS AT A GLANCE: Discover in the FACILITY AREA of the app all the programmes, classes and challenges that your facility promotes
A HAND ON VIRTUAL COACH THAT GUIDES YOU IN THE WORKOUT: Easily choose the program you want to do today in MY MOVEMENT page and let the app guide you through the PROGRAM: the app automatically moves to next exercise and gives you the possibility to rate your experience and schedule your next program.
PROGRAMME: get your personalized and complete training program including cardio, strength, classes and all types of activities; access all exercise instructions and videos; keep track of your results automatically by signing in to mywellness directly on Technogym equipment, wherever you are in the world
A SUPERIOR CLASSES EXPERIENCE: Use THE CLUB ACTIVE APP to easily find the classes of your interest and book a spot. You will receive smart reminders to help you not to forget your appointment.
OUTDOOR ACTIVITY: keep track of your outdoor activities directly via the CLUB ACTIVE APP or automatically synchronise the data you have stored in other applications such as Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin, MapMyFitness, MyFitnessPal, Polar, RunKeeper, Strava, Swimtag and Withings.
BODY MEASUREMENTS: keep track of your measurements (weight, body fat, etc..) and check your progress over time.

Aprenda a faturar na internet com quem já trilhou esse caminho! Letícia Vaz é referência em empreendedorismo digital e vai te ensinar, de forma leve, prática e rápida, a como realizar o sonho de transformar seu negócio.
Elaborado por um ti
bluejetty:00154937:ios.description:
Aprenda a faturar na internet com quem já trilhou esse caminho! Letícia Vaz é referência em empreendedorismo digital e vai te ensinar, de forma leve, prática e rápida, a como realizar o sonho de transformar seu negócio.
Elaborado por um time de especialistas de confiança da Lê, o conteúdo vai te ensinar a surfar nesse novo e (ainda) desconhecido mundo online por meio de vídeo aulas, workshops, discussões em comunidades, palestras e podcasts, que podem ser baixados para assistir e ouvir onde e quando quiser.
Quem é Letícia Vaz?
Letícia Vaz é uma das maiores referências de moda, influência e marketing digital do país. A empresária criou sua marca de roupas, a LV Store, em 2015, com um investimento inicial de R$ 500 e duas máquinas de costura. Na época, cursava a faculdade de jornalismo e viu no e-commerce uma oportunidade de renda extra, mas não imaginava a proporção que o negócio tomaria.
A LV Store conta com 60 colaboradores e fatura mais de R$ 10 milhões por ano. Tudo isso depois dela apostar em vídeos de redes sociais e conteúdo interativo no site, aumentando em 300% a retenção e em 2,5 vezes a taxa de conversão.
Por isso, Letícia Vaz se tornou referência em empreendedorismo online, sendo notícia em veículos como a Forbes, Exame, Folha de S. Paulo e Pequenas Empresas, Grandes Negócios. Com uma das marcas independentes mais amadas pelo público, já ofereceu aulas, consultoria e mentoria para mais de mil empreendedores pelo Brasil. Agora é a sua hora!
Por que baixar?
Com o app da Letícia Vaz, você terá acesso a todas as vantagens oferecidas por uma das maiores referências de empreendedorismo do país.
-Acesso a comunidade de empreendedores e networking
-Conteúdos leves e eficazes
-Materiais desenhados por especialistas
-Acesso fácil ao suporte e time de dúvidas
-Veja e ouça quando puder e quiser
-O download é grátis
-Notificações com acesso às nossas lives exclusivas com transmissão dentro do aplicativo

bluejetty:00120669:ios.summary:
Do you want to play a fun game full of unique mechanics and which will help you boost your math learning fast and easy? Toon Math is here to help you enjoy a cool math experience that will complement the lessons you learn at school.
In thi
bluejetty:00120669:ios.description:
Do you want to play a fun game full of unique mechanics and which will help you boost your math learning fast and easy? Toon Math is here to help you enjoy a cool math experience that will complement the lessons you learn at school.
In this game all your friends are kidnapped and they are taken to the Halloween Town. What you have to do now is to make sure that you save them before midnight. Otherwise, they will turn to scarecrows! Become the ultimate math ninja, try to eliminate all the enemies in front of you and take your gameplay experience to the next level!
This cool math game is about testing your skills and improving them. The player gets to become the ultimate math ninja and he will continually run and solve various math challenges. It is suitable for any grade, and it’s a wonderful educational game that you do not want to miss.
The gameplay is very immersive and it provides you with an extraordinary set of challenges. Moreover, the game tests you how fast you are, since everything will end up before midnight and you have to avoid all of that. Thankfully, since this is a game for almost each grade, each player can play at his own pace.
You will be able to unlock new characters and each one of the enemies and characters are very cute.
Your team can level up its spells and take things to the next level in no time. This makes the gameplay a lot more impressive and everyone can feel like a math ninja as he/she beat the monster in front of them. Since you have to run all the time, the gameplay is very easy to get into and it’s just a whole lot of fun to explore everything in here. It’s just an incredible opportunity and a very enticing experience that becomes better and more educational as you play to become a math ninja.
That’s great for parents and teachers which want to teach how to count, divide, subtract or add numbers. The entire game is very educational and you will be very impressed with the quality and value delivered here. Just give this cool math app a shot right now, download Toon Math and fall in love with math!

You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.

bluejetty:00086135:ios.description:
Case Royale is a multiplayer case simulator and case opener. Open cases, collect weapon skins, inspect items in 3D and build your in-game inventory.
OPEN MORE THAN 120 CASES
Explore more than 120 cases inspired by modern and classic weapon collections. Discover weapon skins, knives, gloves and other rare items with different rarity levels.
REAL-TIME CASE OPENER
Open cases in real time and watch every item drop. Discover new skins, expand your collection and continue building your inventory.
BUILD YOUR INVENTORY
Collect weapon skins and create the inventory you want. Manage your items, discover rare additions and grow your collection with every case opening.
INSPECT ITEMS IN 3D
View collected weapon skins in detailed 3D. Rotate guns, knives and gloves, examine their designs and manage all your items from one inventory.
MULTIPLAYER CASE SIMULATOR
Case Royale is more than a single-player case opener. Play online mini-games with other users, compare inventories and participate in multiplayer activities.
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER MODES
Use your collection in interactive online mini-games. Explore different modes, compare your results with other players and continue developing your inventory.
UPGRADE CONTRACTS
Combine duplicate or unwanted items through the contract system and receive a skin of a higher rarity. Use extra items to improve your collection and continue progressing.
CLANS AND TOURNAMENTS
Create your own clan or join an existing one. Complete clan quests, increase your clan level and participate in tournaments with other members.
RANKINGS AND PROGRESSION
Earn experience, improve your inventory and climb global leaderboards. Compare your progress with other players by account level, inventory value and other statistics.
PLAYER PROFILES AND CHAT
View player profiles, explore inventories and communicate through the in-game chat. Share your latest case opening results and discuss collections with the community.
CLICKER EVENTS AND MINI-GAMES
Take part in additional mini-games and limited-time activities. Complete objectives, earn in-game rewards and unlock more ways to develop your inventory.
REGULAR UPDATES
New cases, collections, events and gameplay improvements are added regularly. Keep opening cases and expanding your collection as new content becomes available.
MAIN FEATURES
• Multiplayer case simulator
• Real-time case opener
• More than 120 cases and collections
• Weapon skins, knives and gloves
• Detailed 3D item inspection
• Online multiplayer modes
• Upgrade contracts
• Clans, quests and tournaments
• Global rankings and player profiles
• Community chat
• Clicker events and mini-games
• Regular content updates
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Case Royale is an independent case simulator and is not affiliated with Valve Corporation or Counter-Strike.
All cases, skins, currencies and other items exist only inside the application. They have no real-world monetary value and cannot be sold, traded, transferred or withdrawn outside the application.
This application is intended only for users who meet the minimum age requirements established by the laws of their country or region.
Privacy Policy: https://caseroyale.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://caseroyale.com/terms

bluejetty:00070675:ios.description:
Dino Bubble Sorting Puzzle is a fun and relaxing time-killing game. Just tap the balls and switch the same balls to tubes and make them sort correctly. It's easy to learn with endless challenges.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Tap any tubes to pick a ball
- Put it into a tube that contains the same color ball on the top of the tube that has enough space, or an empty tube.
- Stack all the balls with the same color into a single tube.
- Try not to get stuck! But you can undo the ball move by using the back function or restart the level anytime you want.
- Don’t forget you also can add an empty bubble tube to make the game easier 
FEATURES
- Easy to play but hard enough to exercise your brain
- One finger control.
- Thousands of levels, can you pass all of them?
- New themes and background skin.
- NO penalties & time limits; you can enjoy the ball sort puzzle anywhere you want.
- All offline, no need for connection! Free for download!
- Suitable for all ages. Let's share this bubble sorting game with your friends and your family members to have a good time with them.

You will enjoy the whole day long by playing this ball sorting color match game. Hopefully, Dino bubble sorting puzzle game will make your day become more interesting and colorful.

bluejetty:00092297:ios.summary: This app remotely controls "Wireless Sensor Tags" cloud temperature/humidity/motion recording, monitoring and lost-item-finder device. Use it to make each tag beep (helps find lost items) and receive push notifications when each tag detects
bluejetty:00092297:ios.description:
This app remotely controls "Wireless Sensor Tags" cloud temperature/humidity/motion recording, monitoring and lost-item-finder device. Use it to make each tag beep (helps find lost items) and receive push notifications when each tag detects motion, door/window open/close, water presence, temperature or humidity exceeding normal range. Cloud-record temperature and humidity graphs, view them anywhere with Internet, and get notified when temperature or humidity exceeds user defined normal range.
"Wireless Sensor Tags" are integrated with WeMo switches/LEDs, various Internet-connected thermostats and IFTTT. Multiple "KumoApp" automation scripts can be written from web interface and configured inside the app to allow automated rules using information from Tags sensor data, chosen phones location data, and more, to trigger WeMo devices and thermostats. 
Disclaimer: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This applies only if you install and enable KumoApp automation scripts that use/monitor your phone's location.

bluejetty:00075859:ios.description:
[Plot Introduction of Dungeon Survivor III]
On the eve of the catastrophe, a sinister red moon appeared in the sky above Akyum. Unbeknownst to the people, the whispers of the Soul Eaters were already emanating from the thick fog. The ancient dragon's fury destroyed the city walls, and soulless demons lunged at all life. The unyielding Wild Souls, wandering on the edge of the darkest abyss, await the opportunity to reverse their fate.
The Necromancer (played by you), once exiled to the ends of the world for touching the forbidden soul arts, is awakened. He roams the apocalyptic world under the red moon, seeking souls that have not yet dissipated, forming contracts and partnerships with them, embarking on a journey to uncover the truth. His origins, the secrets of the soul, the truth behind the red moon—all are as mysterious as an underground labyrinth.
[Main Characters of Dungeon Survivor III]
Necromancer (played by you) / Ice Curse / Navigator / Morning Star / Nightingale / Shadow Mage / Sword of Courage / Earthshaking Vanguard / Dawn Judgment / Song of Eternal Hope 
[Features of Dungeon Survivor III]
• Enjoy Hand-drawn Live2D
Dynamic character portraits offer you a seductive real interaction. The painstakingly hand-drawn details present you with unique appearances, all to break the boundaries between reality and virtual, giving you an immersive experience within reach!
• Acquire Goddess Effortlessly
Idling not only yields resources but also goddesses! Idle to draw characters, and even choose specific job pools to easily collect your favorite goddesses. With the help of goddess statues, you can claim generous rewards with one click, saying goodbye to grinding in games!
• Surviving Amidst Mysteries
Warlocks, dragons, goblins, airships... In a world of magic and machinery, who will stand out? Time, soul, temples, abyss... In the fog of history and darkness, who is whispering? Awakening from the mysterious, you open your eyes to behold this world.
• Explore Random Mazes
Each level of the endless Cave in the Arcane Realm is full of unknown random events. Can you make it out alive before the golden lantern goes out?
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DungeonSurvivor3EN
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/TryPqdNdv7
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@LunarGames888

bluejetty:00023915:ios.summary:

Whether you’re a fan of classic crossword games or just looking for a relaxing word
bluejetty:00023915:ios.description:
Sharpen your mind with Word Crush crossword puzzles! Get ready for a thrilling word adventure with Word Crush, where fun, challenge, and relaxation await.
Whether you’re a fan of classic crossword games or just looking for a relaxing word board game, Word Crush has something for everyone. With over 18,000 levels, exciting mini-games, and exclusive events beyond just word matching and word crushing, the adventure never ends! Improve your vocabulary, sharpen your word skills, and enjoy the ultimate word search puzzle experience in a leisurely environment.
Highlights
- Over 18,000 Classic Word Puzzle Levels to Explore 
Word Crush features a vast collection of over 18,000 levels, each designed with increasing difficulty to keep you engaged. As you progress, you’ll face tougher challenges that will test your vocabulary, spelling, and brainpower. Whether you're a crossword enthusiast, a Scrabble and NYT games fan, or a casual player, there’s always a new level to conquer!
- Fun, Fresh Challenges Beyond Crushing Words!
Search, connect, swipe letters, and crush words to uncover hidden words at each level. Perfect for casual play or pushing yourself! Take a break from traditional board and word puzzle games with mini-games like matching tiles, sorting jams, and unscrewing nuts to sharpen your mind. Enjoy crushing words and candy in Sugar Mine for a word blast experience. Climbing and claiming surprises, filling your festive bingo board for rewards, and collecting themed cards & portraits in special events to unlock exclusive prizes!
- Daily Challenges & Seasonal Events
Stay excited with fresh daily challenges, special seasonal events, and festive celebrations for occasions like Valentine's Day and Easter. Each seasonal event brings unique themes, rewards, and themed word puzzles, adding extra fun to your word puzzle-solving experience and ensuring there’s always something new to enjoy!
Key Features 
- Simple and easy-to-play board crossword game! Swipe and connect letters to form words in the crossword puzzle. 
- Enjoy classic word puzzles where correct answers cause letter blocks to cascade down. 
- Challenge yourself with thousands of fun word crush puzzle games and become the top word master in a 3D puzzle scramble filled with crossed letters! 
- Each level features beautiful nature scenes, gently transporting you to a different world. 
- No Wi-Fi is required; play offline anytime, anywhere! 
- Entertain friends and family with this exciting word puzzle game, Blooms. Finding words together is just as fun as playing solo! 
- Expand your vocabulary and improve your word skills! This crossword puzzle connection starts easy but quickly becomes challenging! Challenge to train your word brain!
- New puzzles are released weekly, bringing endless fun!
Contact us: WordCrushFeedback@gmail.com
Follow our page: https://www.facebook.com/Word-Crush-Fun-Puzzle-Game-1093451577491452/

bluejetty:00000021:android.description:
Thousands of digital books to read wherever and however you want, in addition to a wide range of cultural activities to inspire your library, such as reading clubs, training activities and much more. This is BibliON. The public digital library of the state of São Paulo, which connects you with the world of reading and knowledge.
Access a diverse collection that is constantly updated with over 17,000 titles, including general literature, romance, children's fiction and, for teenagers, poetry, biography, fantasy, philosophy, suspense and many other genres. Social sciences, humanities, health and many other areas of knowledge are also part of the collection. All this in digital books (e-books) and audiobooks to read and listen to whenever and wherever you want.
BibliON also has a diverse program of cultural and training activities to support its library. There are reading clubs, podcasts, seminars, training, reading workshops and much more. Everything online.
Just a click away, BibliON brings knowledge and culture to your everyday life with your favorite books and study books at work, in college, on the means of transport or wherever you want. Download now!
- Fully digital
- Handpicked books with expert curation
- Possibility of reading without using data from your cell phone with previous download of the title
- Smart search with different filters to find the perfect book for you: by topic, by author, by title, and much more
- Reading clubs, podcasts, seminars, training, reading workshops and many other cultural and training activities
- Books in several languages
- Text size adjustment and page view
- New titles constantly added to the platform
- Audiobooks
- Monitoring, history and statistics of your time dedicated to reading
- Dedicated space for you to participate in challenges
BibliON is an initiative of the Government of the State of São Paulo, through the Secretary of Culture, Economy and Creative Industry of the State of São Paulo, with the realization and management of SP Readings.

bluejetty:00146658:ios.description:

Manage Multiple Tide Stations: Add and switch between numerous tide stations worldwide with ease.
Monthly Tide Tables: View comprehensive, color-coded monthly tide charts for effortless planning.

Offline Access: Enjoy uninterrupted service with data cached locally for extended offline use after the initial download.
Customizable Units: Choose between imperial or metric units to match your preference.
Ad-Free Upgrade: Opt for an ad-free experience anytime for uninterrupted usage.

Designed with simplicity and user-friendliness in mind, TideClock's intuitive interface and easy-to-read tide clock make staying informed about tidal movements a breeze. It's the perfect tool for boating, fishing, surfing, sailing, and all your favorite beach and water sports activities.

bluejetty:00028021:ios.description:
FUJIFILM XApp is an app. provided by Fujifilm Corporation. Once users pair a Fujifilm digital camera with their smartphone or tablet via Bluetooth®, they can transfer captured images and movies to their smartphone or tablet, control the camera remotely, backup and restore camera settings, synchronize date, time, and location, and update firmware.
The Wi-Fi function of smartphones or tablets is also used for transferring captured images and videos, and updating firmware.
In addition, by signing in to Fujifilm's network service, daily shooting activities using the camera can be automatically summarized in a diary format.
This service is useful for reviewing their photographic activities and improving their photographic skills.
[Compatible Cameras]
Please refer to the URL below:
https://fujifilm-x.com/support/compatibility/software/xapp/
Please upgrade the camera with the latest firmware.
Please refer to the URL below to download the firmware:
https://fujifilm-x.com/support/download/firmware/cameras/
[Compatible OS]
Please refer to the URL below:
https://fujifilm-x.com/support/compatibility/software/xapp/
[Supported languages]
English(US), English(UK), Japanese/日本語, French/Français, German/Deutsch, Spanish/Español, Italian/Italiano, Turkish/Türkçe, Simplified Chinese/中文简, Russian/Русский, Korean/한국, Thai/ไทย, Indonesian/Bahasa Indonesia
[Note]
The FUJIFILM XApp uses the GPS function of the smartphone/tablet continuously in the background, which may consume a large amount of battery power in your smartphone/tablet.
To reduce battery consumption, please go to "Settings" of FUJIFILM XApp and set the "Location synchronization interval" to a longer interval.

For detailed operations, please refer to the "Guide" found within this app.

Night Light is a collection of customizable calming videos with relaxing background deep sleep sounds. 
It helps you sleep, relax, meditate, focus or create vibes around. 
Night Light provides adjustable relaxing videos coming with ambient calming sounds for healthy sleep and rest. The app enables setting up the phone brightness for any nightlight to the lowest or highest level possible. The in-built countdown timer helps you develop deep sleep habits.
The beautiful nightlight animations can be used both by adults and as a baby night light. Simply choose any calming video according to your needs.
The nightlight app videos are designed to help you:
- Sleep, relax, meditate, focus.
- Beat insomnia (calming deep sleep sounds).
- Calm with relaxing sounds in all videos.
- Unfear darkness with a night light.
- Use baby nightlight and sleep sounds.
- Create vibes and moods thanks to relaxing sounds.
Night Light most popular animations include fireplace, candle, thunderstorm, lava lamp, baby night light, rain and aquarium. But there's more and we add new videos with every update. You can personalize all nightlight videos by setting up the candle flame size, fireplace intensiveness, lava lamp color, and other parameters. You can even adjust all the relaxing sounds to calm or deep sleep.
Night Light works on most devices and can be used as a screensaver on your TV or phone. You can put it on while charging the phone too.
Many people use Night Light on the phone for resting and distracting from stressful scrolling addiction. It takes your anxiety and stress away, while you are just chilling and listening to calming sounds and watching the relaxing videos. 
Night Light is not only for relaxing though. It also helps you focus or create the vibe you need around at specific moments. You can easily create the mood with our calming videos, while the relaxing sounds will make it more romantic (or how you need it).
All our calming adult and baby night light videos and deep sleep sounds are adjustable. You can use your mood to customise video and relaxing sounds intensity, colour, animation and volume according to how you feel. In-built sleep countdown timer allows you to use the app for going to bed.
Our top 6 videos are:
- Calming videos of a fireplace with fire's relaxing sounds.
- Relaxing video of a candle.
- Chilling thunder with nature sleep sounds.
- Personalised colourful night light.
- Lava lamp with ambient calming sounds.
- Baby nightlight for healthy children's sleep.
Make sure to check for updates to ensure you have the whole Night Light collection, as we add new animations with almost every new update.
We wish to give you the best experience with our adult and baby night light and deep sleep sounds app. Hope it will help you sleep, relax, meditate, focus and read. By the way, we will be grateful for your feedback on how to improve our app. Just email us or leave a review with a comment!

bluejetty:00015224:ios.description:
FastMath – Scan, Solve, Study & Ask
FastMath turns your camera into a powerful AI math solver, study companion and homework helper.
FastMath 3.x represents a new generation of FastMath, completely rebuilt and far beyond the experience of earlier 2.x and 1.x versions. The app now combines high-accuracy math solving, improved question detection, full-page worksheet scanning, multi-question solving, step-by-step explanations, and AI follow-up questions in one fast and organized workflow.
Take a photo of a single math problem or scan an entire worksheet. FastMath detects the questions, solves them together, and presents the answers clearly so you can review the whole page without scanning problems one by one.
FastMath is built for high-accuracy math solving, with improved detection, stronger reasoning, more reliable answers, and clearer step-by-step explanations across a wide range of math problems.
Need more than just the answer? Open any question to explore a detailed solution, understand how the result was reached, and ask AI follow-up questions whenever something is unclear.
SCAN AN ENTIRE WORKSHEET
Capture a full worksheet, homework page, or practice sheet in one shot. FastMath can detect multiple math questions from the same image and process them together.
SOLVE MULTIPLE QUESTIONS AT ONCE
Stop scanning one problem at a time. FastMath identifies the questions on the page and gives you organized answers in one streamlined workflow.
HIGH-ACCURACY AI MATH SOLVING
FastMath is designed to provide accurate and reliable solutions with improved question recognition and advanced AI reasoning.
STEP-BY-STEP SOLUTIONS
Select any problem to view detailed solution steps. Follow the reasoning and understand how the answer was reached instead of seeing only the final result.
ASK AI ABOUT ANY STEP
Have a question about a specific part of the solution? Ask a follow-up question and get an additional explanation directly inside FastMath.
BUILT FOR STUDY
FastMath is more than an answer scanner. Use it to check homework, review practice problems, understand difficult concepts, prepare for exams, and study more efficiently.
ORGANIZED QUESTION CARDS
Each detected problem is organized into its own clear card, making it easy to move between questions, answers, and detailed solutions.
EXPORT SOLUTIONS TO PDF
Select the solutions you need and export them as a clean PDF for studying, saving, reviewing, or sharing.
 FEATURES
• Full-page worksheet scanning
• Multiple-question detection
• High-accuracy AI math solving
• Instant answers
• Step-by-step explanations
• AI follow-up questions
• Homework and study support
• Individual question selection
• Organized question cards
• PDF export
• Support for printed math problems
• Support for handwritten math problems
• Fast camera-based workflow
Whether you are checking your homework, studying for a test, reviewing a worksheet, or trying to understand a difficult math problem, FastMath helps you move from question → answer → explanation → understanding in one place.
FastMath has been redesigned around accuracy, speed, clarity, and learning, giving you a smarter way to scan, solve, study, and understand math.
Some features require a FastMath Pro subscription. Subscription options and prices are displayed in the app before purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription from your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00014810:ios.summary:
