bluejetty:00014810:ios.description:
Did you lose track of your time again? We can help. With a single tap, track and save your time with Toggl Track — anywhere you go.
Toggl Track has you covered across all of your devices. Start tracking your hours in a browser, then stop it later on your phone or on your Apple Watch. All your tracked time is safely synced between your iPhone, Watch, desktop, and browser.
Is the app FREE?
Yes, Toggl Track on iOS is completely free for you to use.
---
FEATURES:
• Reports
Discover what's taking up your time and get a snapshot of your day or week with Reports. Analyze your Reports in the app or export them to send the data to your clients (or analyze them further on our web app to see where your hours are going).
• Sync
Keeps your time seamlessly synced, safely saved, and ready to track on your account, on any device.
• Customize your time entries with projects, clients, and tags
Organize and add more details to your time entries by adding projects, clients, and tags. See exactly where your work hours are going.
• Calendar
Instantly create time entries based on your calendar events! Connect your calendar app to Toggl Track to see all of your calendar events and time entries in the app itself.
• Pomodoro mode
Enjoy better focus and productivity by trying out the Pomodoro technique with our Pomodoro mode. Automatically track your time in 25-minute increments, with notifications, a full screen mode, and countdown timer to really help you stay focused and on task.
• Suggestions
The more you track, the better the data. The app will give you suggested time entries based on your tracking habits and previous time entries.
• Shortcuts
Use @ and # to quickly add projects and tags to time entries you track.
• Auto-complete
Easily find your older time entries and track time on them again.
• Manual Mode
Want more control? Add and edit all of your tracked time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for.
• Siri
Toggl Track is compatible with Siri! Track a new time entry, stop it, or access your reports — all that with just a few words.
• iOS Widgets
Start (and stop) tracking from your iPhone Home Screen.
• What if I'm offline?
No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync seamlessly with your account (and the rest of your devices). Your time is not going anywhere.
---
Yep, that's Toggl Track — a time tracking app so simple that you'll actually use it and get stuff done! See where your time goes, focus on important tasks, and boost your productivity. Whether you’re in an office or en route to one, stuck on a space mission to Mars, or just want to see how much time you're wasting on projects that aren't bringing you money — track your time anywhere you go.

AUTOMATIC T
bluejetty:00037350:ios.description:
A parental control app designed for parents!
We all secretly know it. Studies show that too much screen time for children can have many negative effects. We help parents and families get a grip on the issue of kids and phones.
AUTOMATIC TIME LIMITS
Now your child is shown the “5 more minutes please” beforehand. With a suggested or custom daily time limit, you can teach your child time management while maintaining a healthy screen time balance.
AUTOMATICALLY A SAFE INTERNET
Over 5 million websites are automatically filtered for you. As soon as your child tries to access an inappropriate site, we redirect them to a safe site and notify you. Ohana also adjusts search engines to only display child-friendly content.
LOCKED, STUDY or LEISURE
These are our modes that you can set the phone to with just one tap. Apps are then automatically locked and tidying up the room becomes the most important thing after all.
PHONE OFF FOR BEDTIME
Automatic schedules help to put the phone into locked or study mode at certain times. Apps that are not allowed can simply no longer be opened. This way, a restful night is automatically integrated into everyday life.
NEW INSIGHTS EVERY WEEK
You get a brief overview of what happened last week and can easily find out about new apps. Comparison values with other kids help you to evaluate your child.
WORKS BETWEEN ALL DEVICES
Ohana transcends device boundaries and supports different platforms. As a parent on a different platform, you can still control and enjoy all functions independently.
LOCATION SAFETY FEATURE
Some parents want an extra layer of protection in real life. Therefore, we offer a safety feature that allows parents and children to transparently share their location within the family. The function is optional to prevent any potential misuse.
SECURITY & PRIVACY
The security and privacy of parents and children are most important to us. We do not sell your data to third parties. Your data belongs to you and is securely encrypted.
TRY IT OUT FOR FREE
Download the app now and help your child manage their own devices!
For any questions, contact us at support@ohana.app.

bluejetty:00088298:ios.description:
Labeled Food Scanner — Discover Healthy for Less
* Scan any barcode and see what’s really inside your food.
* Or browse products from up to 55 US retailers at once and discover healthier foods for less.
Labeled answers the two questions you ask in every grocery aisle: Is this actually good for me, and where can I buy it for less?
SCAN FOODS, SEE WHAT’S INSIDE
Point your camera at a barcode — or scan the label directly — and get an instant breakdown of ingredients, additives, allergens and nutrition. No typing, no guessing.
INGREDIENT SCORE: A, B OR C
Every product gets a clear ingredient grade. A means the ingredients are considered low concern. C means the product may contain ingredients with significant health concerns.
Tap any concern to see which ingredient triggered it and why.
REAL SCIENCE BEHIND EVERY GRADE
Every ingredient score is backed by research and references from trusted health authorities. Open the sources yourself and see the evidence behind each assessment, including FDA, EFSA, WHO, ECHA, CDC, NIH, EPA, NTP, IARC, OEHHA, AICR and FAO.
NUTRITION INSIGHTS BUILT FOR YOU
See a nutrition score out of 100, a fullness (satiety) reading, estimated blood-sugar impact, and quick checks such as no trans fat, low sodium and low cholesterol.
You can even see how many minutes of walking, running or lifting it takes to burn off a serving.
SPOT ALLERGENS IN SECONDS
Peanuts, soy, dairy, gluten and more are highlighted directly in the ingredient list — so you can check a product in seconds instead of squinting at fine print.
COMPARE PRICES ACROSS UP TO 55 STORES
See what the same product costs across up to 55 US retailers, including Walmart, Target, Amazon, Publix, Kroger, H-E-B, Meijer, Albertsons, Safeway, ShopRite, Sam’s Club and many more.
One tap shows every available price, cheapest first.
BUILD A SMARTER GROCERY LIST
Add products to your list and Labeled calculates your total at each store — plus a Cheapest Overall option that combines stores to find the lowest possible total.
Labeled even flags products that a store doesn’t carry.
BROWSE HEALTHIER OPTIONS BY AISLE
Explore entire grocery categories with ingredient grades and prices side by side. Find a better-graded, lower-priced alternative before you buy.
TRACK YOUR SCAN HISTORY
Every scan is saved with its grade, so you can review your choices over time and re-check products with one tap.
Know what you’re eating. Know what you’re paying.
Download Labeled today and make smarter grocery choices — without paying more.

bluejetty:00160007:ios.description: أهلًا بك في تطبيق ريف العطور، وجهتك الراقيـة لاستكشاف عالم الجمال والعطور.تطبيق ريف يضم أصالة العطور العربية وفخامة الروائح العالمية ليمنحك تجربة تسوق فريدة تلبي احتياجاتك وتلامس حواسك, ستجد كل ما تبحث عنه من عطور بتركيبات فاخرة، منتجات تجميل استثنائية، وهدايا أنيقة تناسب كل المناسبات.ليش تطبيق ريف؟تنوع مُبهر: استمتع بمجموعة واسعة من العطور الفاخرة والمنتجات الجمالية تم اختيارها بعناية لتناسب جميع الأذواق.تصميم سهل وأنيق: تجربة تسوق سلسة وسريعة توفر لك الوقت والجهد.توصيل سريع وآمن: نقدّر وقتك ونسعى في توصيل طلباتك لباب بيتك بأقصى سرعة.عروض خاصة ومكافآت: استفد من الخصومات الحصرية وبرامج الولاء التي تخلي كل عملية شراء أكثر تميزًا.مستوى عالٍ من الجودة: نضمن لك منتجات أصلية 100% تلبي أعلى معايير الجودة.في ريف العطور، نحن لا نبيع المنتجات فقط؛ بل نقدم تجربة كل رائحة تحمل ذكرى، كل منتج يروي حكاية، وكل هدية تعبّر عن حبك واهتمامك.انطلق في رحلة فريدة تتحول فيها العطور إلى لغة تتحدث عنك وعن شخصيتك.ابدأ رحلتك الآن واستمتع بالفخامة بين يديك.

bluejetty:00075212:ios.description:
Rediscover the nonogram genre with Nonogram Crossing - a unique nonogram puzzle game! 
If you enjoy playing nonograms (nanogram, pictogram, hanjie, griddlers, pic-a-pix, picross, sudoku), you will love this never-before-seen picture cross puzzle with thousands of levels!
Test and improve your skills & logic with easy-to-learn but difficult-to-master logic number puzzle nonogram levels, surprising mini-games, and countless events with various levels of difficulty and unique obstacles that will challenge your brain. Relax and enjoy the whimsical aesthetics, fun sounds, and cute characters that will take your nonogram playing experience to the next level! 
HOW TO PLAY:
- Follow the numbers around the nonogram puzzle grid 
- Fill the grid with blocks to reveal the picture
- Reveal pictures underneath the nonogram puzzles
- Win levels to help Nonos & unlock new chapters and mini-games 
FEATURES:
- 3000+ nonogram puzzles added regularly 
- New mini-games & level types with different obstacles 
- New & exciting events 
- Exciting seasonal challenges 
- A range of boosters & power-ups 
- Fun, whimsical characters in a fantasy world 
- Amazing graphics with fun sounds 
- Offline mode - play anytime, anywhere 
- No interruptive ads! 
Nonogram puzzles are a great way to challenge your brain, yet they are easy to learn and addictive. Improve your cognitive skills and have fun with Nonogram Crossing! 
If you need help with your puzzle adventure, please write to us from the game or visit our support portal - https://support.twodesperados.com/hc/en/3-nono-crossing/

bluejetty:00018978:ios.name: Christmas Cookie - Help Santa
bluejetty:00018978:ios.summary: What's the biggest way to satisfy your sweet tooth this holiday season? By grabbing a handful of cookies and swapping until Christmas day arrives! Christmas Cookie is an amazing match 3 game that's all about tapping, swiping, and combining
bluejetty:00018978:ios.description:
What's the biggest way to satisfy your sweet tooth this holiday season? By grabbing a handful of cookies and swapping until Christmas day arrives! Christmas Cookie is an amazing match 3 game that's all about tapping, swiping, and combining cookie flavors to earn power-ups and clear the screen as fast as you can. It's delicious, partially nutritious, and crazy Christmas fun, too! What better way to get into the holiday spirit then playing fun Christmas games?
Santa is getting ready for the holiday season, and there's nothing he likes better than a handful of Christmas cookies. Help the big guy out by swapping tiles to make matches of three or more cookies at a time. Clear some space with a clever match 3 combination, then keep puzzle solving while more cookies, candies, and desserts fall from above. Get Santa excited and watch how he celebrates by dancing and singing Merry Christmas! Work fast and match smart to complete the objectives before your moves run out. If they do, Santa will have to go without his holiday treats! 
Christmas Cookie takes match 3 puzzles to a new level with many different power-up combinations. Open gift boxes, melt troublesome snowmen, break out the Christmas stockings and more! Match lots of cookies to create Christmas ornaments, arrow tiles and other power-ups, each perfectly suited for clearing huge groups of cookies all at once. Feel the crunch!
The countdown to Christmas has started! Getting into the holiday spirit and playing fun Christmas games is a must if you want to be on Santas nice list. So what are you waiting for, download the number one Christmas match 3 game today! You can play regular match 3 puzzle games all year round. 
Features:
- Match tons of different crunchy Christmas cookies, one swap at a time!
- Complete unique objectives without running out of moves.
- Blast through entire rows and groups of cookies.
- Create huge combos and earn exciting power-ups.
- 3100 levels of delicious puzzle challenge.
If you're like everyone else, the holiday Christmas countdown means stress! That means preparing your Christmas list and checking it twice. So next time when you go Christmas shopping, and you're stuck waiting for your loved up to finish shopping. Pull out Christmas Cookie and get back into the holiday spirit. While playing Christmas Games is way more fun then Christmas Shopping, we do hope you enjoy the Christmas holidays with your friends and family. 
If you're like many of our fans, Christmas Cookie will keep you entertained all year long. The game is updated regularly, so come back and get into the Christmas spirit year round. We truly hope you enjoy playing our Christmas themed match 3 puzzle game. We thank you for your support this year and RV AppStudios wishes you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

bluejetty:00084135:ios.name: The King Of Ocean
bluejetty:00084135:ios.summary:
The game restores the magnificence of the medieval maritime empires, with maps spanning across Western and Northern Europe as well as the Caribbean. A new map, Atlantis, will soon be released.
*Full Introduction
【Game background based on m
bluejetty:00084135:ios.description:
The game restores the magnificence of the medieval maritime empires, with maps spanning across Western and Northern Europe as well as the Caribbean. A new map, Atlantis, will soon be released.
*Full Introduction
【Game background based on massive and in-depth historical research】
The periods of Renaissance and Enlightenment resulted in the Freedom of Thought that created a thirst for all things new in the European Continent of the Middle Ages, which propelled the process of civilization exploration. At the same time, the accumulation of wealth led to a prosperous commerce trade, while technological advances allowed Europeans to traverse further and faster into unknown territories. With this, the people who have never ventured beyond the European Continent ushered in an all-new Age of Sail.
To revive the full splendor of the Age of Exploration, we consulted large volumes of related historical materials and went to great lengths to ensure that all aspects of the game, from graphics to the choice of words, remain faithful to the norms of the era. The architectural styles and trade specialties of the various regions – Mediterranean, Asian and Latin American accurately reflect the respective histories and the inclusion of long-renowned sea captains and explorers is set to bring players an immersive gaming experience.
【Unique trading system in which players’ behavior influences the trading prices】
In the real world, commodity prices are mainly determined by cost as well as supply and demand. In most trading games, however, commodity trading prices are almost always constant, which is completely unrealistic. We strive to create a highly realistic trading system that brings realism to players.
In King of Oceans, the trading prices largely depend on players’ trading behaviors – centralizing the trading of certain goods may cause prices to fall drastically in the city. Powerful players may even dictate the price fluctuation of the commodities. The rapid and constant changes bring extreme excitement about the unknown to every deal. 
【Realistic and familiar trade specialties】
All cities in King of Oceans are chosen from famed ports in the North, Baltic and Mediterranean seas during the Age of Exploration. Every city has its own specialty produce bearing strong regional characteristics. The supply and demand of the goods determines the price difference, and players have to grasp the timing of these price differences to secure an invincible trading position.
【Be the ultimate victor in our cross-server battles!】
King of Oceans supports data exchange among multiple servers, thus enabling players across different servers to either form allies or opposing camps fighting on the same battlefield. The one who stands last shall be our overall champion and win the admiration of all other players!
*Contact Us*
Should you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave us a message on our official FB page: https://www.facebook.com/The-King-Of-Ocean-363419481184754

bluejetty:00045829:ios.description:
Sometime lets you easily track and complete recurring tasks in your daily life.
People have used it to:
- Know when to take medicine and remember the last time they did it
- Keep their plants alive by being gently reminded
- Be on top of paying their bills every month
- Check when and where they got their last haircut
- Replace their Brita water filter on time before the inevitable algae domination
- And more!
———
YOUR TASKS AT A GLANCE
- See all of your tasks with reminders for Today and in the Future.
- Organize your tasks into categories and quickly switch between them.
- Sort by Last Done to see tasks you haven't done in a while.
- Sort by Upcoming to see reminder times more clearly.
SET FLEXIBLE REMINDERS
- Set a reminder that occurs minutes/hours/days/weeks/months after your task is completed.
- Set a daily reminder that occurs at the times you specify.
- Set a weekly, monthly or yearly reminder at the days and times you specify.
- Set a one-off reminder at a date and time you specify.
- Choose a custom notification sound.
- (Pro) Get notified after your task is past deadline with overdue reminders.
VISUALIZE YOUR HABITS
- Get a better sense of how often you complete a task with informative charts.
- See your average, shortest and longest time interval between completions.
- Easily add, edit and remove completions from history.
OTHER FEATURES
- (Pro) Add notes when you complete a task to remember additional context.
- iCloud sync: Keep your data private and in sync across your devices.
- Notification and Spotlight search actions: Quickly complete a task or set a one-off reminder without opening the app first.
- Home screen widgets
 - Task: See the next reminder date or the last completion for a task.
 - Today: See upcoming reminders for all tasks or tasks in a category.
- Support for Siri and Shortcuts with actions like:
 - Get tasks for today
 - Complete a task
 - Get last completion date for a task
 - Get the next reminder date for a task
 - Remind me later for a task
- Export your task completions as CSV.
Have feedback, suggestions or questions?
Contact us at support@irisation.com

bluejetty:00171987:ios.description:
Track every collection in one app. Pokémon cards, Funko POP, LEGO, video games, comics — Coleka knows them all, with over 1 million references updated daily.
Built by collectors, for collectors. No more duplicate purchases, no more forgotten gaps in your sets.
WHY COLLECTORS CHOOSE COLEKA
- The largest catalog out there
Over 1,000,000 references and growing daily — far more than other tracker apps. If you collect it, chances are it's already in Coleka.
- Smart card scanner
Point your camera at a Pokémon, Lorcana or Yu-Gi-Oh! card and Coleka identifies it instantly. Add hundreds of cards in minutes, not hours.
- Barcode scanner for everything else
Funko POP, LEGO sets, video games, books — scan the barcode and it's in your collection.
- Know what your collection is worth
Real-time value estimation based on actual market data. See how your collection grows over time.
ALL YOUR COLLECTIONS, ONE APP
- Trading cards: Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana, Dragon Ball, Magic
- Figures: Funko POP, Star Wars, Playmobil, Monster High
- LEGO: every set ever released
- Video games: 40,000+ titles from the 70s to today
- Retro & modern consoles: NES, SNES, Atari, Game Boy, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, Dreamcast, and many more
- Niche collections: Kinder Surprise, Happy Meal toys, Panini stickers, manga, comics
Your collection isn't listed yet? Import your own CSV file or add items manually. Thousands of new entries are added every day by our team and community.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a collection (or several — most collectors track 3 to 5)
2. Tick what you already own
3. Coleka shows you exactly what's missing
4. Scan, buy, trade, complete
That's it. No spreadsheets, no scattered notes, no doubles bought by mistake.
BUILT-IN MARKETPLACE
- Sell your duplicates to other collectors
- Find the missing pieces you've been hunting for
- Direct links to eBay, Rakuten and Amazon for items still in retail
- Trade with the Coleka community worldwide
When you click merchant links and make a purchase, Coleka may earn a commission through eBay Partner Network, Rakuten, Amazon Associates and similar programs.
WHAT COLLECTORS SAY
"Finally an app that tracks ALL my collections — not just one type."
"The card scanner saved me hours. Worth it for that alone."
"More references than any other app I've tried."
Coleka started as a website in 2016 and now connects tens of thousands of collectors worldwide.
Imagined by COLEKA, developed by XnView.

Support: contact@coleka.com

If you’ve ever struggled to answer this question, Medcorder can help.
Medcorder is a FREE app that lets you record any doctor appointment at the touch of a button. After the appointment, Medcorder transcribes the conversation for you automatically, and lets you securely share the appointment with family and caregivers. Appointments are often complicated and fast-paced, so having a transcribed recording of what was said can make it simple to recall your doctor's precise instructions. 
Medcorder is secure and all data is encrypted. Our team follows industry security best practices, and we do not sell personal information to 3rd parties, nor do we display ads.

bluejetty:00039246:ios.name: MediCode- ACLS, PALS, BLS, CPR
bluejetty:00039246:ios.summary: Tired of carrying a set of expandable CPR cards all the time for algorithms? Flipping through the cards to find the right one wastes valuable time in emergency health care situations such as cardiac arrest and pediatric urgent care. MediCod
bluejetty:00039246:ios.description:
Tired of carrying a set of expandable CPR cards all the time for algorithms? Flipping through the cards to find the right one wastes valuable time in emergency health care situations such as cardiac arrest and pediatric urgent care. MediCode gives you easy access to all of the International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation (ILCOR) algorithms from the palm of your hand and includes multiple-choice practice tests for you to test your skills.
This Algorithms, Practice Tests, Megacodes, and ebooks app makes it easy for physicians, paramedics, and nurses to care and save lives. Download this health care professional’s app for free.
As health care professionals - critical care physicians, nurses, medical students, paramedics, and Emergency Medical Technicians (EMT), you save lives every day. In times of emergency, others turn to you and trust that you will take the right steps to save them or their loved ones. But no emergency situation is the same. Having a set of tools in your pocket can make all the difference. The MediCode app is a simple, easy-to-use resource for all of your ACLS (including core ECG rhythms), BLS, PALS and NR skills needs, including CPR and first aid. As our gift to you, we are making this health care app, along with downloadable ebooks, available to you for free!
At Save a Life by Advanced Medical Certification (AMC), the premier provider for online certification and recertification courses, we believe that improvements can be made through providing exceptional education and resources. Save a Life by Advanced Medical Certification has compiled a list of the vital Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), Neonatal Resuscitation (NR) and CPR and first aid algorithms, all of which can be viewed and navigated with the touch of your finger.
Test your ACLS, BLS, CPR, PALS, first aid and ECG knowledge and skills with our free practice tests. Each skills test consists of 10 multiple-choice questions that are derived from our provider ebooks and adhere to the latest guidelines.
Download MediCode and our lifesaving ebooks now and start saving lives! Review our newest ECG rhythms and interpretations resource in our ACLS ebook. Also, check out our CertAlert+ app to conveniently access all your licenses and certifications in one place anytime, anywhere.
The individual algorithms included in MediCode are:
• BLS
- Adult BLS Algorithm
- Pediatric BLS Algorithm
• ACLS
- Cardiac Arrest Algorithm
- Details for Cardiac Arrest
- Immediate Post Cardiac-Arrest Care Algorithm
- Bradycardia with Pulse Algorithm
- Tachycardia with Pulse Algorithm
• PALS
- Pediatric Cardiac Arrest Algorithm
- Details for Pediatric Cardiac Arrest
- Immediate Post for Cardiac Arrest
- Pediatric Bradycardia with Pulse/Poor Perfusion Algorithm
- Pediatric Tachycardia Algorithm
• NR
- Neonatal Resuscitation Algorithm
• CPR and First Aid
- Adult BLS Algorithm
- Simple Adult BLS Algorithm
MediCode is a well-organized, polished, and easy-to-use health care professional’s app that walks you through the many algorithms and practice tests - ACLS, BLS, PALS, NR, and CPR and First Aid. MediCode also provides ebooks, including our newest ECG rhythms and interpretations section of our ACLS handbook, to enhance your skills in emergencies.

bluejetty:00115535:ios.description:
Pawzii World is a cozy play house world where kids can explore a cute town, dress up characters, decorate rooms, visit fun places, and create their own stories with Pawzii friends.
Step into a warm and colorful town full of imagination. Walk through the streets, visit homes, shops, salons, the hospital, the supermarket, and more playful places. Every scene is made for open-ended pretend play, character stories, and creative exploration.
Explore a Cozy Pawzii Town
There are many places to discover:
- Visit cute homes and cozy rooms
- Explore shops, supermarkets, and daily life scenes
- Try makeup, hair, and beauty salon play
- Visit the hospital and care for friends
- Discover new buildings and themed areas
- Move characters and interact with props
Each place brings small surprises and new story moments.
Dress Up and Style Characters
Create fun looks for Pawzii friends:
- Choose outfits and accessories
- Try makeup and salon styles
- Dress up for different scenes and stories
- Mix styles to express creativity
Decorate Rooms and Build Stories
Make every space feel special:
- Place furniture and decorations
- Design cozy rooms
- Create rooms for different characters
- Build your own Pawzii story moments
Care for Pawzii Friends
Pawzii World is full of daily life details. Characters may feel hungry, tired, or emotional. Take care of them, help them feel better, and create warm play house stories.
Open-Ended Pretend Play
There are no fixed rules. Kids can explore at their own pace, move characters, interact with items, dress up, decorate, and make up stories in their own way.
Features
- Play house world for kids
- Cozy town scenes to explore
- Character dress up and styling
- Room decorating and furniture play
- Makeup, salon, shopping, hospital, and home scenes
- Interactive props and open-ended roleplay
- Cute Pawzii characters and warm story moments
- Colorful graphics and fun sounds
- Regular updates with more rooms, buildings, and themed content

bluejetty:00100551:ios.description:

Clearia helps you organize your device storage, manage large media files, and maintain essential security settings. With advanced cleaning tools and privacy-focused features, Clearia keeps your device efficient, structured, and protected.

Identify and remove duplicate photos, similar shots, portraits, and unnecessary screenshots. Clearia analyzes your gallery to help you free up space without losing important memories.
Video Optimization
Find similar videos, screen recordings, and the largest files taking up storage. Use the built-in video compressor to reduce file size while maintaining quality.
Device Features
Device Security: Check system settings to maintain essential protection.
AdBlock: Reduce unwanted ads for a cleaner browsing experience.
Email Leakage Monitoring: Get alerts if your email appears in known public data breaches.
Password Leakage Check: Review compromised passwords to help keep your accounts safe.

Privacy & Data Use
Clearia processes all cleaning and optimization directly on your device. Your photos, videos, and personal data are not uploaded, stored, or shared externally.

bluejetty:00061453:ios.description:
Learn how lenders evaluate your business. Nav combines your business and personal credit, cash flow, and other key factors into a clear picture of your potential funding eligibility, with personalized guidance to help you improve.
Get basic tools for free, or unlock more powerful support with Nav Prime. Features vary by plan.
Know where you stand
• Track your business credit with Experian, Dun & Bradstreet, Equifax, and FICO SBSS
• Track your personal credit with Experian and TransUnion
• See the factors that impact your credit and take control with real-time alerts
• Avoid negative balance surprises with cash flow forecasting 
• Sort transactions automatically for simpler bookkeeping
• Export detailed financial statements to help with tax prep 
Get clear next steps
• Check your funding readiness assessment to learn what matters most to work toward approval for loans, credit cards, or trade credit — before you apply
• Prioritize the right next steps for your business with intelligent recommendations powered by your credit, cash flow, and business data
• Unlock 1-on-1 support with a dedicated business credit coach with the Nav Prime Expand plan
Move with confidence
• Unlock a business credit-building tradeline that reports to all major business bureaus 
• Get matched with net-30+, lending, and credit card picks that update automatically as your profile changes, across our network of 160+ options
• Use our cohort analysis to track your eligibility compared to other businesses like yours that were approved.
Nav has given 2.7 million business owners the insights they need to build and grow.
DISCLAIMERS
**Nav Technologies, Inc. is a financial technology company, not a bank**
**Credit building**
Credit building results vary. Scores are calculated based on multiple factors, and some users may not see improved scores.
**Credit-building tradeline**
Select Nav Prime plans include one business tradeline. The ability to apply for additional tradelines is limited to customers on eligible plans and is subject to availability and approval.
**Funding Readiness assessment**
Funding Readiness assessments are based on your business information, third-party data, and aggregated marketplace approval patterns. They are for informational purposes only, do not reflect any individual lender's criteria, and are not a credit decision, pre-approval, or guarantee of funding, rates, or terms.
**Privacy**
Your privacy is important to us, and we do not allow third parties to collect personally identifiable information without your permission. Read more at https://www.nav.com/privacy/ 
**Data security**
We take your online security seriously, which is why we use Plaid to connect your bank and other accounts. Plaid has bank-level encryption.
**Your curated funding options**
Credit card and funding options shown in your Nav account are from our network of partner providers. Offers range from credit cards to lines of credit, merchant cash advances, and loans. We match offers based on information you provide in your business profile, including your time in business, cash flow, and annual revenue.

Track down all sorts of items in several exciting game modes and explore a wide range of locations, from the dangerous outskirts of Albion to elegant Victorian-era studies and quaint confectioneries.
• MEET INTRIGUING CHARACTERS
Immerse yourself in the magical world beyond the mirror, full of heroes you’ve known since childhood as well as unique new characters, all of whom have something to hide.

Engage in exciting battles with the criminals of Albion and prove that you can bring order to the city and learn all its secrets.
• IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE MYSTERIOUS DETECTIVE STORY
Go on a journey through foggy Albion, a city full of thieves, puzzles, and wonder. Discover things that no one else has seen!
• EXPLORE NEW PLACES EVERY DAY
Earn experience points to gain access to incredible new places and buildings! If you’re hungry for more, you can always purchase keys to new locations and other items within the game with real money to speed up the process.

• THIS GAME WORKS IN OFFLINE MODE WITHOUT AN INTERNET CONNECTION — enjoy it on a plane, on the subway, or on the road!

bluejetty:00186849:ios.description:
Build your own BRIO railway!
In this app you can build your own railway with all the classic parts from the world of BRIO. You can lay down tracks, place stations and figures, combine your own train sets and travel out to solve missions in an amazing train world.
The app stimulates creative play where kids can create their own world and play freely. When they play in the world and solve missions they receive more elements to build with.
Features
 - Build your own railway with an awesome collection of parts
 - Create amazing train sets with more than 50 different train parts
 - Jump into the trains and ride on your own track
 - Help the characters in different missions in the world and collect joy to unlock new elements to build with
 - Load cargo with cranes
 - Feed the animals to make them happy
 - Create up to five different profiles in the app
The app is suitable for kids between 3 and 10 years old.
KID SAFETY
The safety of kids is very important for us at Filimundus and BRIO. There is no offensive or explicit material in this app and no ads.
About FILIMUNDUS
Filimundus is a swedish gamestudio focused in creating developing games for kids. We want to stimulate learning by giving them challenges where they can create things and then play with it. We believe in giving kids a creative environment where they can develop through open ended play. 
Visit us at: www.filimundus.se
About BRIO
For over a century, our driving force has been to spread joy among children around the world. We want to create happy childhood memories where the imagination is allowed to flow freely. BRIO is a Swedish toy brand that creates innovative, high-quality and well-designed wooden toys that give children a safe and fun play experience. The company was founded in 1884 and is represented in over 30 countries. 
For more information, please visit www.brio.net.

bluejetty:00047713:ios.summary:
Panoramic Martial Arts Kingdom
Powered by the second generation Flexi Engine, Sword of Shadows takes players on an authentic journey through an ancient martial arts kingdom, as they become legendary warriors. We've paid incredible attentio
bluejetty:00047713:ios.description:
Panoramic Martial Arts Kingdom
Powered by the second generation Flexi Engine, Sword of Shadows takes players on an authentic journey through an ancient martial arts kingdom, as they become legendary warriors. We've paid incredible attention to detail to ensure that Sword of Shadows raises the bar in terms of what 3D mobile games can accomplish visually.
Revolutionary Flying Skills & Sky Battles
In Sword of Shadows, players can literally take flight, allowing them to experience a martial arts battle like never before. The Eight Fighting Flying Skill allows players to soar above their PvP opponents. Players can also learn the Ultra Flying Skills to fly across Sword of Shadows' expansive map.
Fast-Paced and Dynamic Combat
Sword of Shadows' fast-paced and dynamic combat mechanism allows players to adjust the combat mode based on the circumstances of the fight. Players will master a range of martial arts abilities and battle tactics, including the ability to block feints and break through defenses to defeat opponents. The Snail team has also added refraction and displacement effects to increase the visual impact of Sword of Shadows' unique martial arts moves.
Five Unique Schools to Join
The path to martial arts mastery begins in one of Jianghu's five Martial Arts Schools! Each school has unique qualities that provide endless opportunities for character customization. Are you a swift and silent Tangmen ninja? Or are you more Emei, as brutal as you are beautiful? Between the five featured schools in Sword of Shadows, players are guaranteed to find the path to martial arts mastery that is perfect for them.
==Connect==
Visit our official site to learn more about Sword of Shadows: http://sword.snail.com/en/ 
Join the Sword of Shadows community and learn more on Facebook and our official Forum: 
Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/SwordofShadows/ 
Community Forum: http://swordbbs.snail.com/en/

bluejetty:00080517:ios.description:
Welcome to Match Out! Dive into this vibrant 3D world where you can explore adorable animals, delicious foods, and unexpected surprises. Each level presents unique and enchanting 3D items that you need to find and match within a limited time. Here, you'll not only enhance your memory and exercise your brain, but you'll also elevate your matching skills to new heights!
Match Out is perfect for players who love a relaxing yet challenging puzzle game. Whether you’re at home or on the go, Match Out is the ideal companion for a pleasant holiday and doubles as your brain trainer.
How to play:
Find three identical 3D objects, match them, and collect.
Continue matching until you clear all the 3D objects from the screen.
Complete each level’s objectives to become a master of 3D matching games.

bluejetty:00147116:ios.description:
P3 Mobile – VRS on the go, because every conversation matters. 
P3 Mobile is the on-the-go VRS (Video Relay Service) app that makes it easy for deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals to make and receive VP calls anywhere using a Wi-Fi or a cellular data connection.
Recent updates now include text chat, the ability to share a follow-up number with an interpreter straight from your contact list, and even the power to block unwanted callers. Our users love our intuitive user interface with a choice of two themes and the ability to add contact photos. You'll also enjoy Number Lookup, powered by Google Maps, to help you find phone numbers and conduct map searches without having to leave the app. Even when you're not using the app, you can now receive full-screen notifications at the moment a call is incoming.
P3 Mobile still has all the great features users have come to expect including built-in PurpleMail™, one- and two-line VCO, call history, “smart search” and an easy-to-use interface. It’s the best way to keep in touch with everyone and anyone, anytime and anywhere, and now P3 Mobile has even more!
Download/upgrade P3 Mobile today and tell us what you think.

bluejetty:00169648:ios.description:
Clear Wave - Clear Water Eject App is the ultimate solution for getting water out of your phone's speakers. Whether you accidentally dropped your phone in water, spilled some liquid on it, or just want to improve the sound quality, Clear Wave App can help you in minutes.
Clear Wave App is easy to use, fast, and effective. It does not require any special permissions or data collection. Don't let water ruin your phone's speakers. Download Clear Wave App today and enjoy clear, crisp, and loud sound. Clear Wave App is the best speaker cleaner and water remover app on the market. Try it now and see for yourself!
How does Clear Wave - Speaker Cleaner App Works?
Clear Wave App uses ultra-low, high-frequency sound waves to eject water from your speakers. It also measures the decibel level and frequency of the sound to optimize the performance. You can choose from different modes, such as Clear Water, Water Eject, Water Reject, and Clear Plus, depending on the amount and type of water in your speakers.
But that's not all. Clear Wave - Clear Water Eject App also offers other features to enhance your audio experience, such as:
Automatic Water Eject: Say goodbye to water damage worries with our automatic eject feature. Clear Wave uses advanced technology to detect water in your device and expels it effortlessly, ensuring your phone’s longevity and optimal performance.
Manual Water Eject: Gain control with the ability to manually activate the water ejection process. This feature is perfect for those moments when you want to ensure your phone is water-free, providing peace of mind after exposure to moisture.
Sound Test: Ensure your speakers are in top-notch condition with our sound test feature. Whether it’s after ejecting water or just for routine maintenance, Clear Wave helps you verify that your audio output remains crystal clear.
Noise Meter: Stay aware of your environment with the integrated noise meter. This tool is invaluable for measuring ambient noise levels, helping you protect your hearing and adjust your settings accordingly.
Tone Generator: Explore the therapeutic benefits of sound with our tone generator. Whether you’re looking to relax, focus, or achieve better sleep, our range of tones is designed to enhance your well-being.
Clear Wave is more than just an app, it's a Fix My Speaker App; it’s your iPhone’s best defense against water damage and a toolkit for acoustic management. With its user-friendly interface and essential features, Clear Wave is the perfect companion for every iPhone user.

Download our app and never wander aimlessly around a grocery store again.
With Mathem, you can get a perfect, bruise-free avocado delivered straight to your door in time for Friday tacos. Not to mention fresh flowers, sourdough bread, toys, charcoal for the grill…the list goes on. Get everything you need faster than you can write out a grocery list.
In our app, you’ll find:
- The most intuitive way to shop in Sweden
- A broad selection alongside local favorites
- Smart tools to help you plan your weekly meals
- Thousands of recipes you can add to your cart with a single tap
- Smart search and filtering
- A handy barcode scanner
- Real-time delivery notifications
Do we deliver where you live?
Our trucks are on the road in all major metropolitan areas and many surrounding towns between Trelleborg and Uppsala.

bluejetty:00029289:ios.description:
Write smarter with AI using WritBot.
WritBot helps you create high-quality content in seconds. Whether you're writing emails, essays, blog posts, social media captions, marketing copy, or professional documents, WritBot gives you the tools to write faster and with confidence.
Designed for students, professionals, creators, and businesses, WritBot combines powerful AI with an intuitive experience to help you generate, improve, and organize your writing.
Features
-Generate blogs, articles, essays, stories, and creative content
-Write professional emails with engaging subject lines
-Create marketing copy, ads, product descriptions, and social media posts
-Rewrite, expand, shorten, or improve existing text
-Summarize long documents into clear, concise content
-Brainstorm ideas and overcome writer's block
-Chat with AI to ask questions, generate ideas, or get writing assistance
-Choose from over 70 writing templates for different use cases
-Support for more than 180 languages
-Save and revisit your writing history anytime
-Clean, fast, and easy-to-use interface
-Generate original, high-quality content for work, study, and everyday writing
AI chat assistant
Need more than content generation? Use the built-in AI chat assistant to ask questions, refine your writing, brainstorm ideas, or get instant help with almost any writing task.
Built for every writer
Whether you're creating business documents, academic assignments, marketing campaigns, or everyday messages, WritBot helps you produce polished content in less time.
WritBot Premium
Unlock unlimited access to all premium features with a monthly or yearly subscription.
Premium includes:
-Unlimited AI generations
-Full access to every writing template
-Advanced AI writing tools
-Unlimited AI chat
-Premium updates and future features
A free 3-day trial is available for eligible yearly subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID after purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/writbotprivacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/writbottermsandconditions

- Play card games offline anytime and anywhere with no wifi.

iPhone Keyboard Themes
Give your typing keyboards a personalized flair using different types of keyboard patterns. Change the outlook of your iPhone keyboard backgrounds and start typing in style.
How to change font on iPhone using the Fonts & Keyboard app?
Fontix integrates a seamless method of using cool fonts to elevate the keyboard typing experience. Easily change fonts on iPhone by following the steps given below.
- Start the app
- Go to Settings and tap on "Fonts"
- Choose your font types and press "Done"
- Alternatively, hold the "Globe" icon on the keyboard
- Select "Fontix" to change iPhone text fonts
How to change keyboard color on iPhone with Fontix?
Redesign and change iPhone keyboard color in any way you want by using themes. Go through the following steps in your Fontix app to change the color successfully.
- Tap on "Add Keyboard" after starting the app
- Press on "Keyboard" and enable "Fontix"
- Now, change the keyboard themes from the app

An endless stretch of snowy white land, the Uyuni Salt Flats that reflect the sky like a mirror.

・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!

ep1.清涼感いっぱい！新緑、初夏、森林浴ピアノ by Minaco

ep4.雲や空をイメージした優しいピアノ by ソラシド

bluejetty:00039792:ios.description:
L'application du Nouvelliste, le journal quotidien valaisan, vous informe sur l’actualité régionale, suisse et internationale:
• suivez l’info en direct
• suivez les grands évènements régionaux, suisses et internationaux : sportifs, politiques, culturels
• personnalisez les thématiques qui vous intéressent le plus dans la section "Ma une"
• recevez les alertes d’actualité en temps réel
Avec nos contenus destinés aux abonnés, profitez :
• d’une sélection des contenus indispensables pour comprendre l'actualité régionale
• du décryptage des préoccupations et débats qui vous concernent directement
• de l’accès personnel et illimité à tous les contenus payants
• du Journal Digital et ses suppléments thématiques :
 o partout et vingt-quatre heures sur vingt-quatre sur tous les écrans
 o accès aux 30 dernières éditions, au minimum
 o possibilité de consulter Le Nouvelliste en mode « hors ligne », après l’avoir téléchargé
En plus de l’actualité et l’information, Le Nouvelliste vous propose les services suivants : 
• la liste des décès contenant nom, prénom, localité et année de naissance
• nos concours
• nos articles enrichis de galeries d’images et/ou de vidéos
• la fonction « Témoin-lecteur » vous permettant de transmettre à la rédaction une photo ou une vidéo d’un évènement, d'un fait divers, etc...
Découvrez LE NOUVELLISTE NUMÉRIQUE:
Abonnez-vous directement depuis l'application: vous bénéficiez alors d’un accès libre aux articles du Nouvelliste et ses magazines dans l’application.
• Abonnement mensuel CHF 29.- reconductible et sans engagement de durée,
• L’abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés en vous rendant dans votre compte App Store après l’achat.
• Le paiement sera débité du compte iTunes à la confirmation de l'achat
• L'abonnement est automatiquement renouvelé, sauf si le renouvellement automatique est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours.
• Le compte sera facturé pour le renouvellement dans les 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours, et le coût du renouvellement sera déterminé
• Les abonnements peuvent être gérés par l'utilisateur et le renouvellement automatique peut être désactivé en accédant aux paramètres du compte de l'utilisateur après l'achat.
• Toute portion inutilisée d'une période d'essai gratuite, si elle est offerte, sera perdue lorsque l'utilisateur achète un abonnement à cette publication, le cas échéant
Achetez le quotidien ou les magazines à l’unité :
• Le quotidien disponible en achat à l’unité à CHF 3.-
Plus d’infos à cette adresse: https://www.lenouvelliste.ch/pages/conditions-generales-sur-le-nouvelliste-506132

bluejetty:00100167:ios.name: Bird Away
bluejetty:00100167:ios.summary:
High among the treetops of a tranquil forest live a flock of vibrantly colored little birds. They wish to perch together with their same-colored friends on single branches, but they need your help!
This is a relaxing and soothing puzzle gam
bluejetty:00100167:ios.description:
High among the treetops of a tranquil forest live a flock of vibrantly colored little birds. They wish to perch together with their same-colored friends on single branches, but they need your help!
This is a relaxing and soothing puzzle game with simple rules yet full of challenges—just move birds of the same color onto the same branch to complete the sorting and clear each level!
Easy to play, learn in seconds
Tap a bird, then choose a target branch to move it. Sort all birds by their colors. Each level features unique layouts and restrictions, testing your observation and strategic thinking. Seems easy? As you progress, the number of branches, types of birds, and movement limitations will gradually increase, pushing your brain to its limits!
A vibrant visual feast
Featuring and hand-drawn art styles paired with gentle nature sound effects, the game immerses you in a lively forest world. Every bird has its own unique chirp and animation, making each sorting action delightful and heartwarming.
Hundreds of levels for endless challenges
Unlock hundreds of carefully designed levels! From the tender green branches of early spring to the golden woods of autumn, experience different seasonal themes and increasing difficulties. A perfect blend of mental exercise and relaxation—play anytime, whether commuting, resting, or before bedtime.
Key Features:
- Simple and intuitive, suitable for all ages
- No time pressure—think freely and unwind at your own pace
- A perfect fusion of intellectual challenge and aesthetic pleasure
- Completely free to play, no internet connection required
Come help the little birds find their "colorful homes"! Restore harmony to the colors and relax your mind. 
Download now and start your soothing puzzle adventure!

BaZi Hero uses an advanced algorithm to generate accurate charts, making it easy for beginners and useful for professionals.
Create charts, explore your Day Master, check your Luck Pillars, and understand the Five Elements in a clear and intuitive way.
You can also analyze friends and family and build your own database inside the app.
Main Features
• Dynamic daily chart
Shows the current day and hour updates in real time.
• BaZi Chart Generator
Create charts and organize them in your personal database.
• Luck Pillars
Landscape view, detailed breakdown, and future cycle insights.
• Day Master Strength
Clear evaluation with extended analysis.
• Solar Time Conversion
Automatic local-to-solar time adjustment.
• Five Element Strength
Instant overview of elemental balance.
• Profiles (Gods) & Supertalents
Discover character profiles and advanced Supertalent indicators.
• Five Components
Detailed interpretation of each component in the chart.
• Talent Bridge & Dynamic Talent Bridge
Understand how your talents interact and develop over time.
• Qi Analysis
Warm vs. Cold Qi breakdown and useful element suggestions (Qi Boost).
• Import & Export Database
Easily manage your saved charts.
• Blog Access
Case studies, BaZi education, and news directly inside the app.
• Widgets
Display the daily BaZi Chart on your home screen.
BaZi Hero helps you learn the system step by step and gives you all the tools you need to analyze charts confidently.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
BaZi Hero offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
Monthly subscription - 11.99 € per month
Yearly subscription - 119.00 € per year
These prices are for customers in the EU. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
The user may manage subscriptions, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
All BaZi Hero subscriptions are renewed automatically to ensure uninterrupted service, using the credit card on file.
Annual subscriptions are billed in one payment at the time of purchase and automatically renew at the end of the initial term, at the rate secured at the time of purchase.
Please note that if you purchase a subscription through the Apple iTunes Store or our iPhone application, the sale is final, and we will not provide a refund. Your purchase will be subject to Apple’s applicable payment policy, which may not provide for refunds.
You may cancel the automatic renewal by selecting Manage App Subscriptions in your iTunes Account settings and selecting the subscription you want to modify.

bluejetty:00083752:ios.description:
Turn Your Pronunciation Practice into a Fun Adventure! 
Dive into an exciting game where your pronunciation is the key to success! Challenge yourself with pronunciation tasks, unlock doors, and guide your character through thrilling obstacles. Test your vocabulary skills across exciting categories and levels!
Why You’ll Love This App
Interactive Gameplay: Control your character by speaking correctly to clear obstacles.
Diverse Levels: Choose from Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert levels to match your skills.
Exciting Themes: Explore categories like Daily Words, Travel, and Fun Tongue Twisters.
Time-Based Challenges: Stay on your toes with quick rounds that test your reflexes and skills.
Track Your Progress: Reduce mistakes, and reach new milestones.
Go Viral: Turn your rankings into social media trends—be the next big content creator!
Connect Globally: Join a global ranking community and explore the preferences of people around the world.
How to Play
Pick Your Challenge: Choose a category and difficulty level—Beginner, Intermediate, or Expert.
Stay Sharp: Answer quickly to overcome obstacles and avoid penalties.
Compete and Share: Show off your video and challenge friends to beat your pronunciation.
Game Features
Challenge Modes: Play in Easy, Medium, or Hard mode with customizable difficulty.
Dynamic Obstacles: Overcome unique challenges with precise pronunciation.
Regular Updates: Enjoy fresh content and new levels added regularly.
Social Sharing: Share your scores and achievements with friends to keep the competition alive!
Who Is It For?
Perfect for learners, travelers, and anyone who loves a mix of fun and learning. Whether you’re practicing pronunciation or just enjoying a unique voice-controlled game, this app has something for everyone!
Start Your Pronunciation Adventure Today!
Download now and take the first step toward improving your skills while having endless fun!
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
• You can subscribe to all features within Voice Filter for unlimited access.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly or yearly at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
• You can cancel your subscription via this URL: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://cemsoftwareltd.com/term.html

bluejetty:00022594:ios.name: 700 Solitaire Games Pro
bluejetty:00022594:ios.summary:
Unlock the Ultimate Solitaire Experience with 700 Unique Games in One Massive Collection!
Dive into the most comprehensive solitaire suite ever built for iPhone and iPad. Whether you are a casual player or a seasoned pro, 700 Solitaire Gam
bluejetty:00022594:ios.description:
Unlock the Ultimate Solitaire Experience with 700 Unique Games in One Massive Collection!
Dive into the most comprehensive solitaire suite ever built for iPhone and iPad. Whether you are a casual player or a seasoned pro, 700 Solitaire Games Pro offers an unparalleled variety of card games, ranging from world-famous classics to rare, challenging gems.
EXPLORE A VAST LIBRARY
Our intuitive interface makes finding your next favorite game effortless. Navigate through four dedicated tabs:
- Games: Browse the full catalog in a sleek Table or Icon view. Sort games by name or popularity and use the lightning-fast search bar to find exactly what you’re looking for.
- Favorites: Keep your most-loved games just a tap away.
- Recents: A specialized hall of fame featuring every game you’ve successfully conquered.
- Filter: Narrow down the 700 options by Skill Level, Odds of Winning, Completion Time, Deck Amount, or Category (Free Cell, Klondike, Spider, Pyramid, Canfield, Forty Thieves, Yukon, and Pairing).
DETAILED GAME INSIGHTS
Before you deal the first card, get the full breakdown for every game:
- Win Metrics: See the Skill Level (from All Skill to All Luck) and Odds of Winning.
- Game Specs: Check the deck count (1–4 decks) and estimated completion time.
- Community Stats: View global ratings (1–5 stars) and popularity bars.
- Custom Seeds: Enter a unique seed number to replay specific card distributions or challenge friends.
- Layout Editor: Use the Edit button to customize the position of card piles to suit your visual preference without changing the core rules.
POWERFUL GAMEPLAY FEATURES
Experience smooth, responsive gameplay with professional tools at your fingertips:
- Smart Hints: Highlight playable cards in yellow to keep the game moving.
- Unlimited Undo: Made a mistake? Step back as many times as you need.
- Seed Control: Play the same deal again or try a completely new one.
- Interactive Rules: Detailed text instructions are available for every single one of the 700 games.
PERSONALIZE YOUR TABLE
Make the game truly yours with deep customization options in the Preferences menu:
- Visuals: Choose from various card faces, card backs, and beautiful backgrounds (or use your own photos!).
- Controls: Enable Single Touch Action, Auto-Jump to Foundations, or a Left-Handed Layout.
- Animations: Fine-tune movement speed (Slow/Normal/Fast) and toggle start/win effects.
- Visual Aids: Toggle "Mark Selected Cards," "Mark Target Piles," or "Mark Indicated Piles" for maximum precision.
TWO MORE WAYS TO PLAY
- Daily Challenge: three games for every day of the calendar — short, medium and long. Missed days stay open.
- Journeys: more than forty sets of games, played one after another, each with its own progress and leaderboard.
COMPETE AND TRACK PROGRESS
- Advanced Statistics: Monitor your wins, losses, win percentages, and best times for both the entire collection and each individual game.
- Global Leaderboards: Submit your scores with your name and country to see how you stack up against players worldwide. Filter top scores by Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, or All-Time Top 30.
- Puzzles and Badges: win the games on a grid to uncover a picture piece by piece, while badges and levels reward your progress.
- One Purchase, Everything Included: no ads and no subscriptions. Your progress from earlier versions carries over and is backed up to iCloud.
Download 700 Solitaire Games Pro today and carry the world's largest card game library in your pocket!
700 Solitaire Games Pro is for you if like:
- single / solo player games like sudoku, mahjong, puzzles
- multiplayer, board and family games like chess, dominoes, backgammon, reversi, poker, blackjack, checkers (draughts, dame), dice games
Privacy Policy:
https://700solitairegames.com/pro/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use:
https://700solitairegames.com/pro/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00133691:ios.description:
iFAST Global Bank, the UK digital bank that bridges you to the world. 
iFAST Global Bank is a digital bank backed by iFAST Corporation, a Singapore exchange listed wealth management financial technology platform, with assets under administration of S$32.64 billion as at 31 March 2026. Headquartered in Singapore, iFAST is also presence in Malaysia, Hong Kong and China. 
Why iFAST Global Bank? 
+ Online UK bank account opening. Open your account now from the convenience of your phone! No more queuing and paperwork, plus it's free with no minimum balance requirements, and you can open a UK bank account from abroad today. 
+ Multi-currency account. Following a single application, we offer you multi-currency access to GBP, USD, EUR, HKD, SGD, CNY, JPY, AED, CHF, CAD and AUD. All in one place, no more hassle! 
+ Fixed Term and Notice Deposit on the go. Earn daily interest from Notice Deposit. Take advantage of the interest rate rising environment! 
+ Instant transfer within iFAST Group! Join over 1,250,000 people in iFAST Group who use iFAST to save and invest! Now with iFAST Global Bank, you can enjoy the benefits of iFAST ecosystem and send your money between the network countries instantly, and it's free! 
+ Regulated UK bank. iFAST Global Bank is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority. Our Financial Services Register number: 716167. Registered in England and Wales, company number: 4797759. 
*iFAST Global Bank is a member of the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS). For information about the protection of your eligible deposits, please refer to Financial Services Compensation Scheme Information Sheet at our website: www.ifastgb.com

Download the Masterson Staffing Solutions Mobile App today and experience the convenience and flexibility of modern job searching.

bluejetty:00127207:ios.summary:

In the kingdom of Monares trouble is brewing. The governor of Freymore is missing and the island is in tumult. Th
bluejetty:00127207:ios.description:
The Quest is a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.
In the kingdom of Monares trouble is brewing. The governor of Freymore is missing and the island is in tumult. The mages all prophesy a dark shadow looming over the safety of the kingdom. As an Agent of the king, it's your job to find out what is happening and avert any danger.
Choose from five customizable races and an array of skills, weapons, armor and enchantments, and explore a huge world of four cities and a wilderness of mountains, caves, lakes and forests – full of mystery, magic and intriguing challenges. Meet the many inhabitants, each with its own agenda and attitude towards your character. Some will be helpful, some greedy or lascivious or just plain mean. You will have many choices, including some that may place you against the law, along your way to the dramatic ending of your own choosing.
Key Features:
- Pursue a long and dramatic main story and solve many optional side quests.
- Create a highly customizable character and cast dazzling spells, enchant powerful items, concoct potent potions and persuade people to further your goals.
- Discover an open world with interesting locales, day/night cycle, weather, fascinating people, dangerous creatures, readable books, pick-able locks, repairable items, houses that can be broken into, dungeons, traps and much more.
- Play an absorbing card game with three different decks, accessible at the inns.

bluejetty:00016655:ios.description:
Grab your guns and bring your guts to survive the ultimate action-shooter game, Left to Survive.
Danger lurks everywhere. Survive against zombies using rifles, grenades, shotguns, and anything in your arsenal to secure safe havens and save survivors. Build your encampment to defend yourself against enemy attacks. Get to the chopper and lay waste on enemy bases to steal their resources. Battle other players in solo and team multiplayer tournaments. Band together with other human factions.
Kill Hordes of Zombies
Save stranded survivors and purge zombie-infested areas using a pack of weapons with intense firepower
Destroy Bases from A Helicopter
Get to the chopper and unleash a fiery bullet storm on your opponent’s base to steal their resources
Intense PvP
Think zombies are deadly? Test your survival skills against live players in solo and 2v2 matches
Challenge Zombie Bosses
Defend yourself against zombies that can jump, wear police armor, or explode with toxic gas
Build and Customize Your Base
Build, customize, and defend your encampment from zombies and rival factions. Locate survivors, loot materials and band together to overcome a post-apocalyptic world
FOLLOW US on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LeftToSurvive 
If you have a problem with this game, please contact us at: https://support.my.games/lts 
Please note: Left to Survive is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. In-App purchases may include random items.
Premium Survival Pass is a monthly subscription service that allows you to build and upgrade two buildings at the same time, increases your mission rewards:
+40% experience
+40% cash
It also provides access to the special Survivors, that can defend your base and significantly boost production:
+50% oil
+40% material
Premium Survival Pass costs 9.99 USD/month (or local equivalent) and will be charged on your iTunes Account after purchase and when the subscription renews monthly.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan above.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.

bluejetty:00070261:ios.description:
Make your own stickers in a snap!
LINE Sticker Maker is a free app from LINE that allows you to turn your pics and videos into LINE stickers.
Turn your lovely pets, friends' funny faces, or kids' smiles into LINE stickers! These personalized stickers are a great way to add some fun to your chats with friends and family.
What's possible with LINE Sticker Maker
- Create your own original LINE stickers from photos and videos taken with your camera.
- Customize your stickers for free with cropping, text additions, adorable frames and decals, and more.
- Get the stickers you create reviewed and released all from within the app.
- Sell your stickers on LINE STORE or the in-app Sticker Shop and you can receive revenue shares on your sales. Stickers that don't go on sale can only be downloaded for free by the creator.
- By changing your Privacy Settings to "Hide in LINE STORE/Sticker Shop," you can make your stickers purchasable and viewable only by those who know the LINE STORE or Sticker Shop link or those who have been sent the stickers.
Create LINE stickers and use them to chat with friends and family, all while earning some pocket money or maybe even becoming a famous creator!
LINE Sticker Maker Official Site
https://creator.line.me/en/stickermaker/
FAQ
Please check the FAQ for more details.
URL: https://help2.line.me/creators/sp/
If you encounter any problems with the app, please get in touch.
https://contact-cc.line.me/serviceId/10569

bluejetty:00016518:ios:0.summary: Battle as legendary Warcraft heroes in Hearthstone®, Blizzard Entertainment's award-winning free-to-play* strategy card game. Build powerful decks, collect iconic cards, discover game-changing combos, and outsmart opponents in epic card bat
bluejetty:00016518:ios:0.description:
Battle as legendary Warcraft heroes in Hearthstone®, Blizzard Entertainment's award-winning free-to-play* strategy card game. Build powerful decks, collect iconic cards, discover game-changing combos, and outsmart opponents in epic card battles!
ONE GAME. COUNTLESS WAYS TO PLAY. 
Whether you're new to collectible card games (CCG) or a seasoned strategist, Hearthstone offers an experience for every kind of player. Challenge friends, test your skills against opponents from around the world, or enjoy solo adventures at your own pace. Every match is packed with opportunities to learn, experiment, and sharpen your skills. 
Develop strategies that fit your playstyle, craft Legendary cards, and discover new possibilities as your collection grows. Easy to learn and rewarding to master, Hearthstone offers fresh challenges with every game. 
Play online across mobile and PC with your Hearthstone collection and progress synced between devices. Whether you have a few minutes for a quick match or you're ready to climb the competitive ladder, your next match is always within reach. 
Collect. Build. Play.
CLIMB TO LEGEND 
• Battle players from around the world in strategic online PvP duels. 
• Build winning decks, evolve your strategy, and climb all the way to Legend. 
• Earn seasonal rewards and prove your mastery every month. 
HONE YOUR CRAFT
• Take on solo adventures, complete quests, and discover new mechanics at your own pace. 
• Draft a unique deck in Arena from a changing selection of cards, then test your strategy against other players. 
• Returning player? Wild mode lets you play with all your cards! 
OUTSMART RIVALS 
• Recruit powerful minions, build your warband, and compete against seven other players in Hearthstone's signature Battlegrounds auto-battler mode.
• Adapt every turn, discover powerful synergies, and be the last player standing. 
• No two matches play the same. 
EMBRACE THE CHAOS 
• Jump into Tavern Brawl, where unique rules, unexpected twists, and special rewards keep every Brawl fresh.
CHOOSE YOUR HERO 
• Battle as legendary Warcraft heroes across 11 distinct classes. 
• Each class features its own Hero Power, signature mechanics, and unique strategies. 
• Whether you prefer aggressive attacks, careful planning, or clever combos, there's a class for you. 
Complete quests, earn rewards, and discover new cards with every expansion. Regular balance updates, seasonal events, major expansions, and limited-time experiences keep Hearthstone fresh for newcomers and veterans alike. 
Experience the magic, mischief, and mayhem in this epic fantasy CCG. Battle friends, challenge online opponents, and join millions of players around the hearth. Play Hearthstone today! 
*In-game purchases are optional. 
©/TM/® 2026 Blizzard Entertainment, Inc

bluejetty:00083000:ios.description:
Bible Answers AI is your go-to app for biblically sound answers to your questions about the Bible!
Powered by cutting-edge AI technology, it provides accurate and insightful responses along with relevant scripture references. Whether you're a Christian seeking deeper understanding or a curious non-Christian exploring the Bible's teachings, our app delivers personalized answers powered by the latest artificial intelligence.
FEATURES:
- Unlimited Questions
- Search History
- Shareable Answers
- Biblically sound
- Latest AI technology
WHO IS THIS FOR?
We've found people who follow desiring god, the gospel coalition, ligonier ministries, etc. also like us, but this ai bible answer app is for anyone, Christians from any denomination and non-christians alike!
WHAT DOES IT NOT DO?
This tool is specifically limited in the length of answers it responds with. We do not want this to be a sermon generator or a way to get around studying the bible for yourself, but we do hope it provides helpful answers, context, and cross references that aides your bible study. We in no way, shape, or form, claim that these answers are from God nor do we ever make the claim you can chat with God or Jesus by using this app. We however do believe AI can be used in helpful bible-based ways to increase our knowledge of God and the scriptures utilizing Chat GPT and other AI technologies.

bluejetty:00180462:ios.description:
¡Bienvenido/a al clásico juego de resolver Crucigramas!
Los Crucigramas son juegos clásicos de palabras. Para completar el juego deberás encontrar todas las palabras verticales y horizontales que componen el pasatiempo a partir de sus definiciones.
Crucigramas en Español ofrece la mejor experiencia de usuario en dispositivos móviles, proporcionando a los usuarios un contenido nuevo y una interfaz de usuario muy bien diseñada.
## Características ##
- Totalmente en español y gratuito.
- Compatible con móviles y tablets.
- Modo Horizontal en iPad: gira tu iPad y las listas de pistas quedan al lado de la cuadrícula, para que veas más pistas a la vez.
- Pistas ilimitadas.
- Funciona sin Internet.
- Cuatro niveles de dificultad: Fácil, Medio, Difícil y Muy Difícil.
- Tamaños: Minis, Midis y Regular (15x15).
- Temas: Crucigramas con y sin temas.
- Modo Oscuro: usa el tema oscuro para que tengas más comodidad y una mejor experiencia por la noche o en ambientes con poca luz.
- Buscar: encuentra sugerencias de palabras cuando tengas problemas con pistas complicadas.
- Bloquear Respuestas Correctas: mantén las letras correctas bloqueadas, para que no las borres sin querer, mientras estás adivinando y borrando otras palabras.
- Asistencia Para Crucigramas Incorrectos: te recuerda cuando el crucigrama está lleno pero tiene casillas incorrectas.
- Ayuda: revela letras, palabras o toda la cuadrícula si te quedas atascado.
- Mostrar Errores: resalta las letras incorrectas.
- Borrar Errores: elimina fácilmente todas las letras incorrectas.
----
¿Comentarios? ¿Sugerencias? ¿Problemas? Por favor contáctanos en crucigrama@educoelho.com o desde la propia aplicación. Tus comentarios son importantes para nosotros y haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte.
Si estás disfrutando de Crucigramas en Español, tómate un momento para dejarnos una reseña. Tus comentarios nos ayudan a ofrecerte nuevos crucigramas y funciones.

bluejetty:00026155:ios.name: Duck Hunting 3D: FPS Shooting
bluejetty:00026155:ios.summary: Ready for a realistic hunting adventure in Duck Hunting 3D. Test your skills in immersive environments as you aim, shoot, and complete exciting hunting missions. Designed for fans of outdoor challenges and precision shooting, this game brin
bluejetty:00026155:ios.description:
Ready for a realistic hunting adventure in Duck Hunting 3D. Test your skills in immersive environments as you aim, shoot, and complete exciting hunting missions. Designed for fans of outdoor challenges and precision shooting, this game brings the thrill of the hunt to your device.
Features
Engaging Missions:
Track and hunt ducks across multiple levels with increasing difficulty.
Multiple Game Modes:
Practice your aim in training mode or take on real-time hunting challenges.
Wide Range of Weapons:
Use different rifles and shotguns, each with unique aiming mechanics.
Natural Environments:
Hunt in lakes, forests, and wetlands with dynamic lighting and weather.
Simple Controls:
Smooth and responsive FPS controls for all skill levels.
Modes:
There are various modes along with the Rare Card Challenge.
1- Bottle Shooting
In Bottle Shooting mode, you can shoot the bottles to set your aim. It is the practice mode to make you aiming master and the best shooter so that you can easily shoot ducks without missing any shot. Shoot down bottle caps in training to boost up your hunting expertise.
2- Hunting Campaign
In the Hunting Campaign Mode, you can shoot many ducks who are flying high in the sky. In this mode, you can also drive the car to go to the bank of the river for hunting. Your shepherd dog will help you out in collecting the hunted ducks.
3- Hunting with Friends
Hunting with Friends mode also consists of duck hunting in a bit challenging environment. You have to become a perfect FPS Shooter to pass this mode.
4- Sniper Hunting
In Sniper hunting mode, You have to be a perfect Sniper Shooter to hunt the animals. Different animals including deers, bears, dinos & other wild animals are there to hunt. Only use Sniper guns to kill the wild animals in the safari otherwise they are not going to kill and attack you.
5- Heli Hunt
Hunt animals in a different way from the helicopter to sharpen your aim. Be cautious in the jungle from different animals and prove your gun shooting skills in deer hunting simulator.
6- Jeep hunt
Hunt birds from the running jeep to showcase your bird hunting skills as shooting ducks like that is a bit different and needs advanced gun shooting skills.
Let's aim to become a master bird hunter. Try now and start your duck hunting journey today to become a pro Shooter!
