bluejetty:00029575:ios.description:
The Find 5 Differences game will take you to the land of endless fun Compare cool & fun pics to find differences inside photo puzzles. Play our exciting photo hunt game and master investigation skills like a true detective.
Why is this photo hunt experience the best? Take a sneak peek at some awesome features of our Find The Difference game!
Find 5 Differences Game Features:
- Get coins by playing levels and spend them to unlock unique levels, etc
- Timer: find all differences in 60 sec
- Helpful hints to spot every single difference in levels
- Diverse themes of crisp pictures & photo categories
- Amazing music for you to enjoy the game even more
- Daily challenges for you to find differences and collect unique trophies
- Special levels to succeed - find 10 differences, spot more fun
- Zoom option helps to spot even tiniest puzzle differences
Find The Difference game will not only train the mind how to focus on small details. It will fuel your investigation skills with incredible power.
But there is more! Our 5 differences games help to relax and meditate while solving colorful puzzles on exciting photo hunts. Just compare 2 pics side-by-side, find 5 differences in them, and relax listening to your most favorite soothing melodies. Play online or offline - whatever you want.
Find The Difference puzzles are not for adults only. We believe that everyone will absolutely love these mystery puzzles too! Let your friends and family play and train their memory with these awesome puzzles!
Bring your detective skills with you and put them to the test! Use your awesome chance to go on a mind boggling photo hunt. Don’t worry about time - there is no time-limit in this puzzle game! Spot 5 differences - all of them - collect cool trophies.
Try the game for free today to dive into an exciting gaming experience of finding differences in mesmerizing pictures. Play and investigate like you are a true detective. Go on a photo hunt now, start looking for 5 differences… And find them all!
Stay tuned for our 5 Differences Facebook posts about new & exciting bonuses. Don’t forget checking up on whats different and keep an eye on our Find The Difference weekly game’s updates!

Your journey begins in 1980, when the video game industry is just starting to take off. Design and launch home consoles, portable devices, gamepads
bluejetty:00088418:ios.description:
Console Tycoon is an exciting simulator where you can build your own gaming console empire!
Your journey begins in 1980, when the video game industry is just starting to take off. Design and launch home consoles, portable devices, gamepads, and VR headsets, creating them from the design phase to technical specifications in a unique editor with over 10,000 features!
Game Features:
Console Creation: Develop your unique gaming devices. From the exterior design to choosing technical specifications—you control every aspect. Get feedback from customers and aim for high ratings to boost your console sales!
Historical Mode: Dive into the realistic evolution of the gaming industry. All console features and capabilities match their time—online gaming will only appear when the internet becomes a daily reality for gamers.
Research and Development: Explore new technologies and features to stay ahead of the competition. Complete work contracts and sign exclusive deals with legendary game developers.
Marketing and Promotion: Promote your consoles, create advertising campaigns, and gain recognition from players worldwide.
Office Management: Start with a small office and grow! Upgrade your workspace, hire, and train employees to boost your team’s productivity and creativity.
Own Online Store: Create your game store and earn additional income by selling content.
And Much More: Expand your company, make strategic decisions, and build the most powerful gaming empire in the world!
Show everyone that you have what it takes to become a leader in the gaming industry with Console Tycoon! Grow your business, explore new technologies, and create legendary consoles that will change the gaming world!

bluejetty:00133625:ios.name: NHA
bluejetty:00133625:ios.summary:
Pass your NHA CPT Exam with flying colors! Updated for the 2026 exam cycle, boost your confidence in passing on the first attempt with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
The NHA CPT exam
bluejetty:00133625:ios.description:
Pass your NHA CPT Exam with flying colors! Updated for the 2026 exam cycle, boost your confidence in passing on the first attempt with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
The NHA CPT exam is an industry certification developed by the National Healthcareer Association to measure a student's knowledge and skills needed to become a certified phlebotomy technician. When someone passes the exam, they earn a certification showing they can work in a healthcare facility as a phlebotomy technician. The Bureau of Labor Statistics predicts that employment opportunities for phlebotomists and phlebotomy technicians will grow 25% through 2026.
Key features:
- Choose from different topics
- Practice with 1000+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within the Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users' accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://mastrapi.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://mastrapi.com/policy

bluejetty:00147155:ios.description:
When you’re living on the road, it’s hard to make and keep track of friends. Without community, living nomadically can feel lonely, or even dangerous.
Crossroads is built specifically for nomads to find and foster friendships. The app keeps you in-the-know about nearby events, prioritizes your location safety when adding friends, and helps you keep in touch by showing where your travel plans will overlap next. 
Join this amazing nomadic community and know that on the next adventure, you won’t have to go it alone.
_
Crossroads is free, but invite-only. You’ll need a 6-digit invite code to join.
We hope you’ll provide our small volunteer-only team with feedback on how we can make Crossroads better for you and our entire community. You’ll also need to agree to the Community Commitment seen here:
https://findcrossroads.com/#communitycommitment
Hope to see you around the campfire soon.

bluejetty:00060663:ios.description:
Are you looking for a good study Bible for your personal study or to use in church during the Sunday School service and the main church service. Then download this KJV Study Bible offline or King James study Bible for offline and online use.
The best study bible app for men and women, teenagers and young adults alike that make a great resource and help as you study the Word of God deeper. Get this KJV study Bible or King James Study Bible app now for your iPhone or iPad today!
A study Bible is not like any other Bible. It contains a lot of information that you can use a child of God to know God's word more. That is why in most study Bible you will find Bible commentary, Bible dictionaries and other forms of literature to help you understand the word of God.
Spending lots of hours reading God's word gives us hope for the now and also for the future.
KJV Study Bible app or King James Study Bible app makes a great resource for Christians/believers who desire to learn and study the Word of God in a deeper and in a profound way whether you are a beginner or a professional. This study Bible app will help you learn and gain new insights and perspectives about deeper things of God as this app contains extensive features that would really be helpful in your study of God’s Word such as:
• Bible dictionary which would help you understand meanings and definitions of words used in the Bible.
• Daily Devotionals which contains specific spiritual readings and topics that would add up to your knowledge.
• Prayers which contains different kinds of prayers to guide you and assist you in your requests and petitions before the Lord.
• Bible Quizzes for making your study of God’s Word extra fun and enjoyable.
• There is also audio Bible in pure King James language that is good for people who are mostly on the road and would like to listen to the Bible whiles still paying attention to the road. If you are cleaning the house and do not want to listen to music but rather be filled with the Words of God, then take this opportunity to listen to God's profound words.
• For those who are physically challenged we have a Bible section for Deaf people. Sign language is being used which means everyone can now study God's word no matter the situation they are in.
KJV (King James) Study Bible app is especially beneficial to women and men, Sunday school teachers, theologians, Bible believers, Pastors who would like to begin their study of God’s Word but don’t know how to start or where to start, and to guide them of their understanding of God’s Word. 
This app is a complete package that would give you knowledge of the contextual setting of the Scriptures, culture, customs, history, and many more. So whether you are a beginner of God’s Word, a pastor, or teacher, this app is for you.
King James Study Bible or Bible study app is one of the best to have in your cellphone or gadgets as you desire to grow more in your relationship with the Holy Spirit.
Download this Study Bible app now and take your study of God’s Word to the next level!

bluejetty:00083749:ios.description:
Welcome to MyActiveHealth!
We're thrilled to have you here. Here’s what you can look forward to:
MyHealth100 - Wondering how your health measures up? Check out MyHealth100. It’s a clear score on a scale of 0 to 100. You can see where your health stands today and discover actionable ways to improve it.
Pathways - Not sure how to begin your journey to better health? Explore personalized digital pathways that guide you toward your goals, like better sleep, staying active, or improving your nutrition. These pathways are tailored to you, based on your health info, including your health assessment. Daily check-ins help you build and sustain healthy habits with support from AI-powered recommendations.
Coaching - Take advantage of personal and group coaching to address chronic conditions, lifestyle risks, and tobacco cessation. Whether you need support managing health challenges or want to build a healthier lifestyle, our expert coaches are here to guide you every step of the way.
Mental Health Check-In - Prioritize your mental well-being with tools designed to support your emotional health. Access mindfulness content, emergency resources, and activities that promote stress management and relaxation.
Tracking and Insights - Track your progress toward your health goals with our intuitive trackers. Enter data manually or sync with your favorite devices or apps for automatic updates. View your progress in easy-to-read dashboards and use the insights to stay on top of your health journey.
Challenges - Stay motivated with fun activity challenges. Set a goal, push yourself to achieve it, and even enjoy a bit of healthy competition with leaderboards to track your progress.
Explore - Dive into educational content about medical conditions, disease prevention, and overall health. Whether you’re looking for reliable information or tips to improve your well-being, we’ve got you covered.
Personal Health Record - Managing your health information is easier than ever. Store immunizations, allergies, test results, and more in one secure place. You can even download and share your records with your healthcare providers.

bluejetty:00164520:ios.description:
Stop worrying about swapping SIM cards, carrying Wi-Fi devices, or steep roaming fees during international trips. Simply activate your most affordable eSIM with just one click from the RedteaGO App.
What is eSIM?
eSIM is an embedded SIM card, built directly into your phone's hardware rather than being a physical card like traditional SIMs, which require insertion and removal from a phone. It allows you to store multiple mobile network profiles and seamlessly switch between carriers and plans. This is particularly convenient for travelers who frequently switch between different countries. With eSIM, you can instantly connect to local mobile networks wherever you go!
When do you need an eSIM?
RedteaGO eSIM provides an easy way to keep you connected without needing a physical SIM card. Whether you're traveling internationally, on a business trip, or just want a reliable backup network, RedteaGO eSIM has got you covered.

• Stable & Fast Network: Experience a reliable and speedy network connection at your destination. 
• Flexible & Convenient: Keep your physical SIM card while enjoying the convenience of an e-sim.
• Top-up Option: Easily recharge your data plan as needed.
• 24/7 Customer Support: Our customer service team is available round-the-clock. We're always here for you.
• Call & Texts Service: Choose RedteaGO if you need a phone number while you're traveling abroad.

4. Follow the installation instructions provided.
5. Connect to a local network instantly :-)

Shop, Save & Score! Get real Cash Back, coupons, and rewards for shopping in-store & online with Tada, the ultimate Cash Back and deals app. Discover thousands of popular retailers, find deals effortlessly, and save money with coupons and promo codes. Earn cash rewards, redeemable for free gift cards or PayPal cash. Join over 100 million shoppers have saved money and earned rewards with Tada.

Get paid for your receipts: Before you shop in-store, discover deals for groceries & everyday essentials at retailers like Target, Kroger, Walmart, Albertsons & hundreds more! 
Shop online & save: Tada works in the background to give you coupons & promo codes for your favorite brands & stores like Macy's, Old Navy, QVC, Best Buy, Kohl's, Walmart & more! 
Redeem & cash out your earnings: Let us pay you for saving money when you use in-store coupons and promo codes! 
Tada is affiliated with the popular Swagbucks cash app. Every day Tada and Swagbucks users redeem 10,000 free gift cards and PayPal cash deposits.

Install the free Tada app! 
Set up a new account or connect it to your existing Swagbucks or MyPoints account
Explore the latest deals and bonuses in the app
Discover grocery deals before you shop in-store and find promotions when you shop online through the app
Snap a clear picture of your receipt after you shop or simply scan your linked retailer account 
Get rewarded & Cash out with a gift card or put money directly into your PayPal account
With Tada, you get paid for the shopping you're already doing. No more clipping coupons or hunting for promo codes. Discover new brands and products while saving money and earning rewards. 
Disclaimer: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00165803:ios.description:
Help Harry find his younger brother Peter who disappeared ten years ago!
Play a new hidden object game, solve unique puzzles and dark mysteries!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to solve the mystery of Haunting Novel: Burton Hotel? Test yourself in solving engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and learn all the secrets of Burton Hote
Harry Burton inherits the old family manor which was turned into a hotel. Harry has nothing to do with that place as it brings back traumatic memories of his youth - his little brother mysteriously disappeared from his room and his mother fell ill and passed away shortly after that.. Harry arrives at the manor with only one goal - prepare it for sale and leave. However, things don’t go as planned. Harry literally has to face the ghosts of his past and ask for professional help to get to the heart of the manor mystery and find his little brother after so many years…
Note that this is a free trial version of the search items game! 
You can get the full walkthrough by means of an in-app purchase.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO PETER TEN YEARS AGO
How come Harry’s little brother disappeared from his own house and was never found? An exciting plot that will be enjoyed by fans of haunted hotel games and mystery detective games.
WHAT SECRETS HIDES THE OLD MANSION?
Find missing items, artifacts, and clues! Solve engaging puzzles and complete fun mini-games to find out why an old mirror was hidden in the attic and what is sealed in it.
ARE YOU GOING TO MAKE IT OUT FROM THE MIRROR WORLD ALIVE?
Complete thrilling hidden objects scenes and enjoy gloomy locations in this puzzle adventure!
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO VALORIE ASTER IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as the former owner of the haunted manor and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find! 
Haunting Novel: Burton Hotel is a ghost detective game where you need to search and find all hidden objects like a detective. 
Solve the mysteries and learn what surprise awaits Harry in his former home.
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.
Discover more from Elephant Games!

PassMark Software, the leader in PC benchmarks, now brings you benchmarks for mobile devices. Fast, easy to use, mobile device speed testing and benchmarking. PassMark PerformanceTest™ Mobile allows you to objectively benchmark a mobile device using a variety of different speed tests and compare the results to others.
*Find out if your device is performing at its best.
*Compare the performance of your device to similar devices with the app and online at http://www.androidbenchmark.net.

bluejetty:00169425:ios.name: Weight Loss Tracker & Diary
bluejetty:00169425:ios.summary: Weight Tracker turns your daily weigh-ins into something you can actually read. Log what you weigh each morning and the app shows you the direction you are heading, not just the number the scale happened to land on today. It also works out
bluejetty:00169425:ios.description:
Weight Tracker turns your daily weigh-ins into something you can actually read. Log what you weigh each morning and the app shows you the direction you are heading, not just the number the scale happened to land on today. It also works out your body mass index, so your weight and your BMI live in the same place.
Your weight moves from one day to the next for reasons that have nothing to do with progress: water, salt, sleep, what time you stepped on the scale. That is why a single reading tells you so little on its own. Keep logging and the chart does the work, because over weeks and months the direction becomes clear even when individual days do not.
Features:
- Log your weight every day in a couple of taps
- Follow your progress on a weight chart grouped by day, week, month or year
- Scroll sideways through your entire weight history, with no date limit
- Work out your body mass index with the built-in BMI calculator
- See how far you are from your target weight at any moment
- Review your weight statistics: starting weight, average, lowest and highest
- Set reminders to weigh yourself on the days and at the time you choose
- Record in kilograms or pounds, metric or imperial
- Create backup files of your data and restore them whenever you need
- Edit or delete any entry you got wrong
- Keep everything on your phone, with no account to create
> My weight jumps around every day. How does this help?
That jumping is exactly what makes a single reading hard to interpret, because your body holds and releases water constantly. Rather than judging yourself on today's number, you look at the shape of the line. You can switch the chart between days, weeks, months and years, and slide back through your whole weight history to see how one month sits against the one before it. Real weight loss shows up as a slope, and a slope only becomes visible once you have enough points on it.
> What does the BMI calculator do?
When you create your profile you enter your height, and from then on every weigh-in gives you an updated body mass index. The app shows the value and the range it falls into: underweight, normal weight, overweight or obese. It is a quick reference for where you stand, calculated with the standard formula. Bear in mind that BMI only takes weight and height into account, so it says nothing about muscle or body composition, and neither the number nor this app replaces a doctor.
> Can I use it if I want to gain weight rather than lose it?
Yes. Set your desired weight above your current one and everything works the same way, only the arrow points the other way. Whether you are after fat loss, muscle gain or simply holding steady, what matters is recording consistently and reading the trend correctly. The app does not tell you what to eat or promise you results. It records what you weigh and shows you what it means.
> Will it remind me to weigh myself?
If you want it to. You pick which days of the week and what time, and you get a notification then. Weighing yourself at a consistent moment, ideally in the morning before eating or drinking, makes your data far more comparable from one day to the next.
> Does it work with the Health app?
Yes, if you want it to. Turn on syncing and every entry you record goes into Apple Health, both your weight and your body mass index, so it sits alongside the rest of your health data instead of being locked in one app. It stays off until you enable it, and what is stored there is protected by your iPhone passcode.
> Do I need an account?
No. There is no sign-up and no login. Your entries are stored on your phone and stay there. If you want a copy of everything, you can create a backup file and restore it later, on this device or a new one.
Weight Tracker is a straightforward weight loss tracker for people who want to know whether they are actually making progress. Log your weight, check your BMI, watch the trend and decide from there. Download it and start your weight diary today.

bluejetty:00179799:ios.description:
MY ROSARY: The Best App to create the Habit of Daily Prayer. Always carry your Prayers on your iPhone wherever you go. 
PRAYERS:
- Rosary with Litany.
- Rosary without Litany.
- Chaplet of Divine Mercy.
- Rosary of Tears.
- Compendium of Prayers.
FUNCTIONS:
+ DIGITAL FORMAT: Always carry your Prayers in your iPhone wherever you go. 
+ AGENDA: Automatic detection of the day of the week. Indicates which Mysteries should be prayed that day. 
+ FORMAT: Text and Audio available for each Prayer.
+ LOG: The app saves the progress of each Prayer.
+ AUTOPLAY: With the touch of the Play Button the Audio and Text of the Prayers are automatically reproduced.
+ AUDIO ROSARY: The Audio Rosary automatically plays the Mysteries that correspond to that Day.
+ AUTOMATIC REPRODUCTION: Automatically reproduces the Rosary, the Chaplet or the Rosary of Tears, highlighting in Red the Text that the Audio is reading.
+ COUNTER: Rosary, Chaplet and Rosary of Tears counter that helps to create the habit of Daily Prayer.
+ ALERTS: Alerts that indicate the completion of a Rosary, Chaplet or Rosary of Tears.
+ COMPENDIUM: Additional List of the Principal Catholic Prayers.
+ LIST OF REQUESTS: Configurable List of Requests or Intentions (Notas propias - Text and Photo).
+ PATH: This Section will help you create the habit of Daily Prayer through Prayer Streaks and established Goals that will award you trophies upon reaching them.
+ AUTOMATIC NAVIGATION: Plays automatically the Prayers that the Audio is reading.
+ HIGHLIGHTED TEXT: The App highlights in Red the Text that the Audio is reading.
+ AUDIO: Plays the Audio of the Prayers to use as a guide when praying.
+ AUDIO PLAYER: Plays the Audio of the Prayers continuously - Audio track.
+ REMINDERS: Program Reminders to Say your Prayers according to your needs.
MODES: 
+ NORMAL MODE.
+ INTERACTIVE MODE
+ AUDIO PLAYER MODE
ROSARY: The Rosary is a traditional Catholic prayer that commemorates twenty mysteries (fifteen in the traditional form) of the life of Jesus Christ and the Virgin Mary. It is often referred to as the Holy Rosary by Catholics. “The Church has always recognized a particular efficacy to the Rosary, entrusting to it, through its communal recitation and constant practice, the most difficult causes”; St. John Paul II said, ”Through the Rosary the faithful receive abundant graces, from the very hands of the Mother of the Redeemer.”
DIVINE MERCY: We learn to know the merciful love of God towards every man only thanks to Revelation. It is God Himself who tells us about His mercy from the first words of Holy Scripture. In our times, we are reminded of this truth through the Message transmitted by St. Faustina and the teaching of Pope John Paul II. The Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, also called the Divine Mercy Chaplet, is a Christian devotion to the Divine Mercy, based on the Christological apparitions of Jesus reported by Saint Faustina Kowalska (1905–1938).

Super Color, also known as color by number, paint by number, painting by number, is the best way to blow your stress away! Enjoy the fun of creating artworks and paint by number free with this painting game now. Relax and happy coloring! 

HOT FEATURES
* Hand drawn pictures, totally original content
* No specific skills are required
* Easily color any picture number by number and wait for the surprise in the end
* Paint by numbers anywhere with no pencil or paper needed
* Great variety of themed categories: beautiful flowers, cute animals, characters and many more different themes
* New coloring pages update everyday
* Color and recolor pictures whenever you want and wherever you are
* Post your number coloring artworks on all social networks and share with friends and families

HOW TO PLAY:
All pictures are marked by numbers, just choose one image you like, and tap the corresponding coloring cells according to the coloring numbers of the palette, it's easy to finish an artwork and bring pictures to life in a short time by coloring by numbers. Coloring has never been easier, try it now and draw fantastic coloring pages with painting by numbers!

Color your life with our adult coloring book Super Color! 

Super Color starts with a free plan, and you can easily upgrade. If you choose to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple’s App Store account, and your account will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time. For more information, please visit our Privacy Policy(https://supercolorapp.com/privacy-policy.html) and Terms of Use(https://supercolorapp.com/terms-of-use.html).

Love Super Color? Leave us a 5-star review and all your feedback will be appreciated.
For feature requests or further feedback, please send us an email to supercolorapp@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00171340:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00171340:ios.description:
BLUF: the app converts/translates numbers as digits into spelled-out words/text in over 50 languages, and can speak numbers aloud in over 30 languages. 
Have you ever noticed it can be hard to learn to say and spell numbers in different languages because you never see them spelled out in writing? You might see "Uno Dos Tres, ..." in one chapter in your textbook, and then never again. Numbers to Words Translator solves this problem. 
It's great for practice because it has a special "Odometer" style input that makes it easy to quickly count up and down by ones, tens, hundreds, etc. Of course it has a calculator-style input, too. And for practice recognizing numbers it has a fast-paced game: see the spelled number and tap in the digits as fast as you can.
Here are some of the things the app is useful for:
• Quick translation of numbers into spelled-out words. 
• Learning to count in another language
• Writing out a number on a check
• Practicing number translation.
It translates over 50 languages (see the list below).
For most languages when you enter a number the app shows the spelled-out version, like "cuarenta y dos" for 42 in Spanish. 
For many languages that aren't based on the latin alphabet the app also supports the 'latinized' spellings, to help you remember how to pronounce them. So in Chinese the number 1,234 is spelled "一千二百三十四“, and the pronounceable version (in pinyin) is "yī qiān èr bǎi sān shí sì".

bluejetty:00174652:ios.name: Phound: Call, Message & Meet
bluejetty:00174652:ios.summary:
Zoom for calls. Slack for chat. Google Voice for the phone number. Teams for... wait, why do you have Teams?
Phound gives you calls business calling, messaging, video conferencing, and AI in one app — nothing lost, no app switching, no ask
bluejetty:00174652:ios.description:
Zoom for calls. Slack for chat. Google Voice for the phone number. Teams for... wait, why do you have Teams?
Phound gives you calls business calling, messaging, video conferencing, and AI in one app — nothing lost, no app switching, no asking clients to download something just to talk.
Every conversation. One place.
——— WHO IT'S FOR
Teams of all sizes run on Phound. Solo professionals and freelancers who need a real business phone number without the enterprise overhead. Small teams done paying separately for Slack, Zoom, and Google Voice. Growing businesses that want AI summaries, team calling, and broadcast messaging in one place, not four subscriptions. And enterprises that need real control: SSO, centralized admin, dedicated support, and fleet oversight to monitor, manage, and analyze every call across the team.
Start free. Upgrade to Pro at $9.99/month.
——— WHAT YOU GET
Real phone number with voicemail and SMS
Get a US phone number with voicemail transcription and text messaging (SMS/MMS). Call and text anyone — clients, leads, anyone outside your org — without asking them to install a thing. Keep work and personal on one device.
Crystal-clear calling
Make and receive calls from any device. Hand off a call from your laptop to your phone without dropping it. Call anyone in the US, Canada, and Mexico — not just other Phound users.
Team messaging + SMS in one place
Chat 1:1 or in groups. Text customers directly from your Phound number. Every conversation — teammates and clients — lives in one thread, right alongside your calls and meetings.
Video meetings up to 500 participants
Run meetings without switching apps. Record, transcribe, and get AI-generated summaries with action items automatically. Up to 500 participants on Pro and Business.
AI that's woven through everything
Call summaries. Meeting transcripts with action items. Visual voicemail you can read instead of listen to. Phound's AI isn't a bolt-on — it's built into every call, meeting, and message.
Broadcast messaging with Phound Wave
Send voice and text broadcasts to your contacts from your existing Phound number. Replies come back as regular conversations. Perfect for churches, nonprofits, and teams — no extra login, no separate subscription.
——— THE PLANS
Phound Basic (free): Unlimited Phound-to-Phound calling and video. Meetings up to 100 participants. Basic AI meeting summaries. Add a voice-only phone line for $4.95/month.
Phound Pro — $9.99/user/month: Real external phone number, SMS/MMS (North America), advanced AI (call summaries + meeting Q&A + voicemail transcription), and video meetings up to 500 participants.
Phound Business — $18/user/month: Everything in Pro, plus smart IVR (Phound Flows), shared numbers, business voicemail, an AI personal assistant, team conversation summaries, advanced analytics, and an admin dashboard. ~25% nonprofit and church discount available.
Phound Enterprise: Custom contracts, dedicated support, SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and HIPAA/compliance support.
———
Start free at phound.app. Full stack from Pro at $9.99/month.

listings.description:
Zoom for calls. Slack for chat. Google Voice for the phone number. Teams for... wait, why do you have Teams?

Phound gives you calls business calling, messaging, video conferencing, and AI in one app — nothing lost, no app switching, no asking clients to download something just to talk.

Every conversation. One place.

——— WHO IT'S FOR

Teams of all sizes run on Phound. Solo professionals and freelancers who need a real business phone number without the enterprise overhead. Small teams done paying separately for Slack, Zoom, and Google Voice. Growing businesses that want AI summaries, team calling, and broadcast messaging in one place, not four subscriptions. And enterprises that need real control: SSO, centralized admin, dedicated support, and fleet oversight to monitor, manage, and analyze every call across the team.

Start free. Upgrade to Pro at $9.99/month.

——— WHAT YOU GET

Real phone number with voicemail and SMS
Get a US phone number with voicemail transcription and text messaging (SMS/MMS). Call and text anyone — clients, leads, anyone outside your org — without asking them to install a thing. Keep work and personal on one device.

Crystal-clear calling
Make and receive calls from any device. Hand off a call from your laptop to your phone without dropping it. Call anyone in the US, Canada, and Mexico — not just other Phound users.

Team messaging + SMS in one place
Chat 1:1 or in groups. Text customers directly from your Phound number. Every conversation — teammates and clients — lives in one thread, right alongside your calls and meetings.

Video meetings up to 500 participants
Run meetings without switching apps. Record, transcribe, and get AI-generated summaries with action items automatically. Up to 500 participants on Pro and Business.

AI that's woven through everything
Call summaries. Meeting transcripts with action items. Visual voicemail you can read instead of listen to. Phound's AI isn't a bolt-on — it's built into every call, meeting, and message.

Broadcast messaging with Phound Wave
Send voice and text broadcasts to your contacts from your existing Phound number. Replies come back as regular conversations. Perfect for churches, nonprofits, and teams — no extra login, no separate subscription.

——— THE PLANS

Phound Basic (free): Unlimited Phound-to-Phound calling and video. Meetings up to 100 participants. Basic AI meeting summaries. Add a voice-only phone line for $4.95/month.

Phound Pro — $9.99/user/month: Real external phone number, SMS/MMS (North America), advanced AI (call summaries + meeting Q&A + voicemail transcription), and video meetings up to 500 participants.

Phound Business — $18/user/month: Everything in Pro, plus smart IVR (Phound Flows), shared numbers, business voicemail, an AI personal assistant, team conversation summaries, advanced analytics, and an admin dashboard. ~25% nonprofit and church discount available.

Phound Enterprise: Custom contracts, dedicated support, SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and HIPAA/compliance support.

———

Start free at phound.app. Full stack from Pro at $9.99/month.

bluejetty:00173199:ios.name: Science Games for Kids
bluejetty:00173199:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00173199:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Welcome to the Flu Clinic, a fun and educational hospital game for kids! Become a doctor, patient, or scientist and explore every floor - from the medical center to the science lab. Treat virus infections, transport patients via helicopter ambulance, and experiment with bacteria in a futuristic lab. Kids build executive function, problem-solving, and empathy as they manage care routines and learn how to prevent infections using masks, vaccines, and hand sanitizers. With a kid-friendly interface, this safe learning hospital game for kids turns hygiene and health education into an exciting adventure!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00065473:ios.description:
Kufu Zaim is an easy, fun to use household account book app, perfect for our generation. Basic bookkeeping features are streamlined to make them as easy to use as possible, while various analysis tools help you understand your finances better by answering questions like "how much does everyone ELSE spend on food". There are even features such as “Update Stamp Rallies” that reward you for staying on track. The goal of this service is to make it fun to stay on top of your finances, and we will be working rigorously to release new features on an on-going basis to keep it that way.
========================
Reasons to use Kufu Zaim
========================
1. Easy to use user interface with attention to detail
2. Easy to use graphical analysis tools
3. Compare your expense trends with those of others
4. Track remaining funds for each budget item
5. Update Stamp Rally that rewards you for each update
6. Ability to register stores where you spend your money
7. Integration with Facebook
8. Detailed online help and guides to assist beginners
9. Make it easy to enter frequently used items with the Favorites feature
10. Multi-currency support (151 types of currencies)
========================
Features
========================
1. Record expenses
2. Record incomes
3. Associate stores with each expense item
4. Memos
5. Update Stamp Rally to track updates
6. Set budgets for each expense category
7. Customizable icons
8. Graphical analysis of your income and expense
9. Expense item based reports
10. Personal profile
11. Comparison of expense trends with those of other Zaim users
12. Comparison of expense trends with those of other users based on location
13. Save favorite input settings
14. Create entries from saved favorites
15. Create entries from past entries
========================
About the Premium service
========================
1. Input quickly and hide advertising
2. Multiple accounts management
3. Adding the balance graph
4. Analyze your insurances, loans and welfare benefits
[Plan]
Monthly plan
Automatically renewed on a monthly basis starting from the contract date.
Yearly plan
Automatically renewed on a Yearly basis starting from the contract date.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24h prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.Unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase.
[Charging method]
We will charge to your iTunes account.
[How to withdraw from the Premium service ]
Unsubscribe by the following procedure.
[iOS 11 and later]
1. Open the App Store app
2. Select "Today" tab and the button on the top right
3. Select the area displayed your account
4. Select "Subscriptions"
You can also confirm the date of the next charge on the same window.
* If you cancel early, you can continue to use current premium plan until your account automatically finish the premium services at the end of your current billing period. You will not be charged again unless you restart Zaim Premium.

bluejetty:00035144:ios.description:
Clean up your iPhone and organize your storage smarter with CleanX.
From duplicate photos and similar videos to large files, overflowing inboxes, and messy contact lists, CleanX helps you remove unnecessary clutter, free up storage space, and keep your iPhone organized with less effort. Whether your iPhone storage full warning keeps appearing or you simply want to clean out your phone faster, CleanX helps make storage management easier and more organized.
REMOVE DUPLICATE PHOTOS & CLEAN VIDEOS FASTER
Your gallery can quickly fill up with duplicate photos, similar images, repeated videos, screenshots, bursts, and unnecessary media that take up valuable storage space.
Remove duplicate photos and similar images, clear repeated videos, sort large files by size, and free up storage space more efficiently without manually searching through your gallery.
SWIPE THROUGH PHOTOS TO CLEAN UP IN SECONDS
Organizing your gallery should feel simple and natural.
Swipe through photos to quickly decide what to keep and what to remove without spending hours scrolling through your camera roll. If you are looking for how to clear up space on iPhone, CleanX helps simplify the entire cleanup process.
FIND LARGE FILES & FREE UP STORAGE SPACE
Large videos and storage-heavy files can silently consume your phone storage. Get more storage on iPhone by identifying large and unnecessary files taking up space in your gallery.
REDUCE VIDEO SIZE WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY
Save storage without losing important memories.
Compress videos to reduce file sizes while maintaining visual quality and choose exactly which videos you want to optimize.
CLEAN UP EMAIL CLUTTER IN SECONDS
An overloaded inbox can become difficult to manage.
CleanX helps you remove spam, promotional emails, and unnecessary messages so your mailbox feels cleaner, lighter, and easier to organize.
ORGANIZE CONTACTS & BACK THEM UP SECURELY
Merge duplicate contacts, remove unnecessary contact information, create secure backups, and restore previous contact lists anytime with less effort.
KEEP PERSONAL FILES SAFE & PRIVATE
Keep personal photos and videos protected inside a secure private space designed for sensitive content you want to keep separate from your gallery.
ADD CHARGING ANIMATIONS & USEFUL HOME WIDGETS
Make your iPhone feel more personal with stylish charging animations and practical Home Screen widgets for battery tracking, storage usage, and faster access to cleanup tools.
PRIVATE, SAFE & DESIGNED FOR CONTROL
Your privacy and control always come first.
CleanX is designed to help you clean, organize, and optimize your iPhone safely while keeping your personal data protected and fully under your control.
NO INTERNET NEEDED
CleanX works directly on your device, so you can clean and organize your iPhone anytime without needing an internet connection.
REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE
Review your selections before anything is removed. Double-check the photos and videos you’ve chosen to make sure everything looks right. You’re always in control.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Terms of Use: https://cleanerapp.co/terms

ADD DEST
bluejetty:00127477:ios.description:
Find the fastest route for your delivery route with Droppath Route Planner. 3 easy steps: add your stops, find the optimal route and drive away! Droppath ilets thousands of drivers around the world save time on the road. Everyday.
ADD DESTINATIONS IN NO TIME
Scan a barcode, search for addresses, add from contacts, add from a previous route or your current location, paste a list or import a CSV file.
FIND THE FASTEST ROUTE AND GET DIRECTIONS
Droppath will find the best route out of your destination list (up to 500 destinations per route). Select your type of vehicle (car, truck, bike, scooter, you name it) and you’ll get the right directions.
You can also use Droppath to set your own visit order and organize your data, contact information and more.
Launch Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze or Maps.me in one tap from the destination screen to get step by step navigation directions.
MARK YOUR PROGRESS
You can mark each destinations as Success or Failed. Set a different color on markers. The Estimated Arrival Time will update as you progress through your day.
MANAGE MULTIPLE ROUTES
Save your route history. Reuse previous routes by duplicating them, or adding destinations from a previous one.
PRINT OUT AND REPORTS
You can print your driving itinerary or send it by email. Also serve as a mileage or task completed report. Import and export data to CSV for Excel and Google Sheets compatibility.
EXAMPLE USAGE
● Package Delivery: scan you packages, calculate the optimal route and get go!
● Grocery or Pharmacy Delivery: add the addresses, find the optimal route and leave! As often as needed!
● Customer Visits, Equipment Maintenance: Paste your list of customers into the app and find the best route. 
● Campaign Sign Installation: remember campaign signs are by adding the current location each time you install a sign. You won’t forget a sign.

bluejetty:00184852:ios.description:
Türkiye'nin en güvenilir haber sitesi http://sabah.com.tr en sıcak, güncel ve yeni haberleri son dakika olarak sizlere aktarıyor.
Sabah.com.tr mobil uygulaması aracılığıyla gündemdeki konuları telefonunuzdan sıcağı sıcağına takip ederek en son gelişmelerden haberdar olun. Türkiye’nin en iyi haber sitesi sabah.com.tr, kolay arayüzüyle iOS'ta! Son dakika haberler ve anlık gelişmeleri öğrenmek için uygulamayı indirip bildirimleri açabilirsiniz. Uygulamada gündeme dair son gelişmeleri tek tıkla öğrenebilir, namaz vakitleri, yol durumu ve hava durumu verilerine ulaşabilirsiniz. Gündem, Spor, Magazin, Ekonomi, Eğitim ve Yaşam haberleri hakkında gelişmeleri ilk siz öğrenin.
Son güncellemelerle geliştirilen sabah.com.tr son dakika haberler uygulaması, kullanıcı dostu arayüzü ve hızıyla pratik bir gazete okuma deneyimi sunuyor. Sabah yazarlarının günlük ve güncel köşe yazılarına kolayca ulaşabilir, günün öne çıkan manşetleri en güncel haberlerle birlikte takip edebilirsiniz. Gündemdeki diğer önemli detaylar ile birlikte en yeni videoları ve galerileri de uygulama üzerinden görüntüleyebilirsiniz. Ayrıca, Push Notification özelliği sayesinde son dakika gelişmelerinden anında haberdar olmanız mümkün.
Sabah.com.tr mobil uygulaması ile;
• En güncel son dakika manşet haberleri ve gündeme ilişkin öne çıkan gelişmeler artık çok daha erişilebilir. Detaylı haberleri okurken, ekranı sola veya sağa kaydırarak içerikler arasında kolayca geçiş yapabilir, gündemi kesintisiz takip edebilirsiniz.
• Türkiye'nin en güçlü kalemlerine sahip Sabah Gazetesi köşe yazarlarının içeriklerini takip ederek sıcak gündemi mercek altına alabilir, iç ve dış basındaki gelişmelere dair fikir sahibi olabilirsiniz.
• Okuyucu dostu arayüzü sayesinde uygulama, herkes için kolay ve keyifli bir kullanım sunar. Ayarlar bölümünden yazı boyutunu dilediğiniz gibi ayarlayabilir, koyu tema seçeneği ile daha rahat bir okuma deneyimi yaşayabilirsiniz.
• Ulusal ve global gelişmelerin yanı sıra, yerel haberlere de anlık olarak ulaşabilir, yaşadığınız bölgedeki gelişmeleri yakından takip edebilirsiniz.
• En güncel video haberler ile gündemin öne çıkan görüntülerine ilk siz ulaşın! Sabah.com.tr özel video içerikleri ve canlı yayınlar sayesinde sıcak gelişmeleri anbean izleyebilirsiniz.
• Gündem kategorisi ile son dakika ve güncel haberler, ilk olarak sizin ekranınıza düşer. Dünya genelinde yaşanan savaş, deprem ya da siyasi gelişmeler gibi kritik olaylardan anında haberdar olabilir, gündemi yakından takip etme avantajını yaşayabilirsiniz.
• Sabah Spor ile maçların canlı anlatımlarını anbean takip edebilir; futbol, basketbol, voleybol gibi popüler branşlar başta olmak üzere spor dünyasındaki tüm gelişmeleri tek bir platformda okuyabilirsiniz. Galatasaray, Beşiktaş, Trabzonspor, Fenerbahçe haberleri ile diğer kulüplerle ilgili son dakika gelişmelerine ulaşabilir, en yeni transfer haberleri hakkında detaylı bilgi edinebilirsiniz.
• Tüm bunlara ek olarak; dünya, yaşam, ekonomi, magazin, teknoloji, kadın, sağlık ve memurlar gibi farklı kategorilerde yer alan haber başlıklarına da kolayca ulaşabilirsiniz.
• İlginizi çeken haberleri yıldız simgesine dokunarak favorilere kaydedebilir, daha sonra bu içeriklere favoriler sekmesi üzerinden hızlıca yeniden erişebilirsiniz.
• Beğendiğiniz çarpıcı haberleri Facebook, Twitter, Whatsapp veya diğer sosyal medya hesaplarınızdan kolaylıkla paylaşabilir, yakınlarınıza gönderebilirsiniz.
• Namaz Vakitleri sayfası üzerinden il il ezan saatlerine kolayca erişebilirsiniz.
• Sabah Finans ile Borsa, Altın, Döviz, Dolar, Euro ve Bitcoin piyasalarındaki anlık değişimleri takip edebilir, yatırımlarınızı kolayca yönetebilirsiniz.
• Ziraat Türkiye Kupası sayfası üzerinden maçlara dair en özel videoları, golleri, özetleri izleyebilir; en güncel spor haberleri ile tüm gelişmeleri anında öğrenebilirsiniz.
• Hava Durumu tahminleri ekranı ile Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü’nden alınan en doğru ve anlık veriler ile ulaşabilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00041589:ios.description:
Wild Jacks : Card Game - Online Multiplayer Sequence Card & Dice Game
Welcome to Wild Jacks : Card Game, the ultimate online multiplayer strategy game where cards, dice, and smart decision-making come together. Challenge real players, compete with friends, create private rooms, and build winning sequences in exciting multiplayer battles.
Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced strategist, Wild Jacks offers a fun, competitive, and rewarding gameplay experience that is easy to learn and challenging to master.
FEATURES
Online Multiplayer Battles – Play against real players from around the world.
Card & Dice Modes – Enjoy both classic sequence card gameplay and exciting dice battles.
Friends System – Add friends, send friend requests, view online status, and challenge them anytime.
Private Rooms – Create private matches, share room codes, and play exclusively with friends and family.
Strategic Gameplay – Use planning, timing, and smart moves to complete sequences before your opponents.
Jokers & Wild Cards – Gain an advantage with powerful special cards.
Rematch Feature – Continue the competition instantly with quick rematches.
Animated Emojis & Quick Chat – Express yourself during matches with fun reactions and messages.
Multiple Tables & Matchmaking – Choose your preferred table and compete with players worldwide.
Daily Rewards & Daily Spin – Collect free rewards every day.
Daily Challenges – Complete missions to earn coins, experience, and rewards. 
Detailed Statistics – Track wins, sequences completed, streaks, and overall performance.
Beautiful Themes – Enjoy visually appealing boards and card designs.
Welcome Rewards – New players receive exciting bonuses to get started. 
HOW TO PLAY
CARD GAME
1. Draw and play cards to place chips on the game board.
2. Create sequences of five chips horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
3. Use jokers and wild cards strategically.
4. Block opponents from completing their sequences.
5. Complete the required number of sequences before your opponent.
6. Win the match and climb the rankings.
DICE GAME 
1. Highest opening roll gets the first turn.
2. Roll the dice and place your chip on the matching number.
3. Roll 10 to remove an opponent’s chip.
4. Roll 11 to place a chip on any empty space.
5. Roll 2 or 12 to earn an extra turn.
6. Create sequences and outsmart your opponent.
7. Complete the required sequence first to win.
WHY PLAY Wild Jacks?
Real-Time Multiplayer Gameplay
Strategic Card & Dice Battles
Play With Friends Anytime
Private Rooms & Friendly Challenges
Competitive Online Matchmaking
Daily Rewards & Progression System
Quick Chat & Animated Reactions
Easy to Learn, Difficult to Master
If you enjoy strategy games, card games, board games, multiplayer challenges, and competitive online gameplay, Wild Jacks : Card Game is the perfect game for you.
Download now, challenge players worldwide, create private rooms with friends, and become the ultimate Wild Jack!

bluejetty:00149269:ios.description:
LifePulse – Your Smart Health Companion
Stay in tune with your body every day with LifePulse, the all-in-one health monitoring app designed to give you clear, actionable insights about your well-being. Track your key health metrics, visualize your progress, and make informed decisions to live a healthier life.
Heart Rate Monitoring
 Track your heart rate in real time with precise measurements. Monitor trends, detect irregularities, and stay aware of your cardiovascular health effortlessly.
Blood Pressure Logging
 Easily record and analyze your blood pressure. Interactive graphs help you understand your patterns and maintain optimal cardiovascular health over time.
Blood Oxygen Tracking
 Log your blood oxygen levels to ensure your respiratory system is functioning properly. Quick visualizations help you assess oxygen absorption at a glance.
Blood Sugar Monitoring
 Track your blood glucose levels to manage diabetes or prediabetes. LifePulse offers a simple, intuitive interface to record and visualize your trends over time.
BMI Calculation & Weight Tracking
 Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and monitor your fitness goals. LifePulse provides detailed charts and analytics to help you stay on track with your health journey.
Visualized Health Data
 Turn complex metrics into easy-to-understand charts and icons. LifePulse transforms raw data into actionable insights that anyone can read.
Health Self-Assessment Tests
 Evaluate various aspects of your wellness with built-in self-tests. Receive personalized recommendations to improve your overall health.
Why LifePulse?
Intuitive & User-Friendly
 Navigate effortlessly with a clean, seamless interface. Access all features quickly and manage your health with ease.
Comprehensive Health Insights
 Bring all your health data together in one place. LifePulse gives you a holistic view of your wellness so you can track progress across multiple metrics.
Secure & Private
 Your personal health data stays private. LifePulse prioritizes security and ensures that your information is safe and protected.
Whether you’re managing chronic conditions, aiming for a healthier lifestyle, or simply staying proactive about your well-being, LifePulse is your smart partner in health.
Important Note
 LifePulse is not a medical device and should not replace professional medical advice. It is intended for general fitness and wellness tracking.

bluejetty:00119468:ios.description:
PocketSuite is an all-in-one booking app for service professionals. With PocketSuite, you will book more new business, have clients show up on time (and still get paid if they don’t), grow your team, and have new customers sign digital contracts and intake forms. At PocketSuite, there are features built for every client-based business. We also have powerful marketing features to build up more leads and five-star reviews.
Plus, the PocketSuite calendar helps keep any client-based business organized and efficient with color-coded day, week, month, agenda, and map views.
Key Features:
- Scheduling - 
Online booking and scheduling
Map-view calendar with buffer time and directions between mobile appointments
Lead forms and CRM management
Automatically track package usage over appointments & classes
Multi-day appointments/overnights with check-in & check-out
Subscription/ membership management
Color code business appointments
- Messaging -
SMS text client communication and calls from a local business number
Keep your business and personal texting and calls separate 
Automated appointment reminders from a local business number clients can respond to
Dedicated business phone number for texting and calls
Send in-app messages and attachments
- Payments and Invoicing -
Accept credit cards 
Automatically charge cards at the completion of an appointment
Deposits for appointments
Enforceable cancellation policies
Invoices
Tap-to-Pay
Buy-Now-Pay-Later
POS Payments
Sell packages and subscriptions and automatically track usage 
- Marketing -
Smart campaigns for powerful text marketing
Review tools to get more five-star reviews
Get more organic leads from search
Create a booking site that links with websites and all social media
Offer discounts, promotions, and gift certificates
Integrate your booking, ordering and lead pages with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager
- Team & Staffing -
Assign jobs to team members
Set roles & permissions
Process payroll
Communicate with your team 
Manage a full team on the platform
- Business Tools -
Digital forms and contracts
Sell products online and track inventory 
Track sales tax
Easy tax tools and business reports
Any client-based business can benefit from PocketSuite!

bluejetty:00033603:ios.description:
Transform Your Fitness Journey with WeBurn
Embrace a new era of fitness with WeBurn – the innovative 7-minute workout app specifically designed for women. Tailored to meet the unique needs and challenges of today's woman, WeBurn offers efficient, high-intensity interval training (HIIT) exercises and personalized workout plans. Experience the benefits of a fitness coach from the comfort of your home.
Why WeBurn Stands Out
In today's fast-paced world, balancing work, personal life, and fitness can be overwhelming. Traditional fitness solutions often fall short, being either too costly, time-consuming, or inconvenient. WeBurn is the game-changer you’ve been waiting for:
– Cost-effective: Say goodbye to expensive gym memberships.
– Time-Saving: Each power-packed workout is just 7 minutes.
– Flexible and Portable: Exercise anywhere, anytime, fitting seamlessly into your busy life.
Get Fit, Fast
With WeBurn, dive into a world of fitness designed for the modern woman:
– Quick Calorie Burn: Accelerate weight loss with targeted workouts.
– Total Body Toning: Sculpt and shape with exercises for arms, abs, buttocks, and legs.
– Customizable Intensity: Personalize your exercise intensity for maximum results.
– Adaptable Fitness Plans: Tailor your journey towards muscle building, weight loss, or maintenance.
– Integrate Exercise with Ease: Perfect for fitting into tight schedules.
– Energizing Workout Music: Enhance motivation with exciting tunes.
Diverse Workout Programs
Explore a wide range of workout options to keep your routine fresh and effective:
– Full Body
– Abs & Core
– Legs & Glutes
– Butt
– Upper Body
– Cardio
Customize Your Challenge
Adjust each workout to match your fitness level with four difficulty settings, each consisting of 12 intervals:
– Easy: 15s exercise + 25s rest
– Moderate: 20s exercise + 20s rest
– Challenging: 25s exercise + 15s rest
– Intense: 30s exercise + 10s rest
Free Features
– Access basic workouts and plans.
– Track your progress with the workout calendar.
– Stay on track with workout reminders.
– Sync with Apple Health for accurate calorie and progress tracking.
Premium Features
– Enjoy personalized workout routines.
– Get motivated with hand-picked workout music.
– Gain unlimited access to all workouts.
– Use the app offline, anywhere, anytime.
Flexible Subscriptions
Choose from three Premium subscription plans:
– 1 month
– 3 months
– 12 months
Payment is processed via your App Store account. WeBurn Premium automatically renews at the end of each period unless cancelled 24 hours prior. Manage your subscription easily in your App Store account. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at: 
• Privacy Policy: https://kodeon.ai/privacy-policy
• Terms of Use: https://kodeon.ai/terms-of-use
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Step into a world where fitness aligns perfectly with your lifestyle. Download WeBurn and start your journey towards a healthier, more empowered you!

With an intuitive design and comprehensive functionalities, the application aims to simplify and improve the daily organization and financial growth of professionals.

You will be able to record service times, dates and scheduled services, ensuring that your journey is organized, avoiding conflicts. Additionally, you will receive Notifications of your upcoming schedules, so you don't miss anything!
"Customer Registration" is another fundamental feature. You will be able to store detailed information about your customers, including name, contact, preferences and service history. This allows for a personalized approach, enhancing the customer experience and fostering lasting relationships.
"Financial Control" is a valuable tool for managing finances. You will be able to record earnings and expenses in an easy and detailed way, categorizing transactions and viewing clear reports about your financial situation. You also have the "Full Earnings and Expenses History", offering an overview of past transactions.
To stimulate personal and professional growth, the application offers the possibility of creating "Personal and Professional Goals". You will be able to set goals for your family and your business. The app tracks progress towards these goals, encouraging your financial planning.
With a user-friendly interface, the "Beauty Agenda: Professionals" application focuses on providing an optimized experience for you. From scheduling to financial control and goal setting, the application seeks to be a reliable partner on your journey, helping to grow your business and satisfy customers.

bluejetty:00183604:ios.description:
When to start taking your Social Security benefits?
This is a critical retirement decision. You may start as early as 62 but the payment reaches full potential at your Full Retirement Age as set by the Social Security Administration. The monthly payment can grow even further if you decide to wait till age 70. It is nice start getting the funds sooner than later but does it really work out better? 
The answer depends on how long you plan on working, marital status, life expectancy, inflation and other factors. A careful analysis is needed to make an informed once-in-a-lifetime decision. This app, Benefit Optimizer for Social Security (Boss) is developed to help you evaluate such important factors and analyze your options.
Boss is designed by financial planning specialists who have been serving professional planners with comprehensive solutions for decades. The essential elements needed to analyze the benefit options are packed in a simple app that can be used by all potential retirees.
Some of the key features of Boss include-
• Benefit profile of Singles
• Benefit profile of Married couples
• Compare options
• Minimal data needs
• Condensed and detailed results
• Tabular or graphic reports
• Break-even analysis
• Cash needs fulfillment analysis
• Income tax impact analysis
• Future value analysis
• Fully documented operation
· Boss displays full-span reports & Graphs that can also be printed:
• Monthly Benefits
• Annual Benefits
• Cumulative Benefits
• First Full Year
• Monthly Payment Graph
• Option Comparing Graph
• Cash Needs Fulfillment Pie Chart
Quick & Easy
Analysis with Boss is quick and simple. All you need for an essential analysis is a birth date and the benefit amount at full retirement age (FRA). The Social Security Administration provides the FRA amount to social security payers periodically. With these two data items entered you are ready to analyze. Pick an eligible month and year to view benefit details. Enter different option and view the comparative results and line graphs for an easier grasp of projected results. This simple exercise can now be expanded with other factors such as the inflation rate, life expectancy, rate-of-return, expenses and tax related information.
Use with confidence
You can use Boss with complete confidence for the security of your data and the integrity of computations. Your data stays in your device all the time until you delete it. 
Boss is developed and supported by a team of professionals located in USA that have been providing applications to financial planners for over three decades.

SET GOALS & CHECK IN DAILY
Choose a custom plan recommended by your coach and reflect with daily check in questions. These questions become more personalized as you continue chatting with your coach daily.

bluejetty:00182988:ios.name: Day R Survival: Last Survivor
bluejetty:00182988:ios.summary: In 1985, the USSR collapsed before an unknown enemy. Within days, the entire country became a radioactive wasteland – violence, hunger and disease reign here now. You are one of the few survivors. Now you need to find your family in the vas
bluejetty:00182988:ios.description:
In 1985, the USSR collapsed before an unknown enemy. Within days, the entire country became a radioactive wasteland – violence, hunger and disease reign here now. You are one of the few survivors. Now you need to find your family in the vast territory of the post-apocalyptic USSR of the 1980s. Of course, if they are still alive. 
Surviving after the apocalypse is not easy. You will face real hunger games in a world where everyone is for himself! Search or craft all your resources: weapons, clothing and vehicles. Predatory mutants, radiation, diseases, injuries, bloodthirsty enemies - every step in this survival game can be the last. But even in such a hell, you can find allies - unite with others to survive and save your family. 
Hardcore survival 
Surviving hunger and pandemic radiation won't give you a chance to unhurried walking. It's a real self-experiment, so your road to survival will be hard! 
Realistic world 
Changing seasons, huge map of the USSR and more than 2,700 different towns and cities. Survive in the woods and hunt animals, but be careful: even rats can seriously injure you! 
Endless possibilities 
Multi-crafting, acquiring skills, hundreds of crafting recipes, and lots of ammunition. Enjoy all of the top action RPG mechanics. 
Improve your skills 
Mechanics, chemistry, shelter survival, and much more to make your survival experience unforgettable. 
People and stories 
Exciting quests and helpful allies on your road to survival. Survive in the open nuclear world of one of the most exciting apocalypse games. 
Cooperative mode 
Online mode with chat, item exchange, and joint fights. 
Multiplayer survival RPG games. Explore shelters and abandoned buildings to survive post-nuclear war in a real USSR simulator. Find and upgrade weapons, build vehicles using a variety of materials in online multiplayer survival game. Think back to everything you ever knew about chemistry and physics - it comes in handy in an incredibly realistic world Day R! 
Functions: 
- The game is available online and offline. 
- Multiplayer mode for online play with friends. 
- Choice of adventure difficulty: sandbox or real life. 
- Multilevel system of crafting and character leveling. 
- Dynamic maps, generation of enemies and loot. 
- Realism and atmosphere. 
Official Site: https://rmindgames.com/
Customer Service Email: support@rmindgames.com
Join the global Day R community! 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DayR.game/ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtrGT3WA-qelqQJUI_lQ9Ig/featured

bluejetty:00071700:ios.description:
لعبة صقر الصحراء من اقوى العاب سباق الخيل الجديدة وتعتبر هذه اللعبة هى بالفعل احدث العاب سباق الخيل المناسبة للجميع الاعمار بنات ، اطفال و شباب وخصوصا محبى الخيل والفروسية . او حتى هواة مشاهدة مباريات رياضة سباقات الخيول العالميه ولا شك ان اجود وافضل انواع الخيول موجودة في هذه العبه.
تحدى اصدقائك والعب كي تكون افضل فارس .قم باختيار حصانك المفضل من حراج و سوق الخيل .
تحتوي هذه اللعبة على عديد من الخرائط و المستويات برسومات عالية و تعتبر من اقوى العاب سباق . يمكنك تحدي اصدقائك او اللعب منفرد ومشاركة النتيجة مع اصحابك. وتاتي هذه اللعبة بشكل 3d.
ان كنت من محبي العاب السباق و سيارات والعاب الهجوله و تفحيط و درفت فان لعبه صقر الصحراء هي افضل خيار لك وخصوصا انا تحتوى على افكار جديدة .
رسومات بجودة عالية
استمتع برسومات ثلاثية الأبعاد متطورة مع بيئات تم إنشاؤها بواقعية واستمتاع بمشاهدة الخيل و حصان بتفاصيل مثيرة للدهشة.
أنماط لعب تناسب كل مزاج
اشعر بالحماس في طريق من اتجاه واحد أو من اتجاهين، اندفع في لعبة سريعة في محاربة الوقت أو قم بركوب الحصن بهدوء في طريق حر.
زوايا كاميرا متعددة
قم بالسباق عبر حركة المرور مع الكاميرا العلوية أو الخلفية، كل زاوية كاميرا توفر تجربة قيادة فريدة من نوعها.ريد.
تم تطويرها لتكون اقوى لعبة لهذا العام و ميزاتها :
- العديد من المستويات والمراحل.
- خيل مميزة بتصميم واقعي
- تصوير داخلي
-زوايا كاميرا متعددة
- افضل خيل للهجوله والتطعيس.
- هجولة بدون شرطه او حواجز
- تطويف وهجولة 
- مرحلة حرة لتستمتع بها كيفما شئت
اكتشف سر حب الملايين حول العالم لهذه اللعبة الممتعة،
شارك اصحابك المتعة والمرح في هذه اللعبة الصعبة للعديد من اللاعبين فهل انت منهم؟
لعبة بسيطة ولكنها تسبب الإدمان وهي مناسبة لك ان كنت من محبي العاب شرطه وتحفيط , حرامي.
متعة وتحدي بشكل فوري بدون نت جديدة كليا.
بدون تسجيل٫ بدون تعقيدات٫ ابدأ اللعب مباشرة واستمتع
لعبة مجانية في العالم العربي، جربوا اللعبة ولا تنسوا تقييمها لتستمر التحديث

bluejetty:00014387:ios.name: Liquid UI Client for SAP
bluejetty:00014387:ios.summary: Liquid UI for SAP empowers your IT(/users) to ADAPT your existing SAP infrastructure by providing instant mobile access – a complete, comprehensive and native SAP GUI for your device. Its direct connectivity to S/4HANA, ERP or ECC facilitat
bluejetty:00014387:ios.description:
Liquid UI for SAP empowers your IT(/users) to ADAPT your existing SAP infrastructure by providing instant mobile access – a complete, comprehensive and native SAP GUI for your device. Its direct connectivity to S/4HANA, ERP or ECC facilitates mobility without the need to reprogram processes or redevelop z* transactions or recreate transactions in Fiori. 
In addition, with Liquid UI you can also FLEXIBLY innovate your SAP transactions on iOS as per your business requirements along with your screen real estate needs. Furthermore, enjoy the same SECURITY that you get with SAP because of the app’s native connectivity and support to TLS encryption over wirelessly transmitted data.
Key features of Liquid UI for SAP
• Rule-based barcode integration – Populate multiple fields and program actions like auto-enter or auto-tabbing using a barcode.
• Notifications and badges – Manage SAP processes and auto-assign tasks to individuals with all the required context.
• Single sign-on support – Login to SAP using Windows Active Directory with Kerberos authentication, SAP Portal, or SAP Trust.
• World-class security & encryption – Have more control over wirelessly transmitted data between the app and your SAP.
• Automate processes – Automate your SAP transactions to eliminate slow, manually dependent and error-prone processes. 
• Attach instantly via Service For Objects – Instantly attach an image or a video file to your SAP transaction from your device.
• Integrate with web services – Connect with external programs like Salesforce, Excel, PDF, make RFC calls, interact with web service or integrate to databases like Oracle and SQL.
• Electronic signature support, Language localization, On-the-go printing, GPS coordinates support and more.
NOTE: Download this FREE client software on your iOS device and connect to your SAP TODAY to evaluate the user experience and functionality provided by Liquid UI.
Work faster and smarter across many SAP processes
Grow all parts of your business with our complete enterprise platform. Manage processes from Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Inventory Management (IM), Materials Management (MM), Warehouse Management (WM), Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Plant Maintenance (PM), Quality Management (QM), Project Systems (PS), Human Capital Management (HCM), Basis System, etc.
About Liquid UI Technology
Liquid UI is devised to make your existing SAP infrastructure adaptable to advanced technologies like IoT. You can immediately extend your SAP ERP to iOS without reprogramming. Also, you can flexibly innovate your SAP screens to make it simpler and more intuitive. Liquid UI technology also enabled you to deliver specific content based on your business needs. In addition, Liquid UI provides the same security which you get with SAP because of its native connectivity and support to TLS encryption. Thus making your SAP more robust, intelligent, and proficient.

bluejetty:00073446:ios.name: ParkHouston
bluejetty:00073446:ios.summary: The ParkHouston app, powered by ParkMobile, gives you a smarter way to park in Houston. Easily pay for on-street and off-street parking right from your mobile device. You can also reserve parking ahead of time in lots, garages, venues, airp
bluejetty:00073446:ios.description:
The ParkHouston app, powered by ParkMobile, gives you a smarter way to park in Houston. Easily pay for on-street and off-street parking right from your mobile device. You can also reserve parking ahead of time in lots, garages, venues, airports, and universities across the country. You can use the ParkHouston app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, and more.
Why Use ParkHouston?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Reserve parking spots ahead of time to save time and money
• Use the app in over 3000 locations coast-to-coast including venues, airports, and universities
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the ParkHouston app and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the ParkHouston app
How It Works
On-Street and Off-Street Parking:
• Enter the zone number on the posted signs around the meter
• Select the amount of time you want to park and confirm your information
• Touch the “Start Parking” button to begin your parking session
• Extend time in the app if you are running late
Parking Reservations:
• Search for the area where you want to park and select the specific parking location
• Choose the date/time and complete your reservation
• Follow the instructions in your confirmation to redeem at the parking facility
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find my car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked
• Turn-by-turn directions to the parking garage where you reserved your spot
• Multiple payment methods available
About ParkMobile
ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider of parking payment solutions in the United States, helping over 40 million people easily find, reserve, and pay for parking from their mobile devices.
Looking for Help?
At ParkMobile, we’re serious about customer service. We process nearly 500,000 parking transactions every day and we know that every now and then, something might go wrong. If you have an issue, we will do everything we can to make it right. Our customer service is 24/7/365. If you need help, here’s how to get in touch with us:
Web: https://ParkMobile.io/
Email: helpdesk@ParkMobile.io
Online Help Center: https://ParkMobile.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
Video Tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkFsfUAHrnUc5jOm9XtjOmmJQt4YTTCyA
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ParkMobile
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParkMobile/
