With Suzy, you can also create a kid dedicated launcher and prioritize learning by
bluejetty:00138816:ios.description:
Set a kid safe mode with 1 tap while lending your device to your child. Block apps, web browsers and app downloads. Set time limits and device free moments.
With Suzy, you can also create a kid dedicated launcher and prioritize learning by making the use of educational apps mandatory: From now on, if your child wants to access YouTube for 10 minutes, you can require them to learn a new language on Duolingo for 10 minutes first!
Passive scrolling is replaced by intentional learning sessions leading to long lasting knowledge and significant reduction in children's overall screen time.
▶ GET STARTED IN LESS THAN 3 MINUTES
1. Create your child’s profile
2. Select the only apps your child can use on your device. All other apps are blocked by default.
That’s it! Simply tap “switch to child mode” to hand over your device to your child worry-free!
▶ BENEFITS 
Hand over your device worry-free!
• Keep your child safe from inappropriate content
• Protect your content and sensitive information
• Set Time Limits your child can spend on your device to avoid arguments
• Switch ON/OFF all device’s restrictions with one tap
• Turn any screen time into a learning opportunity
▶ FEATURES
App Restrictions
• Allowed Apps: Select apps your child can use. All other apps are BLOCKED by default.
• Kids Launcher: Display a custom launcher with the apps kids can use.
• Child Mode in 1 tap: With a single tap, switch on or off all device’s restrictions.
• Multiple Child Profiles: Create custom child profiles with their own personalized restrictions.
• Pin Protected: Modifying restrictions require the use of a secret PIN code.
• Block uninstall: Prevent your child from deleting Suzy and disabling restrictions
Screen Time Controls
• Screen Time Limit: Set daily time limits for the apps you allow your child to use.
• Schedules: Set screen-free moments during dinner, homework, bedtime, or any time you see fit.
• Statistics: Track your child’s daily/weekly/monthly app usage.
Boosted Learning 
• Learning: Unlock access to their favorite apps only if they use educational apps first.
• Recommended Apps: Get a selection of educational apps to use based on your child’s profile
▶ REQUIREMENTS
Suzy is only supported on (and above):
iOS 16 for iPhone or iPadOS 16 for iPad
▶ TERMS & PRIVACY
• Terms: https://suzyapp.com/terms-of-service/
• Privacy policy: https://suzyapp.com/privacy/
• Support: support@suzyapp.com

FOR EVERYONE
Whether you are discovering the Bible for the first time, returning to God's Word, studying with your family, or serving in church ministry, NLT Bible makes daily Bible reading simple and meaningful.

New Living Translation (NLT) Bible with audio narration, AI Bible Chat, daily verses, study plans, devotionals, Prayer Wall, and offline reading.

The New Living Translation (NLT) presents Scripture in clear, natural, everyday English. Read and explore God's Word with helpful tools designed to make Bible reading and study simple and meaningful.

Read, listen, highlight, study, and pray every day — no account needed to start reading, with offline access to all 66 books.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND INSIDE

• COMPLETE NLT BIBLE — Read all 66 books of the Old and New Testament in clear, easy-to-understand language.

• AUDIO BIBLE — Listen to Bible chapters at home, while traveling, walking, resting, or whenever you want to hear God's Word.

• AI BIBLE CHAT — Ask questions about Scripture, passages, biblical themes, faith, or Christian life and get easy-to-understand answers based on the Bible.

• DAILY VERSE & PRAYER — Start your day with an inspiring Bible verse and prayer.

• PRAYER WALL — Share prayer requests, pray for others, and be part of a community praying together.

• HIGHLIGHTS, NOTES & BOOKMARKS — Save important verses, add bookmarks, highlights, and personal notes while you read.

• OFFLINE BIBLE — Read Scripture without an internet connection or creating an account.

• STUDY PLANS — Build a regular Bible reading habit with guided reading and study plans.

• DAILY DEVOTIONAL — Spend a few minutes each day reading and reflecting on God's Word.

• HOME SCREEN WIDGET — Keep Scripture visible throughout your day.

• BIBLE SEARCH — Quickly find verses, words, passages, and topics across Scripture.

READ, LISTEN & STUDY

Read a chapter during your quiet time, listen to Bible audio throughout your day, save meaningful verses, or continue reading where you left off.

When you have questions, AI Bible Chat can help you understand passages and explore biblical topics in more detail.

PRAY TOGETHER

Prayer Wall gives you a place to share prayer requests and pray for others in the community.

Reporting and blocking options are available to help keep the Prayer Wall safe and respectful.

GROW IN GOD'S WORD

Whether you want to understand a difficult passage, strengthen your faith, or build a daily Bible habit, NLT Bible gives you the tools to read, listen, study, pray, and reflect.

Follow study plans, listen to Scripture, save important verses, ask Bible questions, or simply continue reading where you left off.

SCRIPTURE FOR EVERY SEASON

Explore God's Word during Christmas, Easter, Good Friday, Lent, and other meaningful moments of the Christian year with Scripture, reflection, and prayer.

FOR EVERYONE

Whether you are discovering the Bible for the first time, returning to God's Word, studying with your family, or serving in church ministry, NLT Bible makes daily Bible reading simple and meaningful.

PREMIUM — OPTIONAL

Optional premium plans provide access to additional study features and an ad-free experience.

Auto-renewable subscription options are available. Lifetime Study is also available as a one-time purchase.

AI features may use credits or have usage limits depending on your plan. Lifetime Study does not include unlimited AI usage.

Prices, plans, and included features are shown in the app before purchase and may vary by country or region.

bluejetty:00024158:ios.description:
Rooooaaarrrrr!!
The Bibi Lion roars in the Savanna calling all the animals together to organize a big party. The Bibi.Pet party has landed in Africa and is bringing with it lots of fun and lots of educational activities for kids.
There’s the hippopotamus painting with colored balls, the giraffe with balancing activities and obviously the lion looking for his crown.
And lots of other games: puzzles, numbers, pairing and sorting.
And as always, Bibi.Pet will accompany you as you discover all the educational activities available.
Suitable for ages 2 to 5 and designed together with experts from the educational field.
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- Complete the puzzles
- Have fun coloring
- Educational matching activities 
- Use Logic
- Play with music
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00021221:ios.description:
Daily Tracker - Ultimate Habit & Goal Trackers
## Track your daily habits, life goals, healthy routines, weight goal, sleep hours. Use it as habit tracker, goal tracker, counter tracker or even time tracker. Allow to set your goal and see your progress in chart, calendars. Organise them into groups and more.
## Daily Tracker was featured by Apple in Build Good Habit App on the App Store in US & Canada
• Daily Tracker can track literally everything from habit activities to number, or even time
• Visualise your achievements in chart or review your data in calendar view.
• Create group to organise your data. 
• Attach notes to your tracking progress.
• Protect your data with Cloud Backup, Passcode Lock, Data Export and more.
• Lifetime Price, No subscription, No Ads
Daily Tracker is the ultimate tool for tracking your daily habits and goals, and keeping a log of your daily activities. It allows you to track literally everything about you. Examples:
• Your gym activities
• Number of the glasses of water you've had 
• How many the stairs you've taken today
• Number of hours you've slept last night
• Your running distance
• Your weight or your % of body fat
• Your total daily sells of your business
• ...or whatever is important to you
With Daily Tracker, you won’t need another individual apps for each of these things. Only Daily Tracker can manage them all in one app. That's why you'll love it. It is also easy to use but it is flexible and more powerful than you think.
=============
Features
=============
## Track Your Goals
Multiple ways to track your goals from yes/no, counter, numeric to time.
## Visualise Your Progress
See the whole picture of your achievements in simplified chart.
## Goal Target
Setting your Goal Target. The powerful way to achieve your goal.
## Organise by Groups
Easily tracking progress by specified group which you can manually define.
## Logbook View
Don’t be afraid of losing your historical data, Daily Tracker will be kept in the logbook view.
## Calendar View
Keep track of your progress with our build-in calendar view.
## Note-Taking Capability
Describe your progress which a convenient way to attach note.
## Cloud Backup
Your data will never lose with our cloud backup and restore via Dropbox.
## CSV Export
Data is yours! Want to use your tracking data outside our app? This data export feature can be your rescuer.
## Setting Reminder for Trackers
Never forget to track your daily progress! Our tracker reminders will remind you.
## Theme
The choice is yours! Light or Dark, Modern or Classic, We have a theme which suits for you.
## Passcode Lock
Secure your personal data from prying eyes with 4-digits passcode lock.
## More Good Things to Come
Stay tune for more new features such as streaks mode, etc.

bluejetty:00026317:ios.name: Kidduca 3D: Games For Kids 2+
bluejetty:00026317:ios.summary: Welcome to Kidduca 3D - an interactive, multiplayer educational game where kids can learn new languages, develop essential skills in math, writing, and reading, recognize colors, solve fun logic puzzles, and enjoy exciting racing games! Kid
bluejetty:00026317:ios.description:
Welcome to Kidduca 3D - an interactive, multiplayer educational game where kids can learn new languages, develop essential skills in math, writing, and reading, recognize colors, solve fun logic puzzles, and enjoy exciting racing games! Kidduca 3D is designed to engage young learners with a variety of fun and educational activities.
Key Educational Features:
3D LEARNING GAMES FOR KIDS
Kidduca 3D offers over 90 educational levels filled with 400+ interactive elements, including letters, numbers, shapes, words, animals, and vehicles. Kids will improve their language skills, practice counting, learn to read, and solve engaging puzzles. This interactive learning experience is perfect for boys and girls ages 2 to 7!
NUMBERS & MATH LEARNING GAMES
Make learning numbers fun with engaging math activities! These interactive games build a strong foundation in counting and introduce basic arithmetic in an easy-to-understand way.
SHAPES, COLORS & CREATIVE COLORING ACTIVITIES
Through interactive drawing and coloring games, kids will learn to identify shapes and colors while enhancing their logical thinking, fine motor skills, and creativity. These activities are ideal for early cognitive development in children ages 2 to 5.
ALPHABET & WORD LEARNING GAMES
Kids ages 2 to 7 can explore letters, words, and sounds with interactive alphabet games and flashcards. These activities build strong early literacy and writing skills.
LOGIC PUZZLES & SORTING GAMES
Boost your child’s critical thinking with fun sorting games and logic puzzles! Kids will sort objects by size, color, and shape, strengthening their problem-solving abilities and cognitive growth.
MULTIPLAYER GAMES FOR KIDS
Kidduca 3D offers a fun multiplayer experience where kids can see other players and interact using cheerful emojis! This feature makes learning even more exciting, encouraging children to explore Kidduca 3D together.
EDUCATIONAL CAR RACING GAMES
Make learning even more fun with customizable car racing games! Kids can design their own cars and tracks, improving spatial awareness, hand-eye coordination, and strategic thinking.
WHY CHOOSE KIDDUCA 3D?
Kidduca 3D provides a safe and enriching environment where kids can learn while having fun. Each level is narrated by native speakers, helping children learn correct pronunciation. The game seamlessly blends education and entertainment, making it perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, and early learners!
DOWNLOAD KIDDUCA 3D TODAY!
Give your child the best start – download Kidduca 3D today and start the learning adventure! Whether it’s language learning, math practice, writing improvement, reading comprehension, color exploration, puzzle-solving, or thrilling car racing, Kidduca 3D has it all.

Are you ready for a puzzle adventure like no other? City Block Jam takes the classic sliding block puzzle game to the next level by blending brain-teasing puzzles, color matching chall
bluejetty:00046793:ios.description:
City Block Jam – Solve Puzzles, Build Your Dream City!
Are you ready for a puzzle adventure like no other? City Block Jam takes the classic sliding block puzzle game to the next level by blending brain-teasing puzzles, color matching challenges, and strategic city-building fun! Every puzzle you solve not only sharpens your logic and reflex skills but also brings your dream city to life.
Think, Solve, Build!
In City Block Jam, you’ll dive into addictive, casual brain training as you slide blocks, overcome obstacles, and complete uniquely challenging levels. With every move, you earn coins to upgrade your city and unlock exciting new areas, turning simple block puzzles into a vibrant urban adventure.
Game Highlights:
-A Fresh Take on Puzzle Gaming: This isn’t just another block puzzle game! Every solved level in this mobile puzzle game rewards you with coins to invest in your city’s growth.
-Hundreds of Mind-Teasing Puzzles: Enjoy a wide variety of brain-teasing puzzles that blend logic, reflexes, and creative planning in a colorful block matching challenge.
-Unlock & Expand Your City: Use your rewards to build and customize your metropolis, making each win even more satisfying.
-Strategic & Addictive Gameplay: Every move counts in this sliding block puzzle game that combines casual brain training with a time-based puzzle challenge.
-Stunning Visuals & Immersive Experience: The game’s vibrant graphics and smooth controls create a visually engaging, ASMR-like experience for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.
-Daily Challenges & Exciting Rewards: Return every day for special missions, exclusive rewards, and new opportunities to grow your dream city!
How to Play:
-Slide the blocks to clear paths and match colors in this captivating block puzzle game.
-Solve each color matching puzzle efficiently to earn coins and bonuses.
-Use your coins to upgrade, build, and customize your city.
-Overcome increasingly challenging puzzles and time-based obstacles to unlock new city features!
Why You’ll Love City Block Jam:
-A perfect blend of addictive, brain-teasing puzzles and creative city-building.
-A rewarding progression system—watch your city flourish as you master every sliding block puzzle challenge.
-An engaging and relaxing puzzle adventure designed for puzzle enthusiasts and city-building fans alike.
If you love a mix of logic, creativity, and fun, then City Block Jam is your go-to mobile puzzle game. Play now and start solving puzzles to build the city of your dreams!

bluejetty:00123239:ios.name: TEXAR Mobile
bluejetty:00123239:ios.summary: The TEXAR App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organize
bluejetty:00123239:ios.description:
The TEXAR App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact TEXAR customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the TEXAR App, you must be enrolled as a TEXAR Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00086815:ios.description:
Brave Brain is a quiz & trivia game that lets you look at familiar and unfamiliar places on the world map, test your knowledge in quizzes and learn lots of interesting facts!
The game is fully blind-friendly and supports VoiceOver.
Choose a country, location or place and try to master the quiz questions. You have 30 seconds to answer and one of the four choices is always correct.
The correct answer will earn you additional coins for the game. Wrong answer? Redeem yourself using diamonds. The more correct answers you get, the higher you climb on the ladder of those who aren't afraid to think.
And when do you win? Whenever you get it right! This quiz & trivia game has no definitive end, just like knowledge of the world. You can go back and expand your horizons whenever you have a moment.
This version of the fun quiz and trivia game has many advantages: a hand painted and beautiful art style, thousands of exciting questions, excellent sound track and sound effects will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the places you visit in the game. And this makes it one of the best free quiz games.
Game Features:
 - Enjoy playing solo or compare your knowledge with others in leaderboards.
 - More than 10000 quiz & trivia questions from all continents and fields of knowledge.
 - The game is completely barrier-free: you can play without sight or hearing! (screen reader VoiceOver is supported)
 - Hand-painted art style.
 - Immersive soundtrack.
 - The game is fully playable in the free version, with money you can buy in-game currency, personal avatars and other bonuses.
Quiz topics:
 - Geography
 - History
 - Politics
 - Culture
 - Sport
 - Science and inventions
 - Technology and engineering
 - Demography
 - Personalities
 - Lifestyle and trends
 - Art history and facts
 - Architecture and landmarks
 - Food and cooking
 - Fashion and popular brands
Got five minutes? Stop scrolling and send your brain on an interesting journey with this quiz & trivia game!

bluejetty:00141083:ios.description:
With Wellance, monitoring your vital signs has never been easier. Let AI assist you in tracking your heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar, and more, providing in-depth health analysis and personalized advice to support daily well-being. Receive actionable insights to build healthy habits and maintain a balanced diet, all tailored to your unique needs. From intelligent tracking to lifestyle recommendations, Wellance is your guide to optimal health.
Health Disclaimer
· This app is intended to promote fitness and is primarily a tool for general health awareness, designed to encourage an active lifestyle.
· It should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The app does not replace certified medical instruments or professional consultations.
· Please be aware that this app is limited to tracking heart rate only; it does not provide capabilities for blood pressure or blood oxygen level monitoring.
· If you have any health-related questions or concerns, please consult a qualified healthcare professional before making health decisions or following suggestions provided by this app.
Measuring Heart Rate: Steps For Accurate Results
1. Hold your phone steadily and make sure you are relaxed.
2. Cover the back camera completely with your fingertip.
3. Stay still throughout the measurement process until it’s complete.
Key Features of Wellance
1. Heart Rate Monitor: Track your heart’s rhythm in real time with heart rate and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) monitoring. Gain insights into how your body responds to stress and daily activities.
2.Blood Pressure and Oxygen Log: Keep track of your manually entered blood pressure and oxygen levels over time for a comprehensive understanding of your cardiovascular health.
3. Blood Sugar Log: Record and monitor your blood sugar triends by entering your own data. This tool helps you stay aware of your glucose levels for better health management.
4. Weight and Calorie Tracker: Log your weight and BMI, along with your daily calorie intake, to maintain a balanced diet and monitor your progress towards your health goals.
5. AI Health Consultant: Get tailored advice from AI-driven health experts based on your health information and personal goals, empowering you to make informed choices about your health.
6. AI Food Scanner: Easily scan your meals to analyze calorie content and nutritional details, while also receiving a personalized AI-generated meal plan tailored to your dietary needs.
7. Calming White Noise: Enjoy calming white noise to help you relax and improve your sleep quality.
8. Apple Watch Integration: Seamlessly connect with Apple Watch to monitor and record your health metrics for more accurate insights.
Subscription Options: Weekly, Monthly, Yearly
1. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account once the purchase is confirmed.
2. After purchase, you can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
3. To avoid auto-renewal, be sure to turn it off at least 24 hours before the current subscription period expires.

bluejetty:00119695:ios.description:
Trax Retail Execution is a solution that provides consumer goods manufacturers and retailers with unprecedented control and optimization of their in-store execution.
Reduce manual auditing time and maximise your sales at every point of sale.
Trax’s breakthrough mobile application is built on cutting edge computer vision algorithms unique to retail. With an advanced camera application, Trax allows the field user to take high quality images of the store shelf, have it sent to our Trax cloud and within minutes the user is sent actionable real-time mobile reports on immediate corrective actions to be taken in the store. The user friendly application delivers a robust range of reporting capabilities such as distribution, share of shelf, out of stocks, promotional presence, planogram compliance and more, with custom reports for both field users and supervisors.
Features also include: automated KPI calculations, task prioritization tools, reports highlighting gaps and opportunities, role-based task lists, targeted questionnaires and surveys, geo-located images, historical store data and offline reporting capabilities.

bluejetty:00171289:ios.description:
Welcome to Dream Hospital: Your Gateway to Healthcare Excellence!
Step into the shoes of a visionary hospital manager in Dream Hospital, where strategy meets compassion. Starting with a modest clinic, your mission is to transform it into a bustling healthcare hub renowned for exceptional care. Balance efficiency and empathy as you expand facilities, upgrade cutting-edge equipment, and design specialized departments to meet every patient’s needs.
Gameplay Features:
Build and Expand: Begin with basic treatment rooms and unlock a variety of facilities, from high-tech operating theaters to cozy maternity wards.
Hire and Train Staff: Recruit talented doctors, nurses, and specialists. Boost their skills through training to ensure top-notch care.
Manage Patients: Cater to a steady flow of patients with diverse ailments. Prioritize, diagnose, and treat them to earn rewards and keep satisfaction high.
Upgrade for Excellence: Invest in state-of-the-art equipment and improve waiting areas for comfort and efficiency.
Strategize Resources: Balance budgets, manage staff schedules, and ensure every department operates like clockwork.
Events and Challenges: Participate in limited-time events and tackle unique challenges to unlock exclusive rewards and rare medical items.
Why You'll Love It:
Every decision you make shapes the future of your hospital. Will you specialize in certain departments or aim for all-around excellence? As you progress, watch your hospital evolve into a beacon of hope and healing. With vibrant visuals, satisfying upgrades, and endless customization options, Dream Hospital promises a fulfilling and immersive experience.
Take charge, save lives, and create your dream healthcare facility in Dream Hospital! Your patients are counting on you. Are you ready to make your mark in medical history?
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

bluejetty:00160599:ios.description:
Take your team's passwords with you wherever you go by downloading Passbolt's open-source mobile app. It offers all the beloved features of the web application, including industry-leading password sharing security, form autofill, plus biometric and multi-factor authentication.
Why choose Passbolt mobile?
- Setting the highest standards in password collaboration security.
- Biometric authentication allows you to log in and access your passwords using fingerprint or facial recognition.
- Secure MFA login is enhanced with NFC-enabled Yubikey support.

A key aspect of this is the secure transfer of private keys from the browser to the app, achieved offline through the scanning of multiple QR codes.
Discover more at passbolt.com.

bluejetty:00098985:ios.description:
Pregnancy test checker that gives you answer.
Our advanced pregnancy test scanner uses cutting-edge computer vision technology to analyze and interpret pregnancy test results with unprecedented precision and reliability.
Key Features:
- Our intelligent pregnancy test checker eliminates guesswork by providing instant readings of both digital and traditional pregnancy tests. The sophisticated algorithms have been trained on thousands of pregnancy test images to ensure reliability.
-Simply photograph your test with our pregnancy test scanner, and receive comprehensive analysis within seconds. The app automatically detects test lines and provides clear, easy-to-understand results that remove any uncertainty from the process.
- The pregnancy test checker works seamlessly with all major pregnancy test brands and formats, making it the universal solution for accurate test interpretation.
How It Works:
- The pregnancy test scanner employs advanced image recognition technology to detect even the faintest test lines that might be difficult to see with the naked eye. This ensures you never miss important results due to lighting conditions or visual limitations.
- Our pregnancy test checker automatically adjusts for various factors including lighting conditions, image quality, and test brand variations to provide the most accurate reading possible. The technology adapts to different environments and situations for consistent performance.
- The app stores your test history securely on your device, allowing you to track changes over time with our comprehensive pregnancy test checker system. This historical data helps you monitor patterns and progress throughout your journey.
Benefits:
- Instant results with elite-grade accuracy mean you get reliable information exactly when you need it. The technology eliminates uncertainty and second-guessing, providing clear answers during an emotionally significant time.
- The pregnancy test scanner works with all major pregnancy test brands, ensuring compatibility regardless of which test you choose to use. This universal compatibility makes it a versatile tool for any situation.
- Your privacy is completely protected with secure, private analysis performed directly on your device. No images or personal information are stored externally, giving you complete control over your sensitive data.
- The app provides 24/7 availability whenever you need it, offering peace of mind and immediate answers at any time of day or night. Historical tracking and timeline features help you understand your reproductive health journey over time.
Whether you're trying to conceive or monitoring your reproductive health, our pregnancy test scanner provides the confidence and clarity you need during this important time. The combination of advanced AI technology and user-friendly design makes accurate test interpretation accessible to everyone.
Download today and experience the future of at-home pregnancy testing with our state-of-the-art pregnancy test checker technology. Join thousands of users who trust our app for reliable, instant pregnancy test analysis.
Note: The functionality of AI scanning and test analyssis requires active subscription.
Note: This app is designed to assist with test interpretation but should not replace professional medical consultation. AI can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.

Privacy Policy: https://pregnancytestchecker.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00137262:ios.summary: Stay connected to the heart of Marietta and Cobb County with the official Marietta Daily Journal app! As your most trusted and comprehensive local news source for over 150 years, we deliver the latest updates, award-winning in-depth reporti
bluejetty:00137262:ios.description:
Stay connected to the heart of Marietta and Cobb County with the official Marietta Daily Journal app! As your most trusted and comprehensive local news source for over 150 years, we deliver the latest updates, award-winning in-depth reporting, and vital community information directly to your device, keeping you informed, engaged, and empowered.
What You'll Get:
• Unparalleled Local News Coverage: Receive real-time access to breaking news from Marietta, Kennesaw, Smyrna, Acworth, Austell, Powder Springs, Mableton, and every corner of Cobb County. Our dedicated team of experienced journalists provides thorough coverage of local government decisions, education advancements, business developments, public safety alerts, transportation news, and the impactful human-interest stories that define our community.
• Instant Breaking News Alerts: Be the first to know with customizable push notifications. Get alerted to major developing stories, urgent updates, and important local events as they happen. You control the types of alerts you receive, ensuring you get the news that matters most to you.
• Complete Sports Reporting: Your ultimate source for local sports! Follow your favorite Cobb County high school teams with extensive game coverage, up-to-the-minute scores, detailed stats, and exciting highlights. We also keep you updated on Kennesaw State University (KSU) Owls athletics and other regional sports relevant to our community.
• Vibrant Community Connection: Discover what’s happening with our comprehensive local events calendar, explore arts and entertainment news, and read features on the people and organizations making a difference in Marietta. Engage with insightful opinion pieces, thought-provoking editorials, and letters to the editor that foster vibrant community discussion. Access daily obituaries to honor and remember the lives of those in our community.
• Rich Multimedia Experience: Go beyond the headlines. Immerse yourself in local stories with our stunning photo galleries and compelling video reports, bringing the news and events of Cobb County to life.
• Optimized User Experience: 
o Intuitive Navigation: Enjoy a clean, user-friendly interface designed for an effortless mobile reading experience. Easily browse sections, search for specific articles, and find what you need quickly.
o Customizable Reading: Adjust font sizes for maximum comfort.
o Offline Access: Save articles to read later, even when you're offline or have a poor internet connection. Perfect for your commute or when you're on the go.
o Seamless Sharing: Share important articles, captivating photos, and informative videos with friends, family, and colleagues via email, text message, or your favorite social media platforms with just a tap.
• E-Edition Access: Subscribers can enjoy the Marietta Daily Journal e-edition – a digital replica of the printed newspaper – right within the app. Flip through the pages, read familiar layouts, and access archived editions. (A Marietta Daily Journal subscription may be required for premium content and full e-edition access).
Free to download. https://www.mdjonline.com/site/terms.html

bluejetty:00127008:ios.description:
Open any text, source code, config, or log file on your iPhone or iPad in seconds — even when iOS Mail or the Files app says the format is unsupported.
Whether someone just emailed you a server .log, a .yaml deployment config, a .cfg or .ini file, or a Python/JSON script, myTextViewer opens it cleanly with offline syntax highlighting, line numbers, and instant in-file search.
No accounts. No cloud uploads. And zero ads while you are reading a file.
WHY DEVELOPERS, SYSADMINS & POWER USERS KEEP IT INSTALLED
• Opens Anything Text-Based — Unknown or non-standard file extensions (.log, .cfg, .conf, .diag, .env, .ini, .dat, .sql, .md, .toml, and more) open directly as readable text instead of hitting an "unsupported file" dead end.
• 100% Offline Syntax Highlighting — Automatic syntax coloring for Python, JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, C/C++, C#, Java, Ruby, Shell scripts, SQL, and more. Use the toolbar menu (‹/›) to switch languages or view as Plain Text, remembered automatically per file extension.
• Formatted View for JSON, Markdown & HTML — One tap pretty-prints minified JSON (keys and numbers kept exactly as written), renders Markdown documents, and shows HTML attachments as a page with scripts turned off. The raw text is always one tap away.
• Log & YAML Highlighting — ERROR, WARN, INFO, and timestamps stand out in .log files, and YAML configs get proper coloring. Binary .plist files open as readable XML.
• Fast In-File Search — Jump straight to the error or config key you need with live match counting ("3 of 12") and next/previous navigation.
• Your File Library on the Home Screen — Every file you open is saved to your searchable home screen library so you can reopen it anytime with a single tap, or tap "+" to import files directly from the Files app.
• Comfortable Reading Anywhere — Switch between Light, Dark, and System appearance in place without losing your scroll position. Toggle line numbers and pinch-to-zoom with a tap.
• Smart Encoding & Large File Support — Cleanly reads UTF-8, UTF-16, BOM-prefixed logs, Windows-1252, and multi-megabyte log files without garbled characters or freezes.
• 100% On-Device Privacy — Your files never leave your device. Decoding, syntax highlighting, and search run entirely locally on your iPhone or iPad. Rendered HTML and Markdown load no remote images until you tap Load, so tracking pixels stay silent.
TWO EASY WAYS TO OPEN A FILE
1. From Mail, Files, Slack, or Messages: Tap Share on any attachment or file and choose myTextViewer. It opens right away and stays in your library for next time.
2. Directly Inside myTextViewer: Tap "+" in the top-right corner of the home screen to pick and open any file from your device or iCloud Drive.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

• Log & YAML Highlighting — ERROR, WARN, INFO, and timestamps stand out in .log files, and YAML configs get proper coloring. Binary .plist files open as readable XML.
• Fast In-File Search — Jump straight to the error or config key you need with live match counting ("3 of 12") and next/previous navigation.
• Your File Library on the Home Screen — Every file you open is saved to your searchable home screen library so you can reopen it anytime with a single tap, or tap "+" to import files directly from the Files app.
• Comfortable Reading Anywhere — Switch between Light, Dark, and System appearance in place without losing your scroll position. Toggle line numbers and pinch-to-zoom with a tap.
• Smart Encoding & Large File Support — Cleanly reads UTF-8, UTF-16, BOM-prefixed logs, Windows-1252, and multi-megabyte log files without garbled characters or freezes.
• 100% On-Device Privacy — Your files never leave your device. Decoding, syntax highlighting, and search run entirely locally on your iPhone or iPad. Rendered HTML and Markdown load no remote images until you tap Load, so tracking pixels stay silent.

Be the first to know about breaking news, weather updates, and top stories in Cincinnati and the surrounding area. With the WLWT News 5 app, you’ll have real-time news, sports highlights, traffic alerts, and entertainment updates – all at your fingertips. DOWNLOAD NOW AND STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR COMMUNITY.

bluejetty:00129574:ios.description:
Word Pizza is a very interesting, colourful and exciting game while being completely free.
A new word puzzle game, where you need to create words from the letters placed in a circle.
This game will enlarge your vocabulary, and improve your spelling skills and concentration.
HOW TO PLAY
• In this game, you need to look for words and create them from the letters provided.
• Words can be assembled by dragging a line in any direction
• Just swipe over the letters to make a word
• If you have highlighted the correct word, it will appear on the answer board
• The goal of the game is to find all the hidden words.
It sounds very simple, but the difficulty increases with every level, so our word game won't let you get bored.
COOKING THEME
• You cook pizza and travel in the game, by completing the levels
• There are many stylish awards from 15 countries around the world, try to collect them all.
• Decorate your kitchen
• Run away from the paparazzi
• Nice and calm game atmosphere
WHAT IS INTERESTING ABOUT THE GAME
• Find and learn words by highlighting them.
• Free hints at the start
• Develop your mind and vocabulary
• Play and compete with friends
• Ratings and achievements
• Play on your mobile or tablet
• It's a great brain trainer.
NO TIME LIMIT
You can close or minimize the application at any time and then continue from where you stopped, without losing any level progress.
LOTS OF LEVELS
15 countries and more than 2,000 levels await you in the game.
The levels are designed to increase in difficulty, so you'll feel your skills and knowledge growing.
MANY LANGUAGES
The following languages are fully supported:
• English
• Spanish
• German
• Italian
• French
• Portuguese
• Russian
NO INTERNET CONNECTION REQUIRED
No wifi? No problem! The game works without an Internet connection, which makes it a great time killer while you travel. Nevertheless, an Internet connection is required to synchronize your progress so that it can be restored through social networks.
Find us on social media:
https://www.facebook.com/Word-Pizza-130262024301646/
https://vk.com/wordpizza
Good luck in the game!

In today’s fast-paced world, mental health and focus are crucial. MINDMOD™ helps transform your mind using mindfulness, meditation, and neuroplasticity techniques, allowing you to rewire your subconscious, build positive beliefs, and overcome barriers.

• Meditation & Hypnosis: Tailored audios for boosting confidence, relaxation, and business growth. MINDMOD’s audios help you reach a state of deep relaxation, where your mind becomes receptive to positive change.

• Confidence & Personal Development: Build the mindset needed to excel in life with tools that help you overcome self-doubt and develop self-assurance.
• Focus & Mental Clarity: Enhance concentration, mental clarity, and stay on track with MINDMOD’s focused audios.
• Money & Business: Cultivate the mindset for financial success with audios focused on business growth, entrepreneurship, and financial abundance.
How MINDMOD™ Works:
MINDMOD™ combines expert guidance with the science of neuroplasticity, hypnosis, and meditation. Our audios guide you into deep relaxation, making your mind receptive to positive suggestions. Consistent use rewires your brain and shifts your mindset.

Choose Your Audio: Browse our library and select an audio aligned with your goals.
Listen & Engage: Find a quiet space, immerse yourself in the audio.

bluejetty:00136044:ios.name: RUN interval - Running Timer
bluejetty:00136044:ios.summary: Easily set up and record your Interval and Fartlek running sessions. With the flexibility of using time and/or distance as interval targets for your "Hard", "Easy" and "Rest" efforts. The simple but highly configurable interface on your pho
bluejetty:00136044:ios.description:
Easily set up and record your Interval and Fartlek running sessions. With the flexibility of using time and/or distance as interval targets for your "Hard", "Easy" and "Rest" efforts. The simple but highly configurable interface on your phone and watch will have you running sooner.
Now with a Distance Goal option for your session. Along with great audio and visual feedback, detailed post-run summary, share your runs to Strava, and a full-featured Apple Watch app.
You can also record your regular runs with voice-over calling out distance and pace feedback.
Key Features:
• Easily create flexible custom interval sessions.
• Utilize three effort targets "Hard", "Easy" and "Rest" in each set, targeting time or distance (meters or miles).
• You can "Skip" any of the three efforts to create flexible sets, like building a progressive intervals session.
• NEW: Set a Distance Goal for your session, that repeats the sets from the start until the distance has been reached.
• Set a Warm-Up and Warm-Down timer or distance around your session.
• Clear and easily glanceable visuals and audio prompts, including vibrations.
• Voice-over prompts to save you from looking at the screen, great for iPhone or headphone users.
• Voice-over prompts include the upcoming intervals effort and time/distance amount, and your last intervals average pace and heart rate.
• Full-featured Apple Watch App!
• Heart Rate Zones! (see description below)
• Indoor Mode, no GPS, for treadmill running.
• Sound Mode, for normal, discrete or silent audio prompts on your watch.
• Vibration feedback on both the phone and watch.
• Detailed run summary, showing pace for hard and easy efforts.
• The run summary also includes interval breakdown, distance breakdown and heart rate details.
• Play music or podcasts while running and still hear the audio prompts.
• Sharing. Share a summary photo with your friends.
• Private data. We don’t send any of your data to a server or share it with anyone.
Session Types:
• Normal Run – Record a normal run, long or short.
• Record Intervals – If you run with a group or do an undefined session, then use the Record Interval option. It allows you to manually change between "Hard" and "Easy" reps, allowing you to record your session.
• Custom Intervals – Our fully flexible intervals that allow you to use time and/or distance for the efforts. Add multiple intervals sets together to create the session you want.
Sharing:
From the summary screen, you can share your runs with friends or across social media. If you want to share directly with friends or across other social media, you can share a summary image with the details of your run.
Heart Rate Zones: (Apple Watch Only)
Zones are displayed as grouped percentages of your maximum heart rate. Giving you an indication of your current work rate based on your current heart rate. Just enter your maximum workout heart rate into our Settings screen and they will display on your Watch the next time you run.
Zone 1: Very Light Effort 50-60% (Gray)
Zone 2: Light Effort 60-70% (Blue)
Zone 3: Moderate Effort 70-80% (Green)
Zone 4: Hard Effort 80-90% (Yellow)
Zone 5: Maximum Effort 90-100% (Red)
Privacy:
We don’t want to know where you have run, that's for you to worry about. We don’t send any of your data to a server or share it with anyone you don't want too. We keep your running records safe in Apple Health so you have control. Apple Heath gives you the control over who accesses your data. We only write and read the data we record from your running.
Feedback:
And because we don't send any data to a server, we need you to send us feedback and suggestions. Hit the Support link below or visit our website to contact us.

bluejetty:00024713:ios.description:
Tick Tack Toe glow is a free classic puzzle game, also known as Noughts and Crosses. It is the best digital edition of the classic paper-and-pencil game that anyone & everyone can play online or offline.
Get more childlike innocence, Get more joy! Revisit the classics, great Happiness. If you are an adult get your favorite childhood memories of Tic Tac Toe which you may play physically.
Tic Tac Toe Game features:
- Play in your iPhone and iPad. Or play with your friends & family - Singleplayer & Multiplayer support
- Various options of ‘rows x columns’ grid - 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 8x8
- Perfect software-based Artificial Intelligence (AI) within the game. That decides the difficulty for you, as you continue to play.
- Custom place mark (X or O) options - ‘align’. It’s not that easy to win!
- Easy to play hard to master gameplay
- Elegant fresh screen with glowing designs
HOW TO PLAY?
- Two players alternate, marking one empty space (box) at a time.
- The player attempts to placemarks (X or O) in a sequence, unlike an SOS game. It can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal (slantwise). Make 3, 4, 5, or 8 scores (as decided by you).
- The player who makes the most sequences (either of Os or Xs) WINS! 
Not everyone can beat the AI engine, can you? Try single-player mode and level up your logical thinking & brain skills! 
The AI for this puzzle game is one of the best you will see. It adapts to your playing style and is very unpredictable. The most played game is sometimes also known as X and O, and “Cat's Game”.
That’s everyone can enjoy the game at any time and anywhere! Because of the simplicity of this Tic Tac Toe, it is often used as a pedagogical tool. For teaching the concepts of good sportsmanship and the branch of artificial intelligence. It’s easy to play, easier to experience the challenge!
Tic Tac Toe have different names:
- X & O
- O-X OR X-O
- Tick-tack-toe in the US and Canada.
- Naughts & crosses or noughts and crosses in Asia (India, Pakistan, etc), Europe (United Kingdom, Germany, etc), South Africa, New Zealand, and Australia.
- Xs and Os in Zimbabwe and the Republic of Ireland.
- Ultimate tic-tac-toe in some african countries.
- xsie-osies or Exy-ozys in Northern Ireland.
Start playing this glowing Tic Tac Toe game on your iPhone & iPad.
Get Free Tick Tack Toe now and let the fun begin! Be a challenger!
DOWNLOAD and play tic tac toe NOW!

bluejetty:00089731:ios.name: Speak Spanish: Palteca
bluejetty:00089731:ios.summary:
Learn Spanish the way your brain was meant to.
Palteca uses teaching methods that are rooted in science, making it one of the most effective ways to quickly learn and speak Spanish. Unlike the majority of the language learning apps on the
bluejetty:00089731:ios.description:
Learn Spanish the way your brain was meant to.
Palteca uses teaching methods that are rooted in science, making it one of the most effective ways to quickly learn and speak Spanish. Unlike the majority of the language learning apps on the market today that try to offer a tiny bit of many languages, Palteca offers an in-depth learning experience for Spanish.
---------------------------
THE PALTECA METHOD
1. WATCH REAL NATIVE SPEAKERS: Palteca uses Comprehensible Input (CI), giving you content that is entirely in Spanish spoken by real speakers in real conversations. Our curriculum is built to teach you the most important words first, and over the course of the following days/weeks, continue to reinforce these same words through repeated exposure. This makes remembering much easier
2. SPEAK FROM DAY 1: Get instant feedback so you can begin speaking confidently, while responding to real native Spanish speakers
3. TRAIN YOUR EARS: The sounds in Spanish are different from English and other languages. So we will teach you how to distinguish between similar-sounding words, giving you the ability to better listen to native speakers
4. LEARN HOW TO LEARN A LANGUAGE: Palteca starts by getting you ready to learn how to learn a language. Many people try to learn languages through apps, but grow bored and frustrated when they realize the method isn’t working. Palteca gives you the roadmap to Spanish fluency in and out of the app
---------------------------
PALTECA FEATURES
* Learn only useful vocabulary and phrases
* Practice speaking with real-time feedback 
* Practice listening to real Spanish natives
* Hundreds of activities from speaking, practicing numbers, sounds, and more
* Listen to different accents
---------------------------
PALTECA MEMBERSHIP
A subscription is required to access Palteca. Palteca offers both monthly and annual subscriptions. Once purchased, the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled in your Apple App Store account. When a subscription is canceled, access to Palteca will expire at the end of the current payment period. Refunds will not be given for any unused portion of the term. 
---------------------------
Have questions or need assistance? Contact us at hello@palteca.com.
---------------------------
Terms of Service: https://palteca.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://palteca.com/privacy

Unlock the celestial mysteries of the night sky with Moon Phase, your comprehensive lunar calendar and astrology companion.

Dive into a world of celestial timekeeping. Our lunar calendar provides you with detailed information on the current moon phase, zodiac sign, and lunar events. Never miss a New Moon or Full Moon again!

Moon Sign & Astrology: Unearth the influence of the moon on your life. Find your moon sign and explore its profound impact on your emotions, personality, and destiny.

World Moon Map: Explore the moon phases around the globe. Understand how the lunar cycle affects different regions and cultures worldwide.

Join a vibrant community of moon enthusiasts and stargazers and embark on a celestial journey that'll deepen your connection to the cosmos.

Moon Phase is your go-to lunar calendar and astrology app, helping you sync with the universe, one moon phase at a time.

Download now and let the moonlight guide you!

bluejetty:00167515:ios.description:
"Hello!!" *kawaii otter noises*
Collect the cute otter family
Are otter’s just the oceans’ hamsters? They’re playful, fuzzy, and fit in the palm of your hand (at least in this kawaii game app!). Go on a scavenger hunt to find more members of the cute tamagotchi kawaii family. If you like adventure games with a treasure hunt where you can train your pet animals - Otter Ocean is just for you. 
Make their oasis a paradise 
Relax in an ocean oasis with your cute, kawaii otter friends, and become an OTTER-worldly explorer of the ocean’s mysteries from the beach to OTTER-space! This is one of the relaxing games with tamagotchi animals you have to try!
Find treasures - it's kawaii adventure time
Otter Ocean is a passive and relaxing experience, where you collet adorable kawaii otters as tamagotchi pet animals by going on a treasure hunt. Feed and train them to become master divers, and build your dream kingdom of mysterious otters! Otter Ocean is one of the kawaii games you should try!
Go on a scavenger hunt in the ocean
Come back every day for your adventure time! collect tasty foods and shiny pearls gathered by your otter friends, and continue discovering new otters, hidden secrets and new worlds your otters can explore! Relaxing games are amazing when there is cute tamagotchi pet animals waiting for you every day.
Join a community of millions
Join our community and millions of players around the world who love adventure games with an element of scavenger hunt. Play with your friends and have your adventure time together. Uncover the mysteries and treasures that lay in the sunken ship, deep below the Otter Islands! 
OTTER OCEAN – FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS:
- If you are a fan of relaxing games come and collect cute otter family.
- Go on a scavenger hunt with all of your otter pet animals.
- Pet, feed and train your cuddly, furry (and hungry!) otter friends.
- Just like the little tamagotchi animals, you will have to take care of your otter.
- Watch as they dive on a scavenger hunt to rescue mystery treasures with cute animations.
- Discover the secrets of the deep ocean by going on a treasure hunt, and complete the collection of underwater artefacts.
- Clean the ocean and restore life to the coral reefs.
- New content added every week. This is one of the cute kawaii games & adventure games with pet animals!
- Special events let you earn exclusive otters and prizes during your adventure time.
DOWNLOAD THE OTTER OCEAN TODAY!
Are you enjoying Otter Ocean? Don’t forget to join our community of kawaii games lovers! Let's go on a treasure hunt together!

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/Otter.Ocean

Privacy policy: https://www.finifugu.games/privacy-policy

Welcome to the world of Legendary and Me
bluejetty:00172172:ios.description:
PokeRaid is the best platform to join Worldwide Pokémon GO Raids. More than 1.000.000 Remote Raids have already been hosted around the world since the very beginning of the Remote Raid announcement.
Welcome to the world of Legendary and Mega Raids. Trainers host and join remote raids every hour of every day! Just join PokeRaid and start battling on Remote Raids, no matter where you are.
Break the language barrier! PokeRaid supports English, Japanese and Korean. Communicate with other trainers using integrated translation service. We will be adding more and more languages soon!
How to Join a Remote Raid using PokeRaid?
- Make sure that you have a Remote Raid Pass
- Find an Active Raid Room and Join. Friendship code of the host trainer is copied to your clipboard automatically.
- Open the game and add the host as friend
- Notify other trainers when you are ready, return to the game and wait for a raid invitation
- Join the raid battle and beat the boss!
- Thank everyone in the room and give a rating to the host.
How to host a Remote Raid using PokeRaid?
- Find a raid around you and take a screenshot of the raid
- Create a Raid Room in PokeRaid and upload your screenshot
- Wait for trainers to join your room
- Return to game, accept friendship requests
- Notify other trainers when you are about to start the raid battle
- Start the raid and invite all trainers and beat the boss
- Don’t forget to thank to your guests and give their ratings!
Location privacy
We respect your privacy. Therefore we do not share your location with other trainers.
DISCLAIMER
PokeRaid is a third party application to help nearby trainers to get in touch with each other. It is not affiliated with the Pokémon GO, Niantic, Nintendo or The Pokémon Company.

Please visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

App Store Rewind 2011 -- Best Education App
“If you'
bluejetty:00015709:ios.description:
SkyView® brings stargazing to everyone. Simply point your iPhone, iPad, or iPod at the sky to identify stars, constellations, planets, satellites, and more!
Over 3.2 million downloads.
App Store Rewind 2011 -- Best Education App
“If you've ever wanted to know what you're looking at in the night sky, this app is the perfect stargazer's companion.” 
– CNET 
"If you’ve ever been looking for a stargazing app for your iPhone, then this [is] definitely the one to get." 
– AppAdvice 
“SkyView is an Augmented Reality app that lets you see just what delights the sky has to offer.” 
– 148Apps Editor’s Choice
You don't need to be an astronomer to find stars or constellations in the sky, just open SkyView® and let it guide you to their location and identify them. SkyView® is a beautiful and intuitive stargazing app that uses your camera to precisely spot and identify celestial objects in sky, day or night. Find all 88 constellations as they fade in and out while you scan across the sky, locate every planet in our solar system, discover distant galaxies, and witness satellite fly-bys.
Features: 
• Simple: Point your device at the sky to identify galaxies, stars, constellations, planets, and satellites (including the ISS and Hubble) passing overhead at your location.
• Sighting Events: schedule alerts for upcoming celestial events.
• Apple Watch: see what objects are visible tonight and how to spot them using your Apple Watch.
• Today Widget: brand new iOS 8 today widget lets you quickly see upcoming celestial events.
• Night Mode: Preserve your night vision with red or green night mode filters.
• Augmented Reality (AR): Use your camera to spot objects in the sky, day or night.
• Sky Paths: Follow the sky track for any object to see it’s exact location in the sky on any date and time.
• Comprehensive: Includes thousands of stars, planets, and satellites with thousands of interesting facts.
• Time Travel: Jump to the future or the past and see the sky on different dates and times.
• Social: Capture and share beautiful images with friends and family on social networks. 
• Mobile: WiFi is NOT required (does not require a data signal or GPS to function). Take it camping, boating, or even flying!
What a fun way to teach yourself, your children, your students, or your friends about our wonderful universe!

bluejetty:00090731:ios.description:
Create stunning cover art for your Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, playlists, tracks, albums, and podcasts effortlessly in under a minute with SpotiPlus. 
Crafted by music enthusiasts, SpotiPlus is the ultimate tool to help you organize and enhance the visual appeal of your Spotify experience.
Discover a wide range of design styles tailored to your musical preferences, from Rock to Hip Hop and everything in between. Whether it's Rap caviar, Top pop, or KEXP's Song Of The Day, SpotiPlus has got you covered. Don't wait any longer – try it out today!
___
SpotiPlus will help you attract followers and boost streams by designing professional cover arts for your Spotify playlists.
If you're lacking time or inspiration to make better Spotify playlist covers, we got your back. We offer 100% free templates to start from and customize to match your playlist style.
Key Features:
- No design skills required – an easy-to-use interface for effortless cover art creation.
- Design your own custom images or import existing ones.
- Instantly export your cover art directly to Spotify.
- Download your cover art as a high-quality JPEG for future publishing.
- Choose from a diverse selection of built-in styles to match your unique taste.
- Utilize a powerful editor with customizable fonts, colors, and alignment options.
How To use
1 - Launch the SpotiPlus app.
2 - Select your preferred style.
3 - Make your edits and tap "Done" when finished.
4 - Choose a playlist from your Spotify account and apply the new cover.
5 - Boom! Your playlist cover has been transformed and is now visible to your followers.
Support and Contact
We value your feedback and are eager to hear your thoughts and feature suggestions. Feel free to reach out to us at 7tapsContact@gmail.com to report bugs, share your ideas, or simply say hello.

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Permissions
SpotiPlus utilizes the Spotify API to access both public and private user playlists, enabling seamless remote cover changes within the app. Please note that SpotiPlus is not affiliated with Spotify.
Get ready to captivate your audience, attract more followers, and amplify your streams with SpotiPlus. Upgrade your Spotify playlist covers now!

bluejetty:00124225:ios.description:
Rediscover Snood, the original puzzle classic that has challenged and entertained players since 1996. Whether you played Snood on the family computer, in a school computer lab, or are meeting the Snoods for the first time, the classic gameplay is back on iPhone and iPad.
SAVE THE SNOODS
Launch colorful Snoods into the playing field and connect three or more matching characters to make them disappear. Any Snoods left unattached from the top of the board will fall to safety.
Every shot raises the danger level, so aim carefully and plan ahead. Snood rewards strategy, accuracy, and clever angles, not just quick reflexes.
NEW REASONS TO PLAY EVERY DAY
Take on a new Daily Challenge, build your streak, track your win rate, and see how consistently you can save the Snoods.
FEATURES
• Classic Snood gameplay from the 90s
• Strategic match-3 bubble-shooter puzzles
• Daily Challenges with streak and win-rate tracking
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Increasingly challenging Puzzle Mode boards
• The original precision aimer for tricky shots and tight spaces
• Helpful boosters to enhance gameplay
• Customizable backgrounds
• Leaderboards for comparing scores
Snood is free to download and play. Optional in-game purchases are available.
Questions, feedback, or suggestions? Contact snood@snood.com.
Forget Life. Play SNOOD!

bluejetty:00063626:ios.description:
LEGO® Star Wars™: The Complete Saga is available on iOS for the first time! 
***Episode I Story Mode is FREE for a limited time.***
**Episodes II – VI and other content available via in-app purchases.**
Experience the entire collection that combines the original LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game and the sequel LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy for hours of epic Star Wars content and fun gameplay all from your iOS device! Begin your adventure in Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace and journey through all six episodes in the whimsical style and humor of LEGO. May the bricks be with you!
This game is filled with content! You’ll need 1.44gb of available space on your device if you install over wifi, but only 735mb of space if you download on your computer and then sync. 
As with many large app installations, we advise that you restart your device after installing as this will resolve some stability issues. Also make sure you have installed the most recent firmware.
When re-installing the App, please select ‘Restore All Purchases’ from the main menu and allow a few moments to ensure your purchases have become active.
This is a high memory usage app. If you have performance issues, try closing down background apps or restarting the device.
FEATURES:
36 STORY MODE LEVELS + BONUS CONTENT 
From the Trade Federation’s “negotiations” with Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn in The Phantom Menace to the space battle above Endor in Return of the Jedi, play the most memorable and exhilarating scenes from your favorite episodes. Also unlock special bonus content featuring Bounty Hunter missions, a special Challenge Mode, Arcade Levels, and more! 
OVER 120 CHARACTERS
Play as your favorite Jedi Knight or Sith Lord! There are over 120 playable characters to unlock, including Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, Han Solo, and Boba Fett. 
FORCE POWERS
Which side of the Force will you use? Both dark and light side characters have their own unique Force abilities. Will you use a Force Throw to defeat the Jedi or choose your Lightsaber and Force Push to take down the evil Empire?
LEGO STYLE GAMEPLAY
Smash objects into LEGO bricks and switch characters on the fly as you play through different story levels. Create your own Star Wars character mash-ups like Han Windu and Lando Amidala! 
DYNAMIC CONTROL STYLES
Switch between “Classic” and “Touch Screen” controls to find the play-style that suits you best.
If you enjoy LEGO games, be sure to check out LEGO Batman: DC Super Heroes, LEGO The Lord of the Rings, LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4 and Years 5-7, and LEGO Friends.

bluejetty:00146087:ios.summary:
Spiritual Me® is a mindfulness and meditation app that helps you check in with how you feel, breathe, reflect, and reconnect through calming, nature-inspired sessions.
WHAT IS SPIRITUAL ME?
Spiritual Me is built around one simple idea: st
bluejetty:00146087:ios.description:
Spiritual Me® is a mindfulness and meditation app that helps you check in with how you feel, breathe, reflect, and reconnect through calming, nature-inspired sessions.
WHAT IS SPIRITUAL ME?
Spiritual Me is built around one simple idea: start with how you feel.
Instead of opening into a large meditation library, every session begins with a quick emotional check-in. From there, the app guides you into calming breathwork and a session shaped by your mood.
The goal is simple. Pause. Notice what is happening within. Return to yourself with more calm, clarity, and presence.
HOW IT WORKS
Every session follows one gentle arc:
• Feel — check in with your current feeling
• Breathe — shift into calm with guided breathing
• Reflect — notice what stands out in the moment
• Reconnect — close with quiet awareness
You can follow a Guided Routine or choose the exercises that feel right for you — including a 2 minute meditation when that is all you have. No pressure. No streaks. No endless browsing. Just a calmer way back to yourself.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Start with a mood-based check-in
• Calm your mind with guided breathing
• Explore Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, and Peace
• Follow a Guided Routine or choose individual exercises
• Practice meditation and body awareness
• Express yourself through drawing
• Explore interactive symbolic practices
• Use calming Fidgets like mazes and stacking
• Add optional spiritual book reflections
• Return to Journey for quiet observations
• Save mindful minutes to Apple Health
• Set gentle daily reminders
WHO IT IS FOR
Spiritual Me is for anyone who feels stressed, anxious, overwhelmed, distracted, emotionally tired, or spiritually disconnected. It is also for quieter moments when you simply want to pause, breathe, and reconnect.
It can support:
• Daily mindfulness and meditation
• Stress relief
• Guided breathing and breathwork
• Self-reflection and emotional awareness
• Inner calm and a peaceful daily reset
• Optional spiritual reflection
EXPLORE THE FULL EXPERIENCE
A Spiritual Me subscription unlocks the complete experience, including Guided Routine, Choose Exercises, Body Awareness, Drawing, Fidgets, symbolic practices, Journey, and optional spiritual reflection.
Eligible new subscribers can begin with a 14-day free trial. Availability, pricing, renewal terms, and billing details are shown before purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings on the App Store after purchase.
SPIRITUAL, BUT NEVER FORCED
Spiritual Me includes optional spiritual reflections from texts you choose. Use it as a mindfulness and meditation app, or go deeper with spiritual reflection when it feels right.
A CALMER ALTERNATIVE TO MEDITATION LIBRARIES
Many meditation apps ask you to choose from endless courses, playlists, teachers, sounds, and streaks.
Spiritual Me takes a simpler approach. Start with how you feel, then follow a Guided Routine or choose the exercises that meet you in the moment.
A NOTE ON CARE
Spiritual Me is designed to support daily calm, mindfulness, breathing, self-reflection, and emotional awareness. It is not a therapy app or medical treatment. If you are in crisis or need mental health support, please contact a qualified professional or local support service.
Privacy Policy: https://spiritualme.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://spiritualme.com/terms
Spiritual Me is a registered trademark.

bluejetty:00064458:ios.description:
1001 TVs lets you cast your phone or tablet to Windows, Mac, Smart TV, Apple TV—even a web browser. You can also receive screen mirroring from other phones and PCs.
We are a professional team on screen mirroring, always focus on the core features:
[New Feature] TV Remote Control — Auto-detect Smart TVs on the same Wi-Fi and control Power / Volume / Home / Channels / Direction pad (Up/Down/Left/Right) + Select/Confirm.
- Support landscape mode and portrait mode that keep same ratio with phone's screen
- Real-Time screen mirroring, keep best balance with low Latency and good quality
- Audio and video stay perfectly in sync
- Mirror multiple phones to one PC at the same time
- Automatically rotates screen to match your phone’s orientation
- Fit, Fill, or Zoom mode to remove black borders
- Support screen mirroring to older devices that don't support AirPlay or Miracast
- Mirror to any browser (like Chrome) — no app needed on the receiver side
- Live Camera Mirroring — mirror what your camera sees to a big screen in real time. Great for selfies, support mirror flip
- Whiteboard — draw or write and share in real time on TV or PC
Also provide additional features:
* Photo Albums — Upload and display photos on your TV
* Web Streaming — Stream videos, music, and images to Smart TVs
* Fast File Transfer — Quickly send files between devices without cables
How to Get Started?
# Install 1001 TVs on your phone and the device you want to cast to (PC, TV or tablet)
# Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network
# Open the app, select a device, and start mirroring
No cables, no complicated setup — just tap and go.
[Feedback]
Reach out to us at 1001tvs@nero.com or visit our website: www.1001tvs.com
[Subscription Plan]
-Service Title: Auto-renew Weekly, Auto-renew Monthly, Auto-renew Yearly and Lifetime;
-Your payment will be charged to your store account once you confirm the purchase;
-Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period;
-You can always cancel the subscription through your store account;
[Terms of Use]
http://1001tvs.com/license/en/terms.html
[Privacy Policy]
http://1001tvs.com/license/en/privacy.html
For privacy, screen casting data remains within your local network and will never be uploaded.

bluejetty:00179584:ios.description:
Struggling to get your little one to drift off?
Sleep Baby Sleep is designed to help your baby fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer. Using familiar, high-quality soothing sounds, the app creates a calming environment that masks background noise and mimics the comforting sounds of the womb.
Simple & Effective
With a clean, one-tap design and a beautiful new "dreamy" interface, you can instantly start the white noise that works best for your baby. No complicated settings—just immediate relief for busy parents.
6 Soothing Sounds Included:
• Electric Fan: Constant, rhythmic air flow.
• Hair Dryer: Warm, consistent hum.
• Vacuum Cleaner: A classic favorite for deep sleep.
• Clothes Dryer: Gentle, tumbling vibrations.
• Running Water: Calm and natural.
• Heartbeat: Gentle and rhythmic sounds for maximum comfort.
Key Features:
• One-Tap Start: Quickly get the soothing started when you need it most.
• Sleep Timer: Set a duration and let the sound gently fade out.
• Purchase Extras: Unlock the ability to Remove Ads and Enable Background Play, allowing you to keep the sounds running with the screen locked or while using other apps.
• Global Support: Now available in 16 languages to help parents everywhere.
Whether it’s nap time or a difficult night, Sleep Baby Sleep is here to help you and your baby get the rest you deserve.
Sweet Dreams!

Turn everyday photos into expressive black-and-white images with B&W Retro Photo Editor.
Start from your camera or photo library, choose a monochrome look, fine-tune the image, and save the finished photo to Photos. The app is designed for quick black-and-white editing, while still giving you useful tools for shaping the final image.

You can also adjust the details after applying a look. Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, and tone. Crop or rotate the photo for a better composition. Use Blur & Focus to draw attention to the subject. Add text, frames, or stickers when you want a more creative finish.

- Camera and photo library support
- Noir, silver, matte, film-style, warm mono, and cool mono moods
- Brightness, contrast, saturation, and tone adjustments
- Crop, rotate, blur, focus, text, frames, and stickers
- Save edited photos to your photo library
B&W Retro Photo Editor is made for people who want a simple, focused way to create black-and-white photos without a complicated editing workflow. Choose a photo, apply a mood, refine the details, and save your finished image.

*Find your voice with Astound*
Speaking with confidence doesn't come naturally to most of us. Whether it's leading a meeting, pitching an idea, teaching a class, or recording a podcast — your voice carries more weight than you think.

Most users notice a real shift within just a few days of practice: greater calm, more confidence, stronger presence. With daily recordings, you can hear your own progress as it happens.
We know speaking can feel nerve-racking — even when it's not a big stage. That shaky feeling before you present? You're not alone. Astound helps you turn those nerves into calm energy and presence.
*Our approach is different*
Instead of obsessing over filler words, we focus on how your voice makes you — and your listeners — feel. You'll learn to breathe with intention, speak with authenticity, and adapt your voice to fit any room.
With 100+ bite-sized exercises, guided breathing techniques, voice recordings, affirmations, and progress tracking, daily practice becomes simple, approachable, and even something to look forward to.
Your voice is your power. Astound teaches you how to use it.

- A 30-Day Challenge that gradually builds your voice toward your chosen goal

- Daily reminders to build a lasting habit

With Flavorish, your go-to recipe app, organizing, saving, and
bluejetty:00168151:ios.description:
Save recipes from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, websites, cookbooks, handwritten notes, and more, all in one app! Turn them into meal plans and grocery lists in seconds.
With Flavorish, your go-to recipe app, organizing, saving, and cooking has never been easier.
Save recipes from anywhere
- Save from Social Media: Save recipes directly from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube in a clean, easy-to-read format.
- Save from Images: Snap photos of handwritten recipes, cookbooks, menus, or food and convert them into editable recipes with AI.
- Save from Text: Paste a recipe in plain text and let AI automatically turn it into a structured recipe with detailed ingredients, instructions, and notes.
- Unlimited Web Imports: Save and customize recipes from any website or blog.
- Deep Recipe Imports: Use AI to deeply analyze non‑standard recipe pages to more accurately capture ingredients, instructions, notes, and other details. 
- Digital Cookbook: Create recipes from scratch or save family favorites in one organized cookbook.
Cook smarter
-AI Recipe Generator: Instantly get personalized recipe ideas by entering ingredients you have or your dietary goals & needs, including vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, diabetic, and more.
- Nutrition & Servings: Get detailed nutrition data and scale recipes up or down for any occasion.
- Cooking Mode: Cook multiple recipes at once while your screen stays on.
- Custom Collections: Organize recipes into collections like "Family Dinners," "Low-Carb Lunches," or "Quick Snacks" and share it with friends and family.
Plan and shop with ease
-Meal Planning: Plan weekly meals with your saved recipes in seconds, organized by breakfast, lunch, snack or dinner.
- Grocery Lists: Automatically generate grocery lists by recipe, organize by aisle, and collaborate or share them in real time.
- Print recipes: Print recipes or save them to PDF with customizable servings, units, images, and notes.
- Offline Access & Sync Across Devices: Access recipes and lists without internet, synced across all your devices.
- Ad-Free, Privacy first: No ads, no interruptions, we don't sell user data.
- Easy Recipe Sharing: Share recipes, collections and grocery lists with family and friends with a single tap.
Flavorish’s Free plan offers a seamless, ad-free recipe experience across unlimited devices, with no hidden fees, pop-ups, or data selling. To keep building powerful features, we offer a $4.99/month Premium plan that supports our small team and covers the cost of advanced tools. Core features will always be free. Just pay for what it takes to run the premium features. Fair and simple.
Flavorish isn't just another recipe app, it’s a must have toolkit in your kitchen. Start using Flavorish now and change the way you cook.
"For consumer-friendly design, reliable AI, and the best UI, Flavorish is the recipe app I recommend for saving viral recipes." - Yahoo Life!
For our Terms of Use, visit https://www.flavorish.ai/terms-of-use
