bluejetty:00129127:ios.description:
Do you like atmospheric Western-style gun shooter games? Like shootouts, chases, wars with criminal gangs and their dangerous bosses? Then our survival sniper action game is for you. Take guns and fight for justice! 
Slay all ragdoll bandits in an epic Wild West shooting game! Try Western Sniper to feel like a cowboy fighting for justice on this godforsaken land. Explore various locations & be ready to shoot down the invaders! 
Shameless gangs of thugs have decided to capture new lands and get away with it. But there is a defender in the area - a tough sniper – someone, who can declare war to the troublemakers, fight back, and restore peace and order in the region. It's all about you! 
Feel like a brave cowboy, a sharp sniper, fighting for justice. The clash is going to be tough! Will you be able to survive against dozens, even hundreds, of enemies? 
Your gun is your best friend in this grave battle. Aim, shoot, and repeat - here are three simple but vital rules on the way to success in this dangerous adventure! You are to stay face to face with deadly danger and you have to survive by all means. Shoot back from cover with either one or two hands, using different weapons - rifles, pistols - and defeat your enemies in exciting duels. 
This sniper western game will definitely captivate you with the spirit of the Wild West and let you feel not just like a brave cowboy and a gunslinger, but like a true hero – one, who is able to clear the local land from the gangs of robbers and protect civilians. An incredible survival action with chases and gunfights is waiting for you. Be the best sniper to the very end, find a target and destroy all the stickman bandits to stay alive and save the region. 
Top features of Western Sniper: 
- One of the most action-packed FPS shooting games 
- Genuine atmosphere of the Wild West 
- Gun and revolver shooting modes: aim and see the ragdoll bandits in the scope 
- Various challenging locations. Try to shoot them down in a train or boat. Saloons and old towns are too easy! 
- Game store with lots of rifles to choose from 
- Genuine music & sound effects to recreate the western atmosphere 
Test your marksmanship, gunslinger! Start playing our exciting online or offline sniper warfare game and get the most out of it by improving your results. 
Let's go! It's time to take out all the ragdolls in the area. A dangerous battle is waiting for you. 
Shoot down all the wanted bandits in this FPS game, bang bang!

bluejetty:00022091:ios.description:
■ MazM Membership ■
If you are subscribed to MazM Membership, please log in with the same ID.
You can use all of this game's content for free.
In this narrative adventure, you follow a young traveler across borderlands, facing loss, hope, and hard choices. Set against a turbulent era, the journey unfolds like a book you can play—quiet, emotional, and deeply human.
■ Story & Genre
This is a full-length visual novel and story game that centers on people rather than battles. If you enjoy story games and storyline game experiences, you'll feel right at home. The plot moves through layered conversations, letters, and memories, capturing the weight of history and the warmth found in small kindnesses. For fans of sad games and emotional game narratives, its tone balances melancholy with resilience.
■ Gameplay Features
Play at your pace. Read, make dialogue choices, and uncover side episodes to learn more about each character. Interactive stories meet adventure games sensibilities: no grinding, no timers—just choices that shape how you understand the people you meet. Whether you prefer story mode games or interactive story games, the focus stays on immersion.
■ Key Highlights
• A crafted, chaptered story with clear arcs—from arrival, to parting, to quiet reckonings.
• Choice-driven reading: multiple routes and unlockable side stories for deeper context.
• Timeless presentation: clean UI, evocative soundtrack, and illustrations that feel like a diary come to life.
• Designed for players who seek the best story games, not twitch reflexes.
• Works great for short sessions or long weekends—your progress autosaves.
■ About MazM
• MazM is a story and adventure game studio that reimagines classic novels and various works as games.
• Like the lingering emotions you feel after a memorable book, movie, or musical, we aim to deliver deep immersion and lasting impact to our players.
• Experience unique adventures through the visual novel and story game titles created by MazM.
• We will continue to craft story games that deliver unforgettable narratives and emotions.
[MazM Membership]
MazM membership begins upon payment, and charges are applied on a monthly basis. 
There is no long-term contract or cancellation fee, and you can easily cancel online at any time, 24 hours a day.
The information collected through MazM games for iOS and iPadOS is subject to the Growing Seeds Corporation's privacy policy.
If you would like to learn more about the information collected by Growing Seeds Corporation in other situations, such as during account registration, please refer to Growing Seeds Corporation's privacy policy (see the link below).
Privacy Policy: https://www.storymazm.com/privacy-policy-en
Terms of Service: https://www.storymazm.com/terms-of-service-en

bluejetty:00116055:ios.summary:
Gilded Court: Regal Era Revived, Aristocratic Life Reimagined
In this ornate palace with carved beams, crystal chandeliers reflect velvet drapery. Dress in finery for masquerade balls, savor macarons on the terrace, and experience 18th-cent
bluejetty:00116055:ios.description:
Gilded Court: Regal Era Revived, Aristocratic Life Reimagined
In this ornate palace with carved beams, crystal chandeliers reflect velvet drapery. Dress in finery for masquerade balls, savor macarons on the terrace, and experience 18th-century noble life.
Princess Castle: Fairy Tale Dreamscape, Magical Encounter Journey
In this spired castle, spiral stairs are carpeted in rose red, and stained glass casts prismatic light. Meet singing nightingales on the starlit terrace.
Pirate Tavern: Buccaneer Revelry, Nautical Legend Stage
In this rum-scented tavern, oak tables bear etched nautical logs. Hear one-eyed captains tell sea monster tales, play the banjo by the fireplace, and piece together treasure map fragments.
Coral Cathedral: Deep-Sea Romance Realm, Coral Sanctum
In this coral-carved cathedral, jellyfish float like chandeliers above seashell pews on seagrass carpets. Sunlight spills on pearl altars as mermaid crystal ring ceremonies unfold.
Abyssal Adventure: Unexplored Depths Challenge, Deep-Sea Quest
Dive into abysses in fluorescent wetsuits as glowing jellyfish thread through cliffs. Solve underwater locks, dodge current traps, and hunt for the Ocean's Heart in giant clams.
Fashion Atelier: Personal Style Lab, Creative Wardrobe Workshop
Magic mirrors suggest looks like steampunk coats with lace umbrellas or mermaid-scale gowns. Gather pearls and feathers to design one-of-a-kind attire.
Game Hub: Interactive Entertainment Nexus, Multiverse Playground
In this neon-lit arcade, dance machines flash to beats as players nail dynamic dance moves. Basketball hoops host three-point shootouts, and claw machines hide talking plushies.
Oceanium: Azure Biodiversity Encyclopedia, Underwater Wonderworld
Beneath a glass dome, whale sharks glide overhead while seahorses thread through seaweed forests. Touch rays and ride mini-subs to observe hydrothermal vent creatures.
Baby Haven: Playful Parent-Child Paradise, Little One's Wonderland
In this space with cloud-patterned carpets, glowing star hangings rotate. Babies play in rainbow ball pits, wear animal onesies.
Mermaid Restaurant: Fantastical Culinary Feast, Deep-Sea Gastronomy
Jellyfish lamps light the hall as waiters serve coral salads on seashell platters. Signature "Seaweed Pearl Soup" bursts with colorful bubbles, and shell-carved coins are gifted after meals.
Mermaid Lodge: Coral Colony Lifestyle Guide, Underwater Homestead
In homes built from shells and conchs, seagrass curtains flutter. Learn to weave coral jewelry from mermaids, dry kelp in anemone gardens, and join monthly underwater moonlight dances.
Neon Sea Party: Glow-in-the-Dark Extravaganza, Underwater Rave
Fluorescent jellyfish lights up as electric ray bands play on coral stages under the full moon. Dance the seaweed ballet in glowing kelp dresses and sip starfish cocktails from shell goblets.

1.Theme scene subscription:
Monthly Pass: $8.99 per month, with automatic monthly renewal
Annual Pass: $79.99 per year, automatically renewed annually
Ads Weekly Pass：$1.99 per week, Automatically renew weekly
Ads Monthly Pass: $2.99 per month, with automatic monthly renewal
Care Baby： $1.99 per week, Automatically renew weekly
2. The membership service will be paid directly through the iTunes account.
3. 24 hours before the subscription service expires, the system will automatically renew the subscription and deduct the corresponding fee according to the subscription type.
4. If you need to close the subscription service, please do so in "Account Settings" at least 24 hours in advance.
5.Service Agreement and Privacy Policy :
User Agreement (EULA): https://hdwl.site/ios_user_agreement_builder_en.html
Member Service Agreement (Includes automatic renewal service agreement): https://hdwl.site/ios_service_builder_en.html
Privacy Policy: https://hdwl.site/hnhd_privatet_en.html

bluejetty:00014198:ios.description:
Start banking wherever you are with FMBSC_ToGo Mobile for iPad and iPhone! Available to all Farmers and Merchants Bank of South Carolina online banking customers, FMBSC_ToGo Mobile allows you to check balances, make transfers, pay bills, pay a person, make deposits, access via Touch ID or Passcode and find locations. Need to find a Branch or ATM closest to you? With Find Near Me, FMBSC_ToGo Mobile will discover your location and provide you with addresses and phone numbers on the fly.
Available features include:
Accounts
- Check your latest account balance and search recent transactions by date, amount, or check number.
Transfers
- Easily transfer cash between your accounts.
Pay Bills
-Easily pay bills anytime on the fly.
-Add, edit and delete Payees
People Pay
- Send and receive payments to individuals by email only or via email and phone (text).
Deposit Checks
-Easily make a check deposit.
Passcode
- Allows user to enter a numeric passcode (instead of user name, password, challenge).
Touch ID
- Allows user to set up access to mobile banking using fingerprint after authenticating with full credentials.
Locations
- Find nearby Branches and ATMs using the iPhone's built-in GPS. Additionally, you can search by zip code or address.
All features may not be available in the tablet application.

bluejetty:00122403:ios.description:
Welcome to Listen Sunny Coast – Your Local Audio Hub
Listen Sunny Coast is your go-to audio companion, offering a curated and personalized experience for all things Sunshine Coast. Whether you're at home, on the go, or enjoying the beach, our app brings the best of local radio, music, podcasts, and news right to your fingertips.
What We Offer
• Live Local Radio: Tune into your favourite Sunshine Coast radio stations, including 92.7 Mix FM, 91.9 SeaFM and MIXFM Light, all in one place.
• Exclusive Podcasts: Discover a wide range of original and local podcasts covering topics from community stories to lifestyle, arts, and local events.
• Music Stations: Enjoy a variety of music genres with our curated playlists and live music stations, perfect for every mood and moment.
• News & Updates: Stay informed with up-to-date local news, weather, and traffic updates, keeping you connected to the Sunshine Coast community.
Key Features
• On-Demand Access: Listen to your favourite shows and podcasts anytime, anywhere, with seamless streaming and offline capabilities.
• User-Friendly Interface: Navigate effortlessly through our intuitive design, making your audio experience smooth and enjoyable.
• Community Focused: Engage with local content that matters to you, supporting Sunshine Coast creators and stories.
• Win Prizes & Contests: Enter exclusive competitions and giveaways directly through the app for your chance to win amazing local prizes
Why Download Listen Sunny Coast?
By downloading Listen Sunny Coast, you gain access to a rich tapestry of local audio content that keeps you connected to your community. Whether you're commuting, working out, or relaxing at home, our app ensures you're always in tune with the Sunshine Coast's vibrant audio landscape.

Q: Why does the music occasionally skip?

▷ 4 Minute High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)

▷ 10 Seconds of Rest

bluejetty:00115514:ios.summary:

Built with performance and usability i
bluejetty:00115514:ios.description:
Sonify – A Smarter Way to Control Your Sonos System
Sonify is a powerful third-party controller for your Sonos® system, designed to make your listening experience faster, smoother, and more enjoyable.
Built with performance and usability in mind, Sonify combines all your favorite features with new tools and a refined UI to help you get the most from your music.
We are not affiliated with or endorsed by Sonos, Inc. Sonos® and related trademarks are the property of Sonos, Inc.
Key Features
Faster, More Convenient Controls
- Lock screen & Control Center integration – Control playback without unlocking your phone.
- Hardware volume buttons – Adjust Sonos volume directly from your device’s volume keys.
- More responsive group volume control – Fine-tuned responsiveness for group adjustments.
- One-tap Sync button – Instantly match all players to the same group volume.
Better Navigation & Customization
- Improved navigation – Move through your music library and services effortlessly.
- Customizable home page - Make your home page your own by adding different sections.
- Dedicated Library page – Quick access to your playlists, liked songs, and saved content across services.
- Native pages for faster performance – Smooth scrolling, snappy responses, and minimal load times.
Enhanced Now Playing Experience
- Like button – Save the currently playing track to your service’s liked songs instantly.
- Artist & Album view – Jump directly to more from the artist or album with a single tap.
- Quick access to TV controls – Control your TV when connected to a Sonos home theater setup.
Smarter Playlist Management (for compatible services)
- Sort and search your playlists.
- Create, rename, edit and delete playlists.
- Add or remove tracks without leaving the app.
Queue Your Way
- Swipe actions – Quickly add to queue or play next.
- Custom queue system – Our unique queue architecture makes playing tracks in large playlists near-instant.
Sonify is only compatible with S2 systems.
Sonify does not completely replace the official Sonos app. System setup and some configuration such as TruePlay must be completed in the official app.
Privacy: https://sonify.cloud/privacy
Terms: https://sonify.cloud/terms

Indulge in the perfect blend of entertainment with our delightful merging game – Joy Cafe! If you're a true aficionado of coffee, fine food, and the excitement of mer
bluejetty:00091027:ios.description:
Discover Joy Cafe: The Ultimate Merging Game for Coffee and Food Lovers!
Indulge in the perfect blend of entertainment with our delightful merging game – Joy Cafe! If you're a true aficionado of coffee, fine food, and the excitement of merge games, then this exceptional coffee shop simulation game has been meticulously crafted just for you.
Merge and Manage Your Dream Café!
Step boldly into the shoes of a visionary culinary entrepreneur and craft your very own coffee shop empire! Merge diverse ingredients, conjure up delectable desserts, and serve up the most scrumptious coffee creations to your ever-expanding clientele. Elevate your menu, sharpen your culinary skills, and witness the astonishing transformation of your café into an unrivaled culinary masterpiece.
Master the Art of Coffee and Cooking
Unleash your inner culinary maestro as you seamlessly merge ingredients, fashioning mouthwatering treats that push the boundaries of taste. Ascend to the status of a master barista, expertly brewing the perfect cup of coffee to satiate the palates of fervent caffeine enthusiasts. This isn't merely a casual kitchen game; it is an immersive simulation of the culinary universe. Assume the mantle of a skillful kitchen manager, optimizing resources, steering your team, and asserting your dominance in the realm of restaurant games!
Design Your Café Wonderland
Unleash your innate flair for interior design and metamorphose your café into a chic haven of aesthetic wonder. Effortlessly merge elements to unlock a captivating array of décor styles, allowing you to meticulously tailor your coffee shop's ambiance – from the rustic allure of a quaint bakery to the contemporary elegance of a sophisticated patisserie. Whether you're cultivating an intimate corner for coffee talk or curating an inviting dessert display, the power rests in your hands to craft an atmosphere that beckons customers back for more.
Where Coffee and Desserts Meet Romance
Prepare to be captivated by a symphony of drama, romance, and tantalizing flavors! Engage with your customers to unearth their cherished preferences, delighting them with an array of delectable desserts and specialty coffee concoctions that are certain to leave them yearning for more. From the inquisitive librarian to the discerning coffee connoisseur, every palate will be gratified by the exquisite flavors you serve.
Aim for the Apex of the Coffee Scene
While merging ingredients is undeniably gratifying, the fusion of minds holds even greater allure! Strive for culinary supremacy in an array of cooking challenges and events. Unveil your barista expertise to the world and endeavor to seize the coveted top spot. Forge connections with fellow players, inviting friends to partake in this shared culinary journey. Remember, the joys multiply when they're shared!
Craft Your Unique Café Narrative
Empower yourself to sculpt your culinary destiny within the enchanting realm of Joy Cafe! Embrace the art of merging, effective management, and inventive creation to foster a café that is a true reflection of your individuality. Regardless of whether you're an aspiring barista or an aspiring coffee shop magnate, this merging game is the ultimate fusion of coffee, cooking, and carefree amusement.
Embark on Your Joyful Journey Now!
Download Joy Cafe and immerse yourself in the creation of your own café saga. Brew a storm, merge your way to success, and unravel the delightful narrative of your very own cafe story!

bluejetty:00154574:ios.name: Weight Tracker & Check BMI
bluejetty:00154574:ios.summary: Dieting? Exercising? Want a perfectly toned body shape? Yes! But, don't know if it's working or not for you! Best way is to track your daily weight gain or weight loss, so that you can control your body mass & avoid being overweight again.
bluejetty:00154574:ios.description:
Dieting? Exercising? Want a perfectly toned body shape? Yes! But, don't know if it's working or not for you! Best way is to track your daily weight gain or weight loss, so that you can control your body mass & avoid being overweight again. 
No, it's not difficult at all! We've made it easy as a pie! Control! :
It's always easy to track & monitor the progress by understanding what really works for you. Say, you want to reach a weight goal or maybe you just want to get back to your Ideal Bodyweight after a pregnancy. Having a right app is must to track it!
Easy-to-use, this Weight Tracker App is developed Just for You, which not only allows to add your everyday measurements, but also helps to track your weight record.
Wondering, “How to Gain Weight” or “How to Lose Weight”?
With all the efforts, it is must to observe whether you are on the right track to reach your desired goal or not. This Weight Loss Tracker App shall encourage you! Lose or gain weight and check stats in this ideal smart app! This Body Weight Tracker App is the right choice for you to help get a compliment for your perfect body shape. 
Cool features of “Weight Tracker for Weight Loss”:
> Set a desired target & follow your progress
> Body weight diary helps you to achieve your goal
> Analysis of Weight Control in a smart chart
> Statistics about your Bodyweight (difference of your starting & target weight)
> Choose a preferred measurement unit (kg or lb, cm or (ft + inches))
> Calculate Total Weight Loss/Weight Gain with the remaining amount to achieve your goal
> Weekly, Monthly, or Yearly Weigh Calculation
> Smart reminder to notify you to add current weight at your pre-defined time
Losing or Gaining Weight will turn out to be FUN when you track your weight!
Simply enter your gender, age & height. Then. it will automatically set a goal as per the Ideal Weight Chart!
Set your desire Goal & challenge yourself to lose weight in 30 days! Stay motivated by tracking your Bodyweight & analyze your progress in a chart. This Weight Tracker App will also suggest your Ideal Body Weight based on your height, gender, and age.
Divided into 3 categories:
1) Overview:
 Using this section, you can keep your weight record by monitoring progress in a neat chart. Initial weigh can be considered as Start Weight. You can add your current Bodyweight by using ‘+’ sign. Your Target Weight can be determined automatically from the age, gender & height!
 The difference between Start & Current weigh is calculated to show a change in weight & the difference between Current & Target Weight is calculated to show how much goal amount is remaining to achieve!
2) Statistics:
 From this section, you can easily get your body statistics, from which you can categorize your weight type as either underweight, normal, or overweight! These categories are defined from the BMI range.
 BMI means Body Mass Index. BMI Calculator calculates BMI from age, height, Bodyweight, and gender that is entered by users! And from that, it gives body statistics.
3) History:
 This section is used to keep a track of Weight Loss Record! Here you can get day wise record, in which you can get weigh on a particular date and difference from the previous one as weight loss or weight gain! So from this section, you can decide what will be the next step to achieve your Target Weight!
Check your Weight Diary to find your ideal body weight, because overweight and obesity are risk factors for diseases such as hypertension, heart disease, and diabetes. It can also be used to find a healthy weight if you want to lose it.
You can also take a back up of Body Statistics. So, if you change your device then also you can keep a track on your weigh goal!
If you are already looking for such weight loss apps, it means you are on the right track for getting a better & healthier life.
Get this Weight Tracker for Weight Loss App to Stay Fit, Stay Healthy!

ElonAI: Chat & Answer Engine is the ultimate AI assistant that makes your everyday conversations smarter, faster, and more enjoyable. Designed for students, professionals, creators, and curious minds, ElonAI helps you find answers, create content, translate languages, organize ideas, and stay productive—all from one powerful app.
With cutting-edge artificial intelligence, ElonAI adapts to your needs in real time. Whether you want to research a topic, improve your writing, learn something new, or spark creative ideas, ElonAI delivers instant, accurate, and engaging results.
What You Can Do with ElonAI
Ask Anything, Anytime: Get quick answers to questions on any subject, from science and history to pop culture and daily life.
Perfect Your Writing: Automatically correct grammar, refine tone, and make your sentences clear and professional.
Simplify Complex Text: Summarize articles, documents, and reports into easy-to-understand language—even for a 2nd grader.

Plan & Organize: Create structured outlines for essays, projects, and reports.
Generate Creative Ideas: Build product names, taglines, or marketing slogans with AI inspiration.
Study Smarter: Receive detailed, well-organized notes on any subject to speed up learning.
And More: Explore a growing library of AI tools for productivity, learning, and creativity.
Why Choose ElonAI?
All-in-One Solution: No need for multiple apps—everything you need for communication, creativity, and learning is in one place.
Time-Saving: Cut hours of research, editing, and brainstorming into minutes.
Accessible to Everyone: From beginners to power users, ElonAI’s interface is simple and intuitive.
Always Improving: We constantly update features to bring you the latest in AI technology.

bluejetty:00074624:ios.description:
LUXURY FASHION AND LIFESTYLE DESTINATION
The official SSENSE app offers a seamless shopping experience geared to your needs. Discover new season arrivals, trending designers, exclusive collaborations, and limited-release collections across womenswear, menswear, kidswear, and Everything Else™. Shop a curated edit of over 500 luxury and lifestyle brands, emerging designers, and streetwear labels, including Gucci, Essentials, Aesop, Jacquemus, Moncler, Alexander McQueen, Converse, Balenciaga, Off-White, Saint Laurent, Versace, and hundreds more. Featuring easy navigation, quick searches, simple filters, sales alerts, and daily style drops. The SSENSE app is accessible in English, French, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese. Delivery to over 150 countries worldwide.
INTUITIVE SHOPPING
Use our filter options to shop by brand or category and explore over 60,000 styles from more than 500 luxury brands and independent designer labels.
PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS
Browse personalized product selections based on your preferences and recent shopping activity.
UP-TO-DATE ALERTS
Enable push notifications and be the first to know about the latest product drops, new collections, SSENSE collaborations and partnerships, as well as sales and promotional offers.
ORDER TRACKING
Keep track of your shopping history and current orders and get the latest updates on your shipments, all in one place.
STREAMLINED CHECKOUT
Enjoy a seamless shopping experience from product discovery to hassle-free checkout, and expedited delivery.
YOUR WISHLIST
Save your favorite designer styles and lifestyle pieces in your wishlist and add them to your shopping cart when you are ready to purchase.
SOCIAL SHARING
Share your coveted designer styles, notable SSENSE collaborations, and limited-release product drops on your preferred social media network including Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and iMessages.
SSENSE (pronounced [es-uhns]) is a global technology platform and fashion and lifestyle shopping destination blurring the lines between culture and commerce. It is renowned for its distinctive offering of established and emerging luxury brands, streetwear labels, and original editorial features and cultural content. Visit www.ssense.com and follow @ssense for new arrivals, exclusive collaborations, special offers, and much more. The customer care team is available in 5 languages, 24/7 at customercare@ssense.com.

bluejetty:00069940:ios.summary: Winner’s Soccer 2014 is a real 3D competitive football game. It includes the teams and the latest football players’ data of 2014 World Cup. There are various modes for you to select, such as Cup, League Match and Friendly Match. It has up t
bluejetty:00069940:ios.description:
Winner’s Soccer 2014 is a real 3D competitive football game. It includes the teams and the latest football players’ data of 2014 World Cup. There are various modes for you to select, such as Cup, League Match and Friendly Match. It has up to 126 teams and 2600 players. Smooth actions and playback function let you feel like you actually in the game. 
1．Game Modes
 This game has various modes, including Cup (World Cup, Club Cup), League Match (Premier League, Lega Serie A, La Liga and CSL), Friendly Match and Penalty Shootout. It also has a training mode for you to train skills of your team, dividing into Primary, Medium and Advanced.
Friendly Match Mode: You can select 2 teams from 62 club teams to compete or shoot penalty.
Cup Mode: You can select your favorite team from 64 national teams to participate the World Cup. 
League Mode, You can select one team from Britain, Italy, Spain or China to compete for championship.
Training Mode: You can select a team to perfect its operation skills.
2. Various Operation Skills
 This game provides two kinds of operation modes. You can choose the most suitable one. (You can change mode in Options under Menu or tap button || to activate Menu in game.)
You can read Control Method in Help of Options under Menu.
The operation adopts an international popular way, setting 5 pass ball keys: Short Pass /Press and Long Pass/Slide Tackle, Shoot, Through Pass/GK Rush Out, Long through Pass and Special Dribble /Focus Change.
Short Pass: It is short pass in offense. Let controller press opponent dribbler in defense.
Long Pass: Press Power Accumulate and pass the ball to a mate of appropriate distance after release. Let controller slide tackle when defend.
Shoot: Make different shooting actions according to Power Accumulate and the distance between player and ball.
Special Dribble: Including many special dribble actions: Marsille roulette, Step over, Step over and Pull back.
Automatic combination skills:
Through Pass: Pass ball to catcher according to Power Accumulate.
Long through Pass: Pass ball to catcher with Long Pass according to Power Accumulate.
Sprint: Rapid dribble, fasten speed of dribble but worsen control of ball.
Drive ball out: Stop ball far away from body and facilitate dribble starting acceleration.
Dribble with far distance: Double click in front when fast dribble can dribble farther and facilitate fast run.
Fake Shoot and Fake Long pass: Pressing Short Pass when (or after) Shoot or Power Accumulate will cancel shoot or long pass. They are used to dribble past opponent Defenders or GK.
One-Two pass: Two players cooperate to dribble past opponent Defenders.
Lob shoot: Press Special Dribble to shoot.
Control tracks of ball: Press direction keys to control the flying arc of ball.

Processing is the first easy-to-use software sketching platform created by C. Reas and B. Fry
 and supported by the Processing Foundation.
 Included is an integrated development environment that can be used to develop interactive applications
 using different programming languages but mainly Java, Android, Python, and Javascript.
 Known issues:
 Python sketches can run but you may have trouble stopping them running. If so, you will have
 to use your system monitor application of choice (such as htop) to close the sketch, as it will
 be the only way to stop the sketch, other than closing the IDE itself. This problem also persists
 outside of Flatpak. See: https://github.com/flathub/org.processing.processingide/issues/5
 When trying to open a Python sketch other than an example sketch in the "Examples" dialog,
 the IDE may crash and close by itself. This problem also persists outside of Flatpak. See: https://github.com/benfry/processing4/issues/793
 Python Mode for Processing is currently unmaintained and a new maintainer is currently being
 sought after. It can still be downloaded and run via the Contribution Manager by going to the
 mode selection dialog and clicking "Mode Manager -> Modes -> Python Mode for Processing
 4 -> Install". See: https://github.com/jdf/processing.py/blob/1932b4ca71f3befd333cc23d3a1c8fe7617014ff/README.markdown#this-project-is-not-maintained

Designed primarily for conservatory professors, MyMusicComping is fully adaptable for use by professional pianists, teachers in music schools, and academies.
MyMusicComping stems from its programmer's experience as an accompanist and aims to meet all the needs that professionals may encounter in their work:
- Organize your students by specialty, level, or tutor.
- View your students' information, the repertoire you work on with each of them, and a personalized record of their rehearsals with you.
- Organize your entire repertoire by composer and instrument, indicate its difficulty, and link it to the rehearsals where it is performed and the students who work on it.
- Keep track of all rehearsals by date, indicating whether it was performed in public or recorded.
- Add evaluations and ratings, if needed. - Keep track of all your auditions and concerts, organized by specialty and date, with a list of participating students and the repertoire each one performed.
- Access your scores in PDF format directly from the app, or linked to major online repositories.
- Integrate the app with the ForScore application if you use it on your iPad.
- Receive and schedule notifications and timers for your rehearsals.
- Integrate app data with your system calendar.
- Connect app data with Calendly's online booking system.
- Keep your data organized and up-to-date with simple, flexible, and effective update and maintenance processes.
- Import data from external sources and export it for future reference and archiving in CSV format.
- Share your rehearsals with the tutors of the students you play with who use MyMusicClass app.
MyMusicComping data—which you can protect with a password and your devices' biometric security—is securely stored encrypted in your iCloud account and automatically synced across all your devices, allowing you to work seamlessly across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
MyMusicComping is available in English and Spanish in App Stores worldwide.

apple-macos:6811428611.name: Project Hub: Work & Travel
apple-macos:6811428611.description:
Project Hub keeps everything a project needs in one calm place: your trips, your daily work log, your expenses and receipts, your deadlines and appointments. With one tap it turns them into finished documents – a travel expense report, a work log or a complete project dossier as a PDF.
NEW: MEETINGS INTO TRANSCRIPTS
One tap on the recorder widget records a meeting. Project Hub turns it into a transcript on your device and writes a title, a summary and the to-dos – on every iPhone. One more tap logs the conversation as work time.
YOUR OWN TEMPLATES
Design a template once and it applies automatically to every document you choose. Your name, company, address, phone and email fill in by themselves. Write letters laid out for window envelopes and export your hours for any period as a PDF or CSV.
DEADLINES & APPOINTMENTS WIDGET
All upcoming deadlines and appointments on your Home Screen, including Apple Calendar. Switch between all, deadlines and appointments, page through the list and tick off deadlines with a tap: open, in progress, done. Overdue deadlines stay visible until they are done.
PROJECTS AS FOLDERS
Every project is a beautifully designed folder. Open it to see the next trip, this week's hours, the costs so far and the next appointment at a glance.
TRIPS WITH REAL ROUTES
Log trips by car, train or plane. Project Hub calculates driving distances with Apple Maps, shows the route on a map and keeps departure and return times for meal allowances.
TRAVEL EXPENSE REPORTS IN ONE TAP
Choose your trips and create a PDF with mileage, meal allowances, deductions for provided meals and all linked receipts.
WORK LOG, DAY BY DAY
Record what you worked on and for how long. Use the timer, the Home Screen widget, the Live Activity or simply ask Siri. Weeks and days add up on their own.
EXPENSES AND RECEIPTS
Scan a receipt with the camera – the text is recognized on your device. Link expenses to trips so they land in the expense report automatically.
CALENDAR
Meetings, deadlines and trips in one calendar, optionally synced with Apple Calendar. One tap turns a meeting into logged work time.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account and no server. Your data is encrypted with AES-256 and stored on your device or in an iCloud Drive folder you choose, unlocked with Face ID or your passcode. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
Available in English, German and Arabic.
